bottom_solid_infill_flow_ratio.label: Bottom surface flow ratio
bottom_solid_infill_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for bottom solid infill.

The actual bottom solid infill flow used is calculated by multiplying this value with the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
bottom_solid_infill_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响底部固体填充的材料量。 实际使用的底部固体填充流量是通过将该值乘以细丝流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

first_layer_flow_ratio.label: First layer flow ratio
first_layer_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material on the first layer for the extrusion path roles listed in this section.

For the first layer, the actual flow ratio for each path role (does not affect brims and skirts) will be multiplied by this value.
first_layer_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 此因素会影响本节中列出的挤出路径角色的第一层上的材料量。 对于第一层，每个路径角色的实际流量比（不影响Brim和​裙边）将乘以该值。

gap_fill_flow_ratio.label: Gap fill flow ratio
gap_fill_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for filling the gaps.

The actual gap filling flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
gap_fill_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响填充间隙的材料量。 实际使用的间隙填充流量是通过将该值乘以耗材流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

inner_wall_flow_ratio.label: Inner wall flow ratio
inner_wall_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for inner walls.

The actual inner wall flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
inner_wall_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响内壁材料的用量。 实际使用的内壁流量是通过将该值乘以耗材流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

interlocking_beam.label: Use beam interlocking
interlocking_beam.tip: Generate interlocking beam structure at the locations where different filaments touch. This improves the adhesion between filaments, especially models printed in different materials.
interlocking_beam.tip_zh: 在不同耗材接触的位置生成互锁梁结构。这改善了耗材之间的粘合性，特别是使用不同材料打印的模型。

interlocking_beam_layer_count.label: Interlocking beam layers
interlocking_beam_layer_count.tip: The height of the beams of the interlocking structure, measured in number of layers. Less layers is stronger, but more prone to defects.
interlocking_beam_layer_count.tip_zh: 互锁结构梁的高度，以层数为单位。较少的层更强，但更容易出现缺陷。

interlocking_beam_width.label: Interlocking beam width
interlocking_beam_width.tip: The width of the interlocking structure beams.

interlocking_boundary_avoidance.label: Interlocking boundary avoidance
interlocking_boundary_avoidance.tip: The distance from the outside of a model where interlocking structures will not be generated, measured in cells.
interlocking_boundary_avoidance.tip_zh: 模型边框与互锁结构的距离，以单元格为单位。

interlocking_depth.label: Interlocking depth
interlocking_depth.tip: The distance from the boundary between filaments to generate interlocking structure, measured in cells. Too few cells will result in poor adhesion.
interlocking_depth.tip_zh: 从耗材边界生成互锁结构的距离，以单元格为单位。太少的单元格将导致粘合不良。

internal_solid_infill_flow_ratio.label: Internal solid infill flow ratio
internal_solid_infill_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for internal solid infill.

The actual internal solid infill flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
internal_solid_infill_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响内部固体填充材料的数量。 实际使用的内部固体填充流量是通过将该值乘以耗材流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

mmu_segmented_region_interlocking_depth.label: Interlocking depth of a segmented region
mmu_segmented_region_interlocking_depth.tip: Interlocking depth of a segmented region. It will be ignored if "mmu_segmented_region_max_width" is zero or if "mmu_segmented_region_interlocking_depth" is bigger than "mmu_segmented_region_max_width". Zero disables this feature.
mmu_segmented_region_interlocking_depth.tip_zh: 分割区域的交错深度。如果"mmu_segmented_region_max_width"为零或"mmu_segmented_region_interlocking_depth"大于"mmu_segmented_region_max_width"，则将被忽略。零将禁用此功能。

mmu_segmented_region_max_width.label: Maximum width of a segmented region
mmu_segmented_region_max_width.tip: Maximum width of a segmented region. Zero disables this feature.
mmu_segmented_region_max_width.tip_zh: 分段区域的最大宽度。将其设置为零会禁用此功能。

outer_wall_flow_ratio.label: Outer wall flow ratio
outer_wall_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for outer walls.

The actual outer wall flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
outer_wall_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响外墙材料的用量。 实际使用的外壁流量是通过将该值乘以耗材流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

overhang_flow_ratio.label: Overhang flow ratio
overhang_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for overhangs.

The actual overhang flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
overhang_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响悬垂材料的数量。 实际使用的悬垂流量是通过将该值乘以耗材流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

set_other_flow_ratios.label: Set other flow ratios
set_other_flow_ratios.tip: Change flow ratios for other extrusion path types.
set_other_flow_ratios.tip_zh: 更改其他挤出路径类型的流量比。

sparse_infill_flow_ratio.label: Sparse infill flow ratio
sparse_infill_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for sparse infill.

The actual sparse infill flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
sparse_infill_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响稀疏填充的材料量。 实际使用的稀疏填充流量是通过将该值乘以耗材流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

support_flow_ratio.label: Support flow ratio
support_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for support.

The actual support flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
support_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响支撑材料的数量。 实际使用的支撑流量是通过将该值乘以耗材流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

support_interface_flow_ratio.label: Support interface flow ratio
support_interface_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for the support interface.

The actual support interface flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
support_interface_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响支撑界面的材料量。 实际使用的支撑界面流量是通过将该值乘以耗材流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

top_solid_infill_flow_ratio.label: Top surface flow ratio
top_solid_infill_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for top solid infill. You can decrease it slightly to have smooth surface finish.

The actual top surface flow used is calculated by multiplying this value with the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
top_solid_infill_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 该因素影响顶部固体填充的材料量。您可以稍微减少它以获得光滑的表面光洁度。 实际使用的顶面流量是通过将该值乘以耗材流量比以及对象的流量比（如果已设置）来计算的。

bottom_surface_filament_id.label: Bottom surface
bottom_surface_filament_id.tip:
Filament to print bottom surface.
"Default" uses the active object/part filament.
bottom_surface_filament_id.tip_zh:
用于打印底面的耗材。
“默认”使用当前对象/零件的耗材。

extruder.label: Extruder
extruder.tip: The extruder to use (unless more specific extruder settings are specified). This value overrides perimeter and infill extruders, but not the support extruders.

inner_wall_filament_id.label: Inner walls
inner_wall_filament_id.tip:
Filament to print inner walls.
"Default" uses the active object/part filament.
inner_wall_filament_id.tip_zh:
用于打印内墙的耗材。
“默认”使用当前对象/零件的耗材。

internal_solid_filament_id.label: Internal solid infill
internal_solid_filament_id.tip:
Filament to print internal solid infill.
"Default" uses the active object/part filament.
internal_solid_filament_id.tip_zh:
用于打印内部实心填充的耗材。
“默认”使用当前对象/零件的耗材。

outer_wall_filament_id.label: Outer walls
outer_wall_filament_id.tip:
Filament to print outer walls.
"Default" uses the active object/part filament.
outer_wall_filament_id.tip_zh:
用于打印外墙的耗材。
“默认”使用当前对象/零件的耗材。

sparse_infill_filament_id.label: Infill
sparse_infill_filament_id.tip:
Filament to print internal sparse infill.
"Default" uses the active object/part filament.
sparse_infill_filament_id.tip_zh:
用于打印内部稀疏填充的耗材。
“默认”使用当前对象/零件的耗材。

top_surface_filament_id.label: Top surface
top_surface_filament_id.tip:
Filament to print top surface.
"Default" uses the active object/part filament.
top_surface_filament_id.tip_zh:
用于打印顶面的耗材。
“默认”使用当前对象/零件的耗材。

wipe_tower_filament.label: Wipe tower
wipe_tower_filament.tip: The extruder to use when printing perimeter of the wipe tower. Set to 0 to use the one that is available (non-soluble would be preferred).
wipe_tower_filament.tip_zh: 打印擦拭塔周长时使用的挤出机。设置为0将使用唯一的挤出机（尽量使用不可溶的材料）。

flush_into_infill.label: Flush into objects' infill
flush_into_infill.tip: Purging after filament change will be done inside objects' infills. This may lower the amount of waste and decrease the print time. If the walls are printed with transparent filament, the mixed color infill will be seen outside. It will not take effect, unless the prime tower is enabled.
flush_into_infill.tip_zh: 换料后的过渡料会被用来打印对象的填充。这样可以减少材料浪费和缩短打印时间，但是如果对象的内外墙是采用透明材料打印的，则可以从模型外观上看到内部的混色过渡料。该功能只有在启用料塔的时候才生效。

flush_into_objects.label: Flush into this object
flush_into_objects.tip: This object will be used to purge the nozzle after a filament change to save filament and decrease the print time. Colors of the objects will be mixed as a result. It will not take effect unless the prime tower is enabled.
flush_into_objects.tip_zh: 换料后的过渡料会被用来打印这个对象。这样可以减少材料浪费和缩短打印时间，但是这个对象的外观会是混色的。该功能只有在启用料塔的时候才生效。

flush_into_support.label: Flush into objects' support
flush_into_support.tip: Purging after filament change will be done inside objects' support. This may lower the amount of waste and decrease the print time. It will not take effect, unless the prime tower is enabled.
flush_into_support.tip_zh: 换料后的过渡料会被用来打印对象的支撑。这样可以减少材料浪费以及缩短打印时间。该功能只有在启用料塔的时候才生效。

before_layer_change_gcode.label: Before layer change G-code
before_layer_change_gcode.tip: This G-code is inserted at every layer change before the Z lift.
before_layer_change_gcode.tip_zh: 在每次换层抬升z高度之前插入这段G-code

change_extrusion_role_gcode.label: Change extrusion role G-code
change_extrusion_role_gcode.tip: This G-code is inserted when the extrusion role is changed.
change_extrusion_role_gcode.tip_zh: 当挤出类型改变时会插入此G-code

change_filament_gcode.label: Change filament G-code
change_filament_gcode.tip: This G-code is inserted when filament is changed, including T commands to trigger tool change.
change_filament_gcode.tip_zh: 换料时插入的G-code，包括T命令。

file_start_gcode.label: File header G-code
file_start_gcode.tip: G-code written at the very top of the output file, before any other content. Useful for adding metadata that printer firmware reads from the first lines of the file (e.g. estimated print time, filament usage). Supports placeholders like {print_time_sec} and {used_filament_length}.
file_start_gcode.tip_zh: G-code 写在输出文件的最顶部，位于任何其他内容之前。对于添加打印机固件从文件第一行读取的元数据（例如估计打印时间、耗材使用情况）很有用。支持 {print_time_sec} 和 {used_filament_length} 等占位符。

gcode_flavor.label: G-code flavor
gcode_flavor.tip: What kind of G-code the printer is compatible with.

layer_change_gcode.label: Layer change G-code
layer_change_gcode.tip: This G-code is inserted at every layer change after the Z lift.
layer_change_gcode.tip_zh: 在每次换层抬升Z高度之后插入这段G-code。

machine_end_gcode.label: End G-code
machine_end_gcode.tip: End G-code when finishing the entire print.
machine_end_gcode.tip_zh: 所有打印结束时的结尾G-code

machine_pause_gcode.label: Pause G-code
machine_pause_gcode.tip: This G-code will be used as a code for the pause print. Users can insert pause G-code in the G-code viewer.
machine_pause_gcode.tip_zh: 该G-code用于暂停打印。您可以在gcode预览中插入暂停G-code

machine_start_gcode.label: Start G-code
machine_start_gcode.tip: Start G-code when starting the entire print.
machine_start_gcode.tip_zh: 整个打印开始前的起始G-code

printing_by_object_gcode.label: Between Object G-code
printing_by_object_gcode.tip: Insert G-code between objects. This parameter will only come into effect when you print your models object by object.
printing_by_object_gcode.tip_zh: 在对象之间插入 G-code。此参数仅在逐个打印模型物体时生效。

template_custom_gcode.label: Custom G-code
template_custom_gcode.tip: This G-code will be used as a custom code.

filter_out_gap_fill.label: Filter out tiny gaps
filter_out_gap_fill.tip: Don't print gap fill with a length is smaller than the threshold specified (in mm). This setting applies to top, bottom and solid infill and, if using the classic perimeter generator, to wall gap fill.
filter_out_gap_fill.tip_zh: 不要打印长度小于指定阈值（以毫米为单位）的间隙填充。此设置适用于顶部、底部和实体填充，如果使用经典周长生成器，则适用于墙壁间隙填充。

emit_machine_limits_to_gcode.label: Emit limits to G-code
emit_machine_limits_to_gcode.tip:
If enabled, the machine limits will be emitted to G-code file.
This option will be ignored if the G-code flavor is set to Klipper.
emit_machine_limits_to_gcode.tip_zh:
如果启用，机器限制将写入到G-code文件。
如果G-code风格设置为Klipper，则此选项将被忽略。

machine_max_acceleration_extruding.tip_zh: 挤出时的最大加速度(M204 P)

machine_max_acceleration_travel.tip: Maximum acceleration for travel (M204 T), it only applies to Marlin 2.
machine_max_acceleration_travel.tip_zh: 最大空驶加速度（M204 T），仅适用于Marlin 2

machine_max_junction_deviation.tip:
Maximum junction deviation (M205 J, only apply if JD > 0 for Marlin Firmware
If your Marlin 2 printer uses Classic Jerk set this value to 0.)
machine_max_junction_deviation.tip_zh:
最大连接偏差（M205 J，仅当 JD > 0 对于 Marlin 固件时适用
如果您的 Marlin 2 打印机使用 Classic Jerk，请将此值设置为 0。）

slicing_mode.label: Slicing Mode
slicing_mode.tip: Use "Even-odd" for 3DLabPrint airplane models. Use "Close holes" to close all holes in the model.
slicing_mode.tip_zh: 对3DLabPrint的飞机模型使用 "奇偶"。使用 "闭孔 "来关闭模型上的所有孔。

fuzzy_skin.label: Fuzzy Skin
fuzzy_skin.tip: Randomly jitter while printing the wall, so that the surface has a rough look. This setting controls the fuzzy position.
fuzzy_skin.tip_zh: 打印外墙时随机抖动，使外表面产生绒效果。这个设置决定适用的位置。

fuzzy_skin_first_layer.label: Apply fuzzy skin to first layer
fuzzy_skin_first_layer.tip: Whether to apply fuzzy skin on the first layer.
fuzzy_skin_first_layer.tip_zh: 是否在第一层应用绒毛效果

fuzzy_skin_layers_between_ripple_offset.label: Layers between ripple offset
fuzzy_skin_layers_between_ripple_offset.tip:
Specifies how many consecutive layers share the same ripple phase before the offset is applied.
For example:
- 1 = Layer 1 is printed with the base ripple pattern, then layer 2 is shifted by the configured offset, then layer 3 returns to the base pattern, and so on.
- 3 = Layers 1 to 3 are printed with the base ripple pattern, then layers 4 to 6 are shifted by the configured offset, then layers 7 to 9 return to the base pattern, etc.
fuzzy_skin_layers_between_ripple_offset.tip_zh:
指定在应用偏移之前，有多少连续的层共享相同的波纹相位。
例如：
- 1 = 第 1 层以基础波纹图案打印，然后第 2 层按配置的偏移移动，然后第 3 层回到基础图案，依此类推。
- 3 = 第 1 至 3 层以基础波纹图案打印，然后第 4 至 6 层按配置的偏移移动，然后第 7 至 9 层回到基础图案，依此类推。

fuzzy_skin_mode.label: Fuzzy skin generator mode
fuzzy_skin_mode.tip:
Fuzzy skin generation mode. Works only with Arachne!
Displacement: Сlassic mode when the pattern is formed by shifting the nozzle sideways from the original path.
Extrusion: The mode when the pattern formed by the amount of extruded plastic. This is the fast and straight algorithm without unnecessary nozzle shake that gives a smooth pattern. But it is more useful for forming loose walls in the entire they array.
Combined: Joint mode [Displacement] + [Extrusion]. The appearance of the walls is similar to [Displacement] Mode, but it leaves no pores between the perimeters.

Attention! The [Extrusion] and [Combined] modes works only the fuzzy_skin_thickness parameter not more than the thickness of printed loop. At the same time, the width of the extrusion for a particular layer should also not be below a certain level. It is usually equal 15-25%% of a layer height. Therefore, the maximum fuzzy skin thickness with a perimeter width of 0.4 mm and a layer height of 0.2 mm will be 0.4-(0.2*0.25)=±0.35mm! If you enter a higher parameter than this, the error Flow::spacing() will displayed, and the model will not be sliced. You can choose this number until this error is repeated.
fuzzy_skin_mode.tip_zh:
模糊皮肤生成模式。仅适用于Arachne！
位移：经典模式，通过将喷嘴从原始路径向侧面移动来形成图案。
挤出：通过挤出塑料量而形成图案的模式。这是一种快速而直接的算法，没有不必要的喷嘴抖动，可以产生平滑的图案。但它对于在整个阵列中形成松散的墙壁更有用。
组合：联合模式【位移】+【挤压】。墙壁的外观与 [位移] 模式类似，但周边之间不留孔隙。注意！[挤出] 和 [组合] 模式仅适用于 fuzzy_skin_thickness 参数不大于打印环厚度的情况。同时，特定层的挤出宽度也不应低于一定水平。它通常等于层高的 15-25%%。因此，周宽为 0.4 mm、层高为 0.2 mm 时，最大绒毛表面厚度为 0.4-(0.2*0.25)=±0.35 mm！如果输入参数高于此值，将显示 Flow::spacing() 错误，且模型不会被切片。您可以调整该数值，直到不再重复出现该错误。

fuzzy_skin_noise_type.label: Fuzzy skin noise type
fuzzy_skin_noise_type.tip:
Noise type to use for fuzzy skin generation:
Classic: Classic uniform random noise.
Perlin: Perlin noise, which gives a more consistent texture.
Billow: Similar to perlin noise, but clumpier.
Ridged Multifractal: Ridged noise with sharp, jagged features. Creates marble-like textures.
Voronoi: Divides the surface into voronoi cells, and displaces each one by a random amount. Creates a patchwork texture.
Ripple: Uniform ripple pattern that ripples left and right of the original path. Repeating pattern, woven appearance.
fuzzy_skin_noise_type.tip_zh:
用于生成绒毛表面的噪声类型：
Classic：经典的均匀随机噪声。
Perlin：柏林噪声，可产生更一致的纹理。
Billow：类似柏林噪声，但更成团块状。
Ridged Multifractal：具有尖锐、锯齿状特征的脊状噪声。可生成大理石般的纹理。
Voronoi：将表面划分为 Voronoi 单元，并将每个单元随机位移一定量。可生成拼接状纹理。
Ripple：在原始路径左右起伏的均匀波纹图案。重复图案，呈编织外观。

fuzzy_skin_octaves.label: Fuzzy Skin Noise Octaves
fuzzy_skin_octaves.tip: The number of octaves of coherent noise to use. Higher values increase the detail of the noise, but also increase computation time.
fuzzy_skin_octaves.tip_zh: 使用的相干噪波倍频数。较高的数值会增加噪波细节，但也会增加计算时间。

fuzzy_skin_persistence.label: Fuzzy skin noise persistence
fuzzy_skin_persistence.tip: The decay rate for higher octaves of the coherent noise. Lower values will result in smoother noise.
fuzzy_skin_persistence.tip_zh: 相干噪波高倍频的衰减速率。较低的数值会产生更平滑的噪声。

fuzzy_skin_point_distance.label: Fuzzy skin point distance
fuzzy_skin_point_distance.tip: The average distance between the random points introduced on each line segment.
fuzzy_skin_point_distance.tip_zh: 产生绒毛表面时，插入的随机点之间的平均距离

fuzzy_skin_ripple_offset.label: Ripple offset
fuzzy_skin_ripple_offset.tip:
Shifts the ripple phase forward along the print path by the specified percentage of a wavelength each layer period.
- 0% keeps every layer identical.
- 50% shifts the pattern by half a wavelength, effectively inverting the phase.
- 100% shifts the pattern by a full wavelength, returning to the original phase.

The shift is applied once every number of layers set by Layers between ripple offset, so layers within the same group are printed identically.
fuzzy_skin_ripple_offset.tip_zh:
每个层周期沿打印路径将波纹相位向前移动指定百分比的波长。
- 0% 使每一层都保持相同。
- 50% 将图案移动半个波长，相当于反转相位。
- 100% 将图案移动一个完整波长，回到原始相位。

该偏移每隔“波纹偏移之间的层数”所设置的层数应用一次，因此同一组内的各层会以相同方式打印。

fuzzy_skin_ripples_per_layer.label: Number of ripples per layer
fuzzy_skin_ripples_per_layer.tip: Controls how many full cycles of ripples will be added per layer.
fuzzy_skin_ripples_per_layer.tip_zh: 控制每层添加多少个完整周期的波纹。

fuzzy_skin_scale.label: Fuzzy skin feature size
fuzzy_skin_scale.tip: The base size of the coherent noise features, in mm. Higher values will result in larger features.
fuzzy_skin_scale.tip_zh: 相干噪波特征的基础尺寸（单位：毫米）。较高的数值会产生更大的特征。

fuzzy_skin_thickness.label: Fuzzy skin thickness
fuzzy_skin_thickness.tip: The width within which to jitter. It's advised to be below outer wall line width.
fuzzy_skin_thickness.tip_zh: 产生绒毛的抖动的宽度。建议小于外圈墙的线宽。

adaptive_layer_height.label: Adaptive layer height
adaptive_layer_height.tip:
Enabling this option means the height of every layer except the first will be automatically calculated during slicing according to the slope of the model’s surface.
Note that this option only takes effect if no prime tower is generated in current plate.

bridge_flow.label: Bridge flow ratio
bridge_flow.tip:
This value governs the thickness of the external (visible) bridge layer.
Values above 1.0: Increase the amount of material while maintaining line spacing. This can improve line contact and strength.
Values below 1.0: Reduce the amount of material while adjusting line spacing to maintain contact. This can improve sagging.

The actual bridge flow used is calculated by multiplying this value with the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
bridge_flow.tip_zh:
此值控制外部（可见）桥接层的厚度。
大于 1.0 的值：在保持线间距的同时增加材料用量。这可以改善线之间的接触和强度。
小于 1.0 的值：在调整线间距以保持接触的同时减少材料用量。这可以改善下垂。

实际使用的桥接流量是将此值乘以耗材流量比，以及（如已设置）对象的流量比计算得出的。

bridge_line_width.label: Bridge
bridge_line_width.tip:
Line width of the Bridge. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over the nozzle diameter.
Recommended to use with a higher Bridge density or Bridge flow ratio.

The maximum value is 100% or the nozzle diameter.
If set to 0, the line width will match the Internal solid infill width.
bridge_line_width.tip_zh:
桥接线的线宽。如果以百分比表示，将根据喷嘴直径计算。
建议与较高的桥接密度或桥接流量比配合使用。

最大值为 100% 或喷嘴直径。
如果设置为 0，线宽将与内部实心填充宽度一致。

counterbore_hole_bridging.label: Bridge counterbore holes
counterbore_hole_bridging.tip:
This option creates bridges for counterbore holes, allowing them to be printed without support. Available modes include:
1. None: No bridge is created
2. Partially Bridged: Only a part of the unsupported area will be bridged
3. Sacrificial Layer: A full sacrificial bridge layer is created
counterbore_hole_bridging.tip_zh:
此选项为沉孔创建搭桥，使其可以在无支撑的情况下打印。可用的模式包括：
1. 无：不创建搭桥。
2. 部分搭桥：仅部分不支撑的区域将被搭桥。
3. 牺牲层：创建一个完整的牺牲层。

detect_overhang_wall.label: Detect overhang walls
detect_overhang_wall.tip: Detect the overhang percentage relative to line width and use different speed to print. For 100%% overhang, bridge speed is used.
detect_overhang_wall.tip_zh: 检测悬垂相对于线宽的百分比，并应用不同的速度打印。100%%的悬垂将使用桥接速度。

dont_filter_internal_bridges.label: Filter out small internal bridges
dont_filter_internal_bridges.tip:
This option can help reduce pillowing on top surfaces in heavily slanted or curved models.
By default, small internal bridges are filtered out and the internal solid infill is printed directly over the sparse infill. This works well in most cases, speeding up printing without too much compromise on top surface quality.
However, in heavily slanted or curved models, especially where too low a sparse infill density is used, this may result in curling of the unsupported solid infill, causing pillowing.
Enabling limited filtering or no filtering will print internal bridge layer over slightly unsupported internal solid infill. The options below control the sensitivity of the filtering, i.e. they control where internal bridges are created:
1. Filter - enables this option. This is the default behavior and works well in most cases
2. Limited filtering - creates internal bridges on heavily slanted surfaces while avoiding unnecessary bridges. This works well for most difficult models
3. No filtering - creates internal bridges on every potential internal overhang. This option is useful for heavily slanted top surface models; however, in most cases, it creates too many unnecessary bridges.
dont_filter_internal_bridges.tip_zh:
此选项可以帮助减少严重倾斜或弯曲模型顶面的枕化效应。
默认情况下，小的内部桥接被过滤掉，内部实心填充直接打印在稀疏填充上。这在大多数情况下效果良好，可以加快打印速度而不会过分影响顶面质量。
然而，在严重倾斜或弯曲的模型中，特别是当使用的稀疏填充密度过低时，这可能导致未支撑的实心填充翘曲，引起枕化效应。
启用有限过滤或不过滤将在轻微未支撑的内部实心填充上打印内部桥接层。以下选项控制过滤的灵敏度，即它们控制在哪里创建内部桥接：
1. 过滤 - 启用此选项。这是默认行为，在大多数情况下效果良好
2. 有限过滤 - 在严重倾斜的表面上创建内部桥接，同时避免不必要的桥接。这对大多数困难的模型效果良好
3. 不过滤 - 在每个潜在的内部悬垂上创建内部桥接。此选项对严重倾斜的顶面模型有用；但是，在大多数情况下，它会创建太多不必要的桥接

elefant_foot_compensation.label: Elephant foot compensation
elefant_foot_compensation.tip: Shrinks the first layer on build plate to compensate for elephant foot effect.
elefant_foot_compensation.tip_zh: 将首层收缩用于补偿象脚效应

elefant_foot_compensation_layers.label: Elephant foot compensation layers
elefant_foot_compensation_layers.tip: The number of layers on which the elephant foot compensation will be active. The first layer will be shrunk by the elephant foot compensation value, then the next layers will be linearly shrunk less, up to the layer indicated by this value.
elefant_foot_compensation_layers.tip_zh: 象脚补偿将处于活动状态的层数。第一层将按象脚补偿值缩小，然后接下来的层将线性缩小，直到该值指示的层。

elefant_foot_layers_density.label: Elephant foot layers density
elefant_foot_layers_density.tip:
Density of internal solid infill for Elephant foot layers compensation.
The initial value for the second layer is set.
Subsequent layers become linearly denser by the height specified in elefant_foot_compensation_layers.
elefant_foot_layers_density.tip_zh:
用于象脚补偿层的内部实心填充密度。
此处设置的是第二层的初始值。
后续各层会按 elefant_foot_compensation_layers 中指定的高度线性增密。

enable_extra_bridge_layer.label: Extra bridge layers (beta)
enable_extra_bridge_layer.tip:
This option enables the generation of an extra bridge layer over internal and/or external bridges.

Extra bridge layers help improve bridge appearance and reliability, as the solid infill is better supported. This is especially useful in fast printers, where the bridge and solid infill speeds vary greatly. The extra bridge layer results in reduced pillowing on top surfaces, as well as reduced separation of the external bridge layer from its surrounding perimeters.

It is generally recommended to set this to at least 'External bridge only', unless specific issues with the sliced model are found.

Options:
1. Disabled - does not generate second bridge layers. This is the default and is set for compatibility purposes
2. External bridge only - generates second bridge layers for external-facing bridges only. Please note that small bridges that are shorter or narrower than the set number of perimeters will be skipped as they would not benefit from a second bridge layer. If generated, the second bridge layer will be extruded parallel to the first bridge layer to reinforce the bridge strength
3. Internal bridge only - generates second bridge layers for internal bridges over sparse infill only. Please note that the internal bridges count towards the top shell layer count of your model. The second internal bridge layer will be extruded as close to perpendicular to the first as possible. If multiple regions in the same island, with varying bridge angles are present, the last region of that island will be selected as the angle reference
4. Apply to all - generates second bridge layers for both internal and external-facing bridges
enable_extra_bridge_layer.tip_zh:
此选项启用在内部和/或外部桥接上生成额外桥接层。

额外桥接层有助于改善桥接的外观和可靠性，因为实心填充得到了更好的支撑。这对于快速打印机特别有用，因为桥接和实心填充的速度差异很大。额外的桥接层可以减少顶面的枕化效应，同时减少外部桥接层与其周围周长的分离。

通常建议将此设置为至少'仅外部桥接'，除非发现切片模型存在特定问题。

选项：
1. 禁用 - 不生成第二桥接层。这是默认设置，出于兼容性目的而设置
2. 仅外部桥接 - 仅为面向外部的桥接生成第二桥接层。请注意，比设置的周长数更短或更窄的小桥接将被跳过，因为它们不会从第二桥接层中受益。如果生成，第二桥接层将与第一桥接层平行挤出，以增强桥接强度
3. 仅内部桥接 - 仅为稀疏填充上的内部桥接生成第二桥接层。请注意，内部桥接计入模型的顶部外壳层数。第二内部桥接层将尽可能垂直于第一层挤出。如果在同一岛屿中存在多个具有不同桥接角度的区域，则该岛屿的最后一个区域将被选为角度参考
4. 全部应用 - 为内部和面向外部的桥接生成第二桥接层

extra_perimeters_on_overhangs.label: Extra perimeters on overhangs
extra_perimeters_on_overhangs.tip: Create additional perimeter paths over steep overhangs and areas where bridges cannot be anchored.
extra_perimeters_on_overhangs.tip_zh: 在陡峭的悬垂和无法固定桥接的区域上创建额外的周长路径。

filament_ironing_flow.label: Ironing flow
filament_ironing_flow.tip: Filament-specific override for ironing flow. This allows you to customize the ironing flow for each filament type. Too high value results in overextrusion on the surface.
filament_ironing_flow.tip_zh: 针对熨烫流程的耗材特定覆盖。这使您可以为每种耗材类型定制熨烫流程。值太高会导致表面过度挤压。

filament_ironing_inset.label: Ironing inset
filament_ironing_inset.tip: Filament-specific override for ironing inset. This allows you to customize the distance to keep from the edges when ironing for each filament type.
filament_ironing_inset.tip_zh: 用于熨烫插入的耗材丝特定覆盖。这使您可以自定义熨烫每种耗材丝类型时与边缘保持的距离。

filament_ironing_spacing.label: Ironing line spacing
filament_ironing_spacing.tip: Filament-specific override for ironing line spacing. This allows you to customize the spacing between ironing lines for each filament type.
filament_ironing_spacing.tip_zh: 针对熨烫线间距的耗材特定覆盖。这使您可以自定义每种耗材类型的熨烫线之间的间距。

hole_to_polyhole.label: Convert holes to polyholes
hole_to_polyhole.tip:
Search for almost-circular holes that span more than one layer and convert the geometry to polyholes. Use the nozzle size and the (biggest) diameter to compute the polyhole.
See http://hydraraptor.blogspot.com/2011/02/polyholes.html
hole_to_polyhole.zh: 将圆孔转换为多边型孔
hole_to_polyhole.tip_zh:
搜索跨越多层的近似圆形孔，并将几何形状转换为多边形孔。使用喷嘴尺寸和（最大）直径来计算多边形孔。
参见http://hydraraptor.blogspot.com/2011/02/polyholes.html

hole_to_polyhole_threshold.label: Polyhole detection margin
hole_to_polyhole_threshold.tip:
Maximum defection of a point to the estimated radius of the circle.
As cylinders are often exported as triangles of varying size, points may not be on the circle circumference. This setting allows you some leeway to broaden the detection.
In mm or in % of the radius.
hole_to_polyhole_threshold.tip_zh:
点到圆半径的最大偏差。
由于圆柱体通常被导出为大小不同的三角形，因此点可能不在圆周上。
此设置允许您有一些余地来扩大检测范围。
以毫米或半径的百分比表示。

initial_layer_line_width.label: First layer
initial_layer_line_width.tip: Line width of the first layer. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over the nozzle diameter.
initial_layer_line_width.tip_zh: 首层的线宽。若以百分比表示（例如120%），它将基于喷嘴直径来计算。

initial_layer_min_bead_width.label: First layer minimum wall width
initial_layer_min_bead_width.tip: The minimum wall width that should be used for the first layer is recommended to be set to the same size as the nozzle. This adjustment is expected to enhance adhesion.
initial_layer_min_bead_width.tip_zh: 应用于首层的最小墙宽度，建议设置与喷嘴尺寸相同。此调整有助于增强附着力。

initial_layer_print_height.label: First layer height
initial_layer_print_height.tip: Height of the first layer. Making the first layer height thicker can improve build plate adhesion.
initial_layer_print_height.tip_zh:
首层层高。
若少许加厚首层层高，将有助增加部件与热床间的粘接力。

inner_wall_line_width.label: Inner wall
inner_wall_line_width.tip: Line width of inner wall. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over the nozzle diameter.
inner_wall_line_width.tip_zh: 内墙的线宽。如果以%表示，它将基于喷嘴直径来计算。

interface_shells.label: Interface shells
interface_shells.tip: Force the generation of solid shells between adjacent materials/volumes. Useful for multi-extruder prints with translucent materials or manual soluble support material.
interface_shells.tip_zh: 强制在相邻材料/体积之间生成实心壳。适用于使用半透明材料或手动可溶性支撑材料的多挤出机打印

internal_bridge_flow.label: Internal bridge flow ratio
internal_bridge_flow.tip:
This value governs the thickness of the internal bridge layer. This is the first layer over sparse infill so increasing it may increase strength and upper layer quality.
Values above 1.0: Increase the amount of material while maintaining line spacing. This can improve line contact and strength.
Values below 1.0: Reduce the amount of material while adjusting line spacing to maintain contact. This can improve sagging.

The actual bridge flow used is calculated by multiplying this value with the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.
internal_bridge_flow.tip_zh:
此值控制内部桥接层的厚度。这是稀疏填充上方的第一层，因此增大它可能会提升强度和上层质量。
大于 1.0 的值：在保持线间距的同时增加材料用量。这可以改善线之间的接触和强度。
小于 1.0 的值：在调整线间距以保持接触的同时减少材料用量。这可以改善下垂。

实际使用的桥接流量是将此值乘以耗材流量比，以及（如已设置）对象的流量比计算得出的。

internal_solid_infill_line_width.label: Internal solid infill
internal_solid_infill_line_width.tip: Line width of internal solid infill. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over the nozzle diameter.
internal_solid_infill_line_width.tip_zh: 内部实心填充的线宽。如果以%表示，它将基于喷嘴直径来计算。

ironing_angle.label: Ironing angle offset
ironing_angle.tip: The angle of ironing lines offset from the top surface.
ironing_angle.tip_zh: 顶面熨烫纹路的偏移角度。

ironing_angle_fixed.label: Fixed ironing angle
ironing_angle_fixed.tip: Use a fixed absolute angle for ironing.
ironing_angle_fixed.tip_zh: 使用一个固定的、绝对的角度进行熨烫。

ironing_expansion.label: Ironing expansion
ironing_expansion.tip: Expand or contract the ironing area.

ironing_flow.label: Ironing flow
ironing_flow.tip: The amount of material to extrude during ironing. Relative to flow of normal layer height. Too high value results in overextrusion on the surface.
ironing_flow.tip_zh: 熨烫时相对正常层高流量的材料量。过高的数值将会导致表面材料过挤出。

ironing_inset.label: Ironing inset
ironing_inset.tip: The distance to keep from the edges. A value of 0 sets this to half of the nozzle diameter.
ironing_inset.tip_zh: 与边缘保持的距离。0值将其设置为喷嘴直径的一半。

ironing_pattern.label: Ironing Pattern
ironing_pattern.tip: The pattern that will be used when ironing.

ironing_spacing.label: Ironing line spacing
ironing_spacing.tip: The distance between the lines of ironing.

ironing_type.label: Ironing Type
ironing_type.tip: Ironing is using small flow to print on same height of surface again to make flat surface more smooth. This setting controls which layer being ironed.
ironing_type.tip_zh: 熨烫指的是使用小流量在表面的同高度打印，进而是的平面更加光滑。这个设置用于设置哪些层进行熨烫。

is_infill_first.label: Print infill first
is_infill_first.tip:
Order of wall/infill. When the tickbox is unchecked the walls are printed first, which works best in most cases.

Printing infill first may help with extreme overhangs as the walls have the neighbouring infill to adhere to. However, the infill will slightly push out the printed walls where it is attached to them, resulting in a worse external surface finish. It can also cause the infill to shine through the external surfaces of the part.
is_infill_first.tip_zh:
墙/填充的顺序。当未启用时，首先打印墙壁，这在大多数情况下都是最好的。

首先打印填充可能有助于极端悬垂，因为墙壁有相邻的填充物可以粘附。但是，填充物会在附着在墙壁上的地方轻微地挤出打印的墙壁，导致外部表面质量更差。它还会导致填充物透过零件的外部表面。

layer_height.label: Layer height
layer_height.tip: Slicing height for each layer. Smaller layer height means more accurate and more printing time.
layer_height.tip_zh: 每一层的切片高度。越小的层高意味着更高的精度和更长的打印时间。

line_width.label: Default
line_width.tip: Default line width if other line widths are set to 0. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over the nozzle diameter.
line_width.tip_zh: 当线宽设置为0时走线的默认线宽。如果以%表示，它将基于喷嘴直径来计算。

make_overhang_printable.label: Make overhangs printable
make_overhang_printable.tip: Modify the geometry to print overhangs without support material.
make_overhang_printable.tip_zh: 修改几何形状使得悬垂部分无需支撑材料或者搭桥打印。

make_overhang_printable_angle.label: Make overhangs printable - Maximum angle
make_overhang_printable_angle.tip: Maximum angle of overhangs to allow after making more steep overhangs printable.90° will not change the model at all and allow any overhang, while 0 will replace all overhangs with conical material.
make_overhang_printable_angle.zh: 悬垂可打印化的最大角度
make_overhang_printable_angle.tip_zh: 在使悬垂可打印化后，允许的悬垂最大角度。90°将完全不改变模型并允许任何悬垂，而0°将用圆锥形材料替换所有悬垂部分。

make_overhang_printable_hole_size.label: Make overhangs printable - Hole area
make_overhang_printable_hole_size.tip: Maximum area of a hole in the base of the model before it's filled by conical material. A value of 0 will fill all the holes in the model base.
make_overhang_printable_hole_size.tip_zh: 模型底部的孔洞在被圆锥形材料填充前所允许的最大面积。值为0将填充模型底部的所有孔洞。

max_travel_detour_distance.label: Avoid crossing walls - Max detour length
max_travel_detour_distance.tip: Maximum detour distance for avoiding crossing wall. Don't detour if the detour distance is larger than this value. Detour length could be specified either as an absolute value or as percentage (for example 50%) of a direct travel path. Zero to disable.
max_travel_detour_distance.zh: 避免跨越外墙-最大绕行长度
max_travel_detour_distance.tip_zh: 避免跨越外墙时的最大绕行距离。当绕行距离比这个数值大时，此次空驶不绕行。绕行距离可表达为绝对值，或者相对直线空驶长度的百分比(例如50%)。0表示禁用

min_bead_width.label: Minimum wall width
min_bead_width.tip: Width of the wall that will replace thin features (according to the Minimum feature size) of the model. If the Minimum wall width is thinner than the thickness of the feature, the wall will become as thick as the feature itself. It's expressed as a percentage over nozzle diameter.
min_bead_width.tip_zh: 用于替换模型上的细小特征（根据最小特征尺寸决定）的墙线宽。如果最小墙宽度小于最小特征宽度，则墙将变得和特征本身一样厚。本设置以喷嘴直径的百分比表示。

min_feature_size.label: Minimum feature size
min_feature_size.tip: Minimum thickness of thin features. Model features that are thinner than this value will not be printed, while features thicker than than this value will be widened to the minimum wall width. It's expressed as a percentage over nozzle diameter.
min_feature_size.tip_zh:
薄特征的最小厚度。
比此值更薄的模型特征将不会被打印，而比此值更厚的特征将被加宽到最小墙宽。
本设置以喷嘴直径的百分比表示。

min_length_factor.label: Minimum wall length
min_length_factor.tip:
Adjust this value to prevent short, unclosed walls from being printed, which could increase print time. Higher values remove more and longer walls.

NOTE: Bottom and top surfaces will not be affected by this value to prevent visual gaps on the outside of the model. Adjust 'One wall threshold' in the Advanced settings below to adjust the sensitivity of what is considered a top-surface. 'One wall threshold' is only visible if this setting is set above the default value of 0.5, or if single-wall top surfaces is enabled.
min_length_factor.tip_zh:
调整这个值以略过短的、未闭合的墙，因为这些墙可能会增加打印耗时。设置较高的值将移除更多和更长的墙。

请注意：底面和顶面将不受此值的影响，原因是防止模型外部出现可见缝隙。调整下方高级设置中的 “单层墙阈值” 来调整判断顶面的灵敏度。只有当此设置高于默认值的0.5、或启用了单层顶面时，“单层墙阈值”才会显示。

min_width_top_surface.label: One wall threshold
min_width_top_surface.tip:
If a top surface has to be printed and it's partially covered by another layer, it won't be considered at a top layer where its width is below this value. This can be useful to not let the 'one perimeter on top' trigger on surface that should be covered only by perimeters. This value can be a mm or a % of the perimeter extrusion width.
Warning: If enabled, artifacts can be created if you have some thin features on the next layer, like letters. Set this setting to 0 to remove these artifacts.
min_width_top_surface.tip_zh:
如果顶面需要打印，但是它的一部分被其它层覆盖，那么当它的宽度小于这个值时，它不会被认为是顶层。这个设置可以用于避免在狭窄顶面上触发“顶面单层墙”。这个值可以是毫米或线宽的百分比。
警告：如果启用，可能会在下一层上产生一些薄的特征，比如字母。将此设置设置为0可以消除这些伪影。

only_one_wall_first_layer.label: Only one wall on first layer
only_one_wall_first_layer.tip: Use only one wall on first layer, to give more space to the bottom infill pattern.
only_one_wall_first_layer.tip_zh: 首层只使用单层墙，从而更多的空间能够使用底部填充图案

only_one_wall_top.label: Only one wall on top surfaces
only_one_wall_top.tip: Use only one wall on flat top surfaces, to give more space to the top infill pattern.
only_one_wall_top.tip_zh: 顶面只使用单层墙，从而更多的空间能够使用顶部填充图案

other_layers_sequence_choice.label: Other layers filament sequence
other_layers_sequence_choice.zh: 其他层的耗材打印顺序

outer_wall_line_width.label: Outer wall
outer_wall_line_width.tip: Line width of outer wall. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over the nozzle diameter.
outer_wall_line_width.tip_zh: 外墙的线宽。如果以%表示，它将基于喷嘴直径来计算

overhang_reverse.label: Reverse on even
overhang_reverse.tip:
Extrude perimeters that have a part over an overhang in the reverse direction on even layers. This alternating pattern can drastically improve steep overhangs.

This setting can also help reduce part warping due to the reduction of stresses in the part walls.
overhang_reverse.tip_zh:
在偶数层上，将悬垂部分的走线反转。这种交替的走线模式可以大大改善陡峭的悬垂。

这个设置也可以帮助减少零件变形，因为零件墙壁的应力减少了。

overhang_reverse_internal_only.label: Reverse only internal perimeters
overhang_reverse_internal_only.tip:
Apply the reverse perimeters logic only on internal perimeters.

This setting greatly reduces part stresses as they are now distributed in alternating directions. This should reduce part warping while also maintaining external wall quality. This feature can be very useful for warp prone material, like ABS/ASA, and also for elastic filaments, like TPU and Silk PLA. It can also help reduce warping on floating regions over supports.

For this setting to be the most effective, it is recommended to set the Reverse Threshold to 0 so that all internal walls print in alternating directions on even layers irrespective of their overhang degree.
overhang_reverse_internal_only.tip_zh:
仅在内墙上应用反转墙壁逻辑。

这个设置大大减少了零件的应力，因为它们现在是交替方向分布的。这应该减少零件变形，同时保持外墙的质量。这个功能对于易变形的材料非常有用，比如ABS/ASA，也对于弹性耗材，比如TPU和丝光PLA。它还可以帮助减少支撑上的悬垂区域的变形。

为了使这个设置最有效，建议将反转阈值设置为0，这样所有的内墙都会在偶数层交替打印。

overhang_reverse_threshold.label: Reverse threshold
overhang_reverse_threshold.tip:
Number of mm the overhang need to be for the reversal to be considered useful. Can be a % of the perimeter width.
Value 0 enables reversal on every even layers regardless.
When Detect overhang wall is not enabled, this option is ignored and reversal happens on every even layers regardless.
overhang_reverse_threshold.tip_zh:
判定悬垂反转需要的值（毫米），可以是线宽的百分比。
值0表示在每个偶数层上都启用反转。
当未启用检测悬垂时，此选项将被忽略，反转将在每个偶数层上发生。

precise_outer_wall.label: Precise wall
precise_outer_wall.tip: Improve shell precision by adjusting outer wall spacing. This also improves layer consistency. NOTE: This option will be ignored for outer-inner or inner-outer-inner wall sequences.
precise_outer_wall.tip_zh: 通过调整墙壁间距来提高外墙精度，同时改善层间一致性。注意：当壁序列为外内或内外内时，此选项将被忽略。

precise_z_height.label: Precise Z height
precise_z_height.tip: Enable this to get precise Z height of object after slicing. It will get the precise object height by fine-tuning the layer heights of the last few layers. Note that this is an experimental parameter.
precise_z_height.tip_zh: 开启这个设置，对象在切片后将得到精准的 Z 高度。此命令将微调对象最终数层的层高，以确保对象 Z 高度精准。请注意：此选项尚为实验性参数。

print_flow_ratio.label: Flow ratio
print_flow_ratio.tip:
The material may have volumetric change after switching between molten and crystalline states. This setting changes all extrusion flow of this filament in G-code proportionally. The recommended value range is between 0.95 and 1.05. You may be able to tune this value to get a nice flat surface if there is slight overflow or underflow.

The final object flow ratio is this value multiplied by the filament flow ratio.
print_flow_ratio.tip_zh:
材料在熔融和结晶状态之间切换后可能会发生体积变化。此设置会等比例改变此耗材在G-code中的所有挤出流量。推荐值范围在0.95到1.05之间。如果存在轻微的溢出或欠流，您可以调整此值以获得平整的表面。

最终的对象流量比率是此值乘以耗材流量比率。

reduce_crossing_wall.label: Avoid crossing walls
reduce_crossing_wall.tip: Detour to avoid traveling across walls, which may cause blobs on the surface.
reduce_crossing_wall.tip_zh: 空驶时绕过外墙以避免在模型外观面产生斑点

scarf_angle_threshold.label: Conditional angle threshold
scarf_angle_threshold.tip:
This option sets the threshold angle for applying a conditional scarf joint seam.
If the maximum angle within the perimeter loop exceeds this value (indicating the absence of sharp corners), a scarf joint seam will be used. The default value is 155°.
scarf_angle_threshold.tip_zh:
此选项设置判断是否应用斜拼接缝的角度阈值。
如果围墙环内的最大角度超过了这个值（表示没有足够锐的角），则使用斜拼接缝接缝。默认值为155°。

scarf_joint_flow_ratio.label: Scarf joint flow ratio
scarf_joint_flow_ratio.tip: This factor affects the amount of material for scarf joints.
scarf_joint_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 这个参数影响斜拼接缝的材料用量。

scarf_joint_speed.label: Scarf joint speed
scarf_joint_speed.tip: This option sets the printing speed for scarf joints. It is recommended to print scarf joints at a slow speed (less than 100 mm/s). It's also advisable to enable 'Extrusion rate smoothing' if the set speed varies significantly from the speed of the outer or inner walls. If the speed specified here is higher than the speed of the outer or inner walls, the printer will default to the slower of the two speeds. When specified as a percentage (e.g., 80%), the speed is calculated based on the respective outer or inner wall speed. The default value is set to 100%.
scarf_joint_speed.tip_zh: 这个选项设置斜拼接缝的打印速度。建议以较慢的速度（小于100mm/s）打印斜拼接缝。如果设置的速度与外墙或内墙的速度相差较大，建议启用“平滑挤出率”。如果此处指定的速度高于外墙或内墙的速度，则打印机将默认使用两者中较慢的速度。当以百分比（例如80%）指定时，速度将基于外墙或内墙的速度进行计算。默认值为100%。

scarf_overhang_threshold.label: Conditional overhang threshold
scarf_overhang_threshold.tip: This option determines the overhang threshold for the application of scarf joint seams. If the unsupported portion of the perimeter is less than this threshold, scarf joint seams will be applied. The default threshold is set at 40% of the external wall's width. Due to performance considerations, the degree of overhang is estimated.
scarf_overhang_threshold.tip_zh: 此选项设置斜拼接缝应用的悬垂阈值。如果围墙的未支撑部分小于此阈值，则应用斜拼接缝接缝。默认阈值设置为外墙宽度的40%。由于性能考虑，悬垂程度是粗略估算。

seam_gap.label: Seam gap
seam_gap.tip:
In order to reduce the visibility of the seam in a closed loop extrusion, the loop is interrupted and shortened by a specified amount.
This amount can be specified in millimeters or as a percentage of the current extruder diameter. The default value for this parameter is 10%.
seam_gap.tip_zh:
为了减少环形中接缝的可见性，环会被打断并按指定数量缩短。数值可用毫米指定，也可以使用当前挤出机直径的百分比来指定。
默认值为 10%

seam_position.label: Seam position
seam_position.tip: The start position to print each part of outer wall.

seam_slope_conditional.label: Conditional scarf joint
seam_slope_conditional.tip: Apply scarf joints only to smooth perimeters where traditional seams do not conceal the seams at sharp corners effectively.
seam_slope_conditional.tip_zh: 当墙壁没有合适的锐角以至于传统接缝无法有效隐藏的时候使用斜拼接缝。

seam_slope_entire_loop.label: Scarf around entire wall
seam_slope_entire_loop.tip: The scarf extends to the entire length of the wall.
seam_slope_entire_loop.tip_zh: 将斜拼接缝延伸到整个围墙

seam_slope_inner_walls.label: Scarf joint for inner walls
seam_slope_inner_walls.tip: Use scarf joint for inner walls as well.
seam_slope_inner_walls.tip_zh: 同时应用斜拼接缝于内墙

seam_slope_min_length.label: Scarf length
seam_slope_min_length.tip: Length of the scarf. Setting this parameter to zero effectively disables the scarf.
seam_slope_min_length.tip_zh: 斜拼接缝的长度。长度为0时会禁用斜拼接缝

seam_slope_start_height.label: Scarf start height
seam_slope_start_height.tip:
Start height of the scarf.
This amount can be specified in millimeters or as a percentage of the current layer height. The default value for this parameter is 0.
seam_slope_start_height.tip_zh:
斜拼接缝的起始高度。
这个数值可以用毫米或者当前层高的百分比表示。默认值为0。

seam_slope_steps.label: Scarf steps
seam_slope_steps.tip: Minimum number of segments of each scarf.
seam_slope_steps.tip_zh: 斜拼接缝所需的最少段数

seam_slope_type.label: Scarf joint seam (beta)
seam_slope_type.tip: Use scarf joint to minimize seam visibility and increase seam strength.
seam_slope_type.tip_zh: 使用斜拼接缝来最小化接缝的可见性并增加接缝的强度。

slice_closing_radius.label: Slice gap closing radius
slice_closing_radius.tip: Cracks smaller than 2x gap closing radius are being filled during the triangle mesh slicing. The gap closing operation may reduce the final print resolution, therefore it is advisable to keep the value reasonably low.
slice_closing_radius.tip_zh: 在三角形网格切片过程中，小于2倍间隙闭合半径的裂纹将被填充。间隙闭合操作可能会降低最终打印分辨率，因此建议降值保持在合理的较低水平

small_area_infill_flow_compensation.label: Small area flow compensation (beta)
small_area_infill_flow_compensation.tip: Enable flow compensation for small infill areas.
small_area_infill_flow_compensation.zh: 小区域填充流量补偿（试验）
small_area_infill_flow_compensation.tip_zh: 启用小区域填充的流量补偿

sparse_infill_line_width.label: Sparse infill
sparse_infill_line_width.tip: Line width of internal sparse infill. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over the nozzle diameter.
sparse_infill_line_width.tip_zh: 内部稀疏填充的线宽。如果以%表示，它将基于喷嘴直径来计算。

staggered_inner_seams.label: Staggered inner seams
staggered_inner_seams.tip: This option causes the inner seams to be shifted backwards based on their depth, forming a zigzag pattern.
staggered_inner_seams.tip_zh: 此选项会根据内墙深度使接缝向后移动，形成锯齿形模式。

support_line_width.label: Support
support_line_width.tip: Line width of support. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over the nozzle diameter.
support_line_width.tip_zh: 支撑的线宽。如果以%表示，它将基于喷嘴直径来计算。

thick_bridges.label: Thick external bridges
thick_bridges.tip:
If enabled, bridge extrusion uses a line height equal to the nozzle diameter.
This increases bridge strength and reliability, allowing longer spans, but may worsen appearance.
If disabled, bridges may look better but are generally reliable only for shorter spans.
thick_bridges.tip_zh:
如果启用，桥接挤出将使用等于喷嘴直径的线高。
这会增加桥接的强度和可靠性，允许更长的跨度，但可能使外观变差。
如果禁用，桥接可能看起来更好，但通常只在较短的跨度上才可靠。

thick_internal_bridges.label: Thick internal bridges
thick_internal_bridges.tip:
If enabled, internal bridge extrusion uses a line height equal to the nozzle diameter.
This increases internal bridge strength and reliability when printed over sparse infill, but may worsen appearance.
If disabled, internal bridges may look better but can be less reliable over sparse infill.
thick_internal_bridges.tip_zh:
如果启用，内部桥接挤出将使用等于喷嘴直径的线高。
这会在稀疏填充上方打印时增加内部桥接的强度和可靠性，但可能使外观变差。
如果禁用，内部桥接可能看起来更好，但在稀疏填充上方的可靠性可能较低。

top_surface_line_width.label: Top surface
top_surface_line_width.tip: Line width for top surfaces. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over the nozzle diameter.
top_surface_line_width.tip_zh: 顶面的线宽。如果以 % 表示，它将基于喷嘴直径来计算。

tree_support_auto_brim.label: Auto brim width
tree_support_auto_brim.tip: Enabling this option means the width of the brim for tree support will be automatically calculated.
tree_support_auto_brim.tip_zh: 启用此选项意味着树状支撑的裙边宽度将自动计算自动计算

tree_support_brim_width.label: Tree support brim width
tree_support_brim_width.tip: Distance from tree branch to the outermost brim line.
tree_support_brim_width.tip_zh: 从树状支撑分支到最外层裙边线的距离

wall_direction.label: Wall loop direction
wall_direction.tip:
The direction which the contour wall loops are extruded when looking down from the top.
Holes are printed in the opposite direction to the contour to maintain alignment with layers whose contour polygons are incomplete and change direction, also partially forming the contour of a hole.

This option will be disabled if spiral vase mode is enabled.
wall_direction.tip_zh:
从上往下看时，轮廓墙环的挤出方向。
孔洞以与轮廓相反的方向打印，以便与那些轮廓多边形不完整、会改变方向（同时也部分构成孔洞轮廓）的层保持对齐。

如果启用了螺旋花瓶模式，此选项将被禁用。

wall_distribution_count.label: Wall distribution count
wall_distribution_count.tip: The number of walls, counted from the center, over which the variation needs to be spread. Lower values mean that the outer walls don't change in width.
wall_distribution_count.tip_zh: 从中心开始计算的墙层数，线宽变化需要分布在这些墙走线上。较低的数值意味着外墙宽度更不易被改变。

wall_generator.label: Wall generator
wall_generator.tip: Classic wall generator produces walls with constant extrusion width and for very thin areas is used gap-fill. Arachne engine produces walls with variable extrusion width.
wall_generator.tip_zh: 经典墙生成器产生的墙走线具有一致的挤出宽度，对狭窄区域使用填缝。Arachne引擎则产生变线宽的墙走线

wall_maximum_deviation.label: Maximum wall deviation
wall_maximum_deviation.tip: The maximum deviation allowed when reducing the resolution for the 'Maximum wall resolution' setting. If you increase this, the print will be less accurate, but the G-Code will be smaller. 'Maximum wall deviation' limits 'Maximum wall resolution', so if the two conflict, 'Maximum wall deviation' takes precedence.
wall_maximum_deviation.tip_zh: 在为“最大墙体分辨率”设置降低分辨率时所允许的最大偏差。如果增大此值，打印精度会降低，但 G-code 会更小。“最大墙体偏差”会限制“最大墙体分辨率”，因此当两者冲突时，以“最大墙体偏差”为准。

wall_maximum_resolution.label: Maximum wall resolution
wall_maximum_resolution.tip: This value determines the smallest wall line segment length in mm. The smaller you set this value, the more accurate and precise the walls will be.
wall_maximum_resolution.tip_zh: 此值决定墙体线段的最小长度（毫米）。此值设置得越小，墙体就越精确。

wall_sequence.label: Walls printing order
wall_sequence.tip:
Print sequence of the internal (inner) and external (outer) walls.

Use Inner/Outer for best overhangs. This is because the overhanging walls can adhere to a neighbouring perimeter while printing. However, this option results in slightly reduced surface quality as the external perimeter is deformed by being squashed to the internal perimeter.

Use Inner/Outer/Inner for the best external surface finish and dimensional accuracy as the external wall is printed undisturbed from an internal perimeter. However, overhang performance will reduce as there is no internal perimeter to print the external wall against. This option requires a minimum of 3 walls to be effective as it prints the internal walls from the 3rd perimeter onwards first, then the external perimeter and, finally, the first internal perimeter. This option is recommended against the Outer/Inner option in most cases.

Use Outer/Inner for the same external wall quality and dimensional accuracy benefits of Inner/Outer/Inner option. However, the Z seams will appear less consistent as the first extrusion of a new layer starts on a visible surface.
wall_sequence.tip_zh:
内墙和外墙的打印顺序。

使用内墙/外墙以获得最佳悬垂效果。这是因为在打印时，悬垂的墙可以粘附到相邻的围墙上。但是，这个选项会导致外墙的表面质量稍微降低，因为外墙被内墙挤压。

使用内墙/外墙/内墙以获得最佳的外部表面质量和尺寸精度，因为外墙不会受内墙的影响但是，悬垂性能会降低，因为没有内墙来支撑打印外墙。此选项要求至少3层墙壁才能生效，因为它首先从第3个墙壁开始打印内墙，然后是外墙，最后是第一个内墙。在大多数情况下，此选项建议使用而不是外/内选项。

使用外/内以获得与内/外/内选项相同的外部墙质量和尺寸精度优势。但是，由于新层的第一次挤出是在可见表面上开始的，因此z缝隙看起来不那么一致。

wall_transition_angle.label: Wall transitioning threshold angle
wall_transition_angle.tip: When to create transitions between even and odd numbers of walls. A wedge shape with an angle greater than this setting will not have transitions and no walls will be printed in the center to fill the remaining space. Reducing this setting reduces the number and length of these center walls, but may leave gaps or overextrude.
wall_transition_angle.tip_zh: 决定何时在偶数和奇数墙层数之间创建过渡段。角度大于这个阈值的楔形将不创建过渡段，且不会在楔形中心打印墙走线以填补空间。减小这个数值能减少中心墙走线的数量和长度，但可能会导致间隙或者过挤出。

wall_transition_filter_deviation.label: Wall transitioning filter margin
wall_transition_filter_deviation.tip: Prevent transitioning back and forth between one extra wall and one less. This margin extends the range of extrusion widths which follow to [Minimum wall width - margin, 2 * Minimum wall width + margin]. Increasing this margin reduces the number of transitions, which reduces the number of extrusion starts/stops and travel time. However, large extrusion width variation can lead to under- or overextrusion problems. It's expressed as a percentage over nozzle diameter.
wall_transition_filter_deviation.tip_zh: 防止墙层数的变化规律在增加和减少之间来回转换。这个参数将挤出宽度的范围扩大到[墙最小宽度-参数值, 2*墙最小宽度+参数值]。增大参数可以减少转换的次数，从而减少挤出开始/停止和空驶的时间。然而，大的挤出宽度变化会导致过挤出或欠挤出的问题。参数值表示为相对于喷嘴直径的百分比

wall_transition_length.label: Wall transition length
wall_transition_length.tip: When transitioning between different numbers of walls as the part becomes thinner, a certain amount of space is allotted to split or join the wall segments. It's expressed as a percentage over nozzle diameter.
wall_transition_length.tip_zh: 当零件逐渐变薄导致墙的层数发生变化时，需要在过渡段分配一定的空间来分割和连接墙走线。参数值表示为相对于喷嘴直径的百分比

wipe_before_external_loop.label: Wipe before external loop
wipe_before_external_loop.tip:
To minimize visibility of potential overextrusion at the start of an external perimeter when printing with Outer/Inner or Inner/Outer/Inner wall print order, the de-retraction is performed slightly on the inside from the start of the external perimeter. That way any potential over extrusion is hidden from the outside surface.

This is useful when printing with Outer/Inner or Inner/Outer/Inner wall print order as in these modes it is more likely an external perimeter is printed immediately after a de-retraction move.
wipe_before_external_loop.zh: 额外的外墙打印前擦拭
wipe_before_external_loop.tip_zh:
为了最大限度地减少在使用外/内或内/外/内墙打印顺序时，外墙起始处的潜在过挤出，在外墙起始处外略微向内执行回填。这样，任何潜在的过挤都会隐藏在外表面之下。

当使用外/内或内/外/内墙打印顺序时，这是有用的，因为在这些模式中，外墙可能会在回填移动之后立即打印。

wipe_on_loops.label: Wipe on loops
wipe_on_loops.tip: To minimize the visibility of the seam in a closed loop extrusion, a small inward movement is executed before the extruder leaves the loop.
wipe_on_loops.tip_zh: 为了最大限度地减少闭环挤出中接缝的可见性，在挤出机离开环之前，会向内执行一个小小的移动。

xy_contour_compensation.label: X-Y contour compensation
xy_contour_compensation.tip: Contours of objects will expand or contract in the XY plane by the configured value. Positive values make contours bigger, negative values make contours smaller. This function is used to adjust sizes slightly when the objects have assembling issues.
xy_contour_compensation.tip_zh: 物体的外轮廓将在XY平面内根据配置值进行扩展或收缩。正值使轮廓变大，负值使轮廓变小。此功能用于在物体出现装配问题时微调尺寸。

xy_hole_compensation.label: X-Y hole compensation
xy_hole_compensation.tip: Holes in objects will expand or contract in the XY plane by the configured value. Positive values make holes bigger, negative values make holes smaller. This function is used to adjust sizes slightly when the objects have assembling issues.
xy_hole_compensation.tip_zh: 物体中的孔洞将在XY平面内根据配置值进行扩展或收缩。正值使孔洞变大，负值使孔洞变小。此功能用于在物体出现装配问题时微调尺寸。

zaa_dont_alternate_fill_direction.label: Don't alternate fill direction
zaa_dont_alternate_fill_direction.tip: Disable alternating fill direction when using Z contouring.
zaa_dont_alternate_fill_direction.tip_zh: 在使用 Z 层抗锯齿时禁用交替填充方向。

zaa_enabled.label: Z contouring enabled
zaa_enabled.zh: 启用 Z 层抗锯齿
zaa_enabled.tip_zh: 启用 Z 层轮廓（也称 Z 层抗锯齿）。

zaa_min_z.label: Minimum Z height
zaa_min_z.tip:
Minimum Z-layer height.
Also controls the slicing plane.
zaa_min_z.tip_zh:
最小 Z 层高。
同时控制切片平面。

zaa_minimize_perimeter_height.label: Minimize wall height angle
zaa_minimize_perimeter_height.tip:
Reduce the height of top-surface perimeters to match the model edge height.
Affects perimeters with a slope less than this angle (degrees).
A reasonable value is 35. Set to 0 to disable.
zaa_minimize_perimeter_height.tip_zh:
降低顶面墙壁的高度，使其与模型边缘高度相匹配。
影响坡度小于此角度（度）的墙壁。
合理的取值为 35。设置为 0 以禁用。

accel_to_decel_enable.label: Enable accel_to_decel
accel_to_decel_enable.tip: Klipper's max_accel_to_decel will be adjusted automatically.

accel_to_decel_factor.label: accel_to_decel
accel_to_decel_factor.tip: Klipper's max_accel_to_decel will be adjusted to this %% of acceleration.
accel_to_decel_factor.tip_zh: Klipper固件的max_accel_to_decel将被调整为该加速度的百分比。

bridge_acceleration.label: Bridge
bridge_acceleration.tip: Acceleration of bridges. If the value is expressed as a percentage (e.g. 50%), it will be calculated based on the outer wall acceleration.
bridge_acceleration.tip_zh: 桥接加速度。如果该值以百分比（例如50%）表示，则将根据外墙加速度进行计算。

bridge_speed.label: External
bridge_speed.tip:
Speed of the externally visible bridge extrusions.

In addition, if Slow down for curled perimeters is disabled or Classic overhang mode is enabled, it will be the print speed of overhang walls that are supported by less than 13%, whether they are part of a bridge or an overhang.
bridge_speed.tip_zh:
外部可见桥接挤出的速度。

此外，如果禁用翘曲周长减速或启用经典悬垂模式，它将是支撑少于13%的悬垂墙的打印速度，无论它们是桥接还是悬垂的一部分。

default_acceleration.label: Normal printing
default_acceleration.tip: The default acceleration of both normal printing and travel except initial layer.
default_acceleration.tip_zh: 除首层之外的默认的打印和空驶的加速度

default_junction_deviation.label: Junction Deviation
default_junction_deviation.tip: Marlin Firmware Junction Deviation (replaces the traditional XY Jerk setting).
default_junction_deviation.tip_zh: Marlin 固件连接偏差（取代传统的 XY Jerk 设置）。

enable_overhang_speed.label: Slow down for overhang
enable_overhang_speed.tip: Enable this option to slow printing down for different overhang degree.
enable_overhang_speed.tip_zh: 启用此选项将降低不同悬垂程度的走线的打印速度

filament_ironing_speed.label: Ironing speed
filament_ironing_speed.tip: Filament-specific override for ironing speed. This allows you to customize the print speed of ironing lines for each filament type.
filament_ironing_speed.tip_zh: 特定于耗材的熨烫速度优先。这允许您自定义每种耗材丝类型的熨烫线的打印速度。

gap_infill_speed.label: Gap infill
gap_infill_speed.tip: Speed of gap infill. Gap usually has irregular line width and should be printed more slowly.
gap_infill_speed.tip_zh: 填缝的速度。缝隙通常有不一致的线宽，应改用较慢速度打印。

initial_layer_acceleration.label: First layer
initial_layer_acceleration.tip: Acceleration of the first layer. Using a lower value can improve build plate adhesion.
initial_layer_acceleration.tip_zh: 首层加速度。使用较低值可以改善和打印板的粘接。

initial_layer_travel_speed.label: First layer travel speed
initial_layer_travel_speed.tip: Travel speed of the first layer.

inner_wall_acceleration.label: Inner wall
inner_wall_acceleration.tip_zh: 内圈墙加速度，使用较低值可以改善质量。

internal_bridge_speed.label: Internal
internal_bridge_speed.tip: Speed of internal bridges. If the value is expressed as a percentage, it will be calculated based on the bridge_speed. Default value is 150%.
internal_bridge_speed.tip_zh: 内部桥接的速度。如果该值以百分比表示，将基于桥接速度计算。默认值为150%。

internal_solid_infill_acceleration.label: Internal solid infill
internal_solid_infill_acceleration.tip: Acceleration of internal solid infill. If the value is expressed as a percentage (e.g. 100%), it will be calculated based on the default acceleration.
internal_solid_infill_acceleration.tip_zh: 内部实心填充的加速度。如果该值以百分比表示（例如100%），则将根据默认加速度进行计算。

internal_solid_infill_speed.label: Internal solid infill
internal_solid_infill_speed.tip: Speed of internal solid infill, not the top and bottom surface.
internal_solid_infill_speed.tip_zh: 内部实心填充的速度，不是顶面和底面。

outer_wall_acceleration.label: Outer wall
outer_wall_acceleration.tip: Acceleration of outer wall. Using a lower value can improve quality.
outer_wall_acceleration.tip_zh: 外墙加速度。使用较小的值可以提高质量。

outer_wall_speed.label: Outer wall
outer_wall_speed.tip: Speed of outer wall which is outermost and visible. It's used to be slower than inner wall speed to get better quality.
outer_wall_speed.tip_zh: 外墙的打印速度。它通常使用比内壁速度慢的速度，以获得更好的质量。

overhang_1_4_speed.tip: Speed for line of wall which has degree of overhang between 10% and 25% line width. 0 means using original wall speed.

overhang_2_4_speed.tip: Speed for line of wall which has degree of overhang between 25% and 50% line width. 0 means using original wall speed.

overhang_3_4_speed.tip: Speed for line of wall which has degree of overhang between 50% and 75% line width. 0 means using original wall speed.

overhang_4_4_speed.tip: Speed for line of wall which has degree of overhang between 75% and 100% line width. 0 means using original wall speed.

role_based_wipe_speed.label: Role base wipe speed
role_based_wipe_speed.tip: The wipe speed is determined by the speed of the current extrusion role. e.g. if a wipe action is executed immediately following an outer wall extrusion, the speed of the outer wall extrusion will be utilized for the wipe action.
role_based_wipe_speed.tip_zh: 擦拭速度由当前挤出类型的速度决定。例如，如果擦拭动作紧随外墙，擦拭速度将使用外墙的速度。

slow_down_layers.label: Number of slow layers
slow_down_layers.tip: The first few layers are printed slower than normal. The speed is gradually increased in a linear fashion over the specified number of layers.
slow_down_layers.tip_zh:
减慢前几层的打印速度。
打印速度会在这个范围内以线性方式逐层加至满速。

slowdown_for_curled_perimeters.label: Slow down for curled perimeters
slowdown_for_curled_perimeters.tip:
Enable this option to slow down printing in areas where perimeters may have curled upwards.
For example, additional slowdown will be applied when printing overhangs on sharp corners like the front of the Benchy hull, reducing curling which compounds over multiple layers.

It is generally recommended to have this option switched on unless your printer cooling is powerful enough or the print speed is slow enough that perimeter curling does not happen. 
If printing with a high external perimeter speed, this parameter may introduce wall artifacts when slowing down, due to the potentially large variance in print speeds causing the extruder to be unable to keep up with the requested flow change.
Root cause of these artifacts is most likely PA tuning being slightly off, especially when combined with a high PA smooth time.

Recommendations when enabling this option:
1. Reduce Pressure Advance smooth time to 0.015 - 0.02 so the extruder reacts quickly to the speed changes.
2. Increase the minimum print speeds to limit the magnitude of the slowdown and reduce the variance between fast and slow segments.
3. If artifacts still appear, enable Extrusion Rate Smoothing (ERS) to further smooth the flow transitions.

Note: When this option is enabled, overhang perimeters are treated like overhangs, meaning the overhang speed is applied even if the overhanging perimeter is part of a bridge.
For example, when the perimeters are 100% overhanging, with no wall supporting them from underneath, the 100% overhang speed will be applied.
slowdown_for_curled_perimeters.tip_zh:
启用此选项可在墙壁可能向上翘曲的区域降低打印速度。
例如，在打印诸如 Benchy 船头这类尖角处的悬垂时，会施加额外的减速，从而减少在多层中逐渐累积的翘曲。

通常建议开启此选项，除非您的打印机冷却足够强劲，或打印速度足够慢，以至于不会发生墙壁翘曲。
如果以较高的外墙速度打印，此参数在减速时可能会引入墙面瑕疵，因为打印速度的差异可能过大，导致挤出机无法跟上所需的流量变化。
这些瑕疵的根本原因很可能是压力提前 (PA) 调校略有偏差，尤其是在搭配较长的 PA 平滑时间时。

启用此选项时的建议：
1. 将压力提前的平滑时间降低到 0.015 - 0.02，使挤出机能够快速响应速度变化。
2. 提高最低打印速度，以限制减速的幅度并减小快慢段之间的差异。
3. 如果仍出现瑕疵，启用挤出速率平滑 (ERS) 以进一步平滑流量过渡。

注意：启用此选项后，悬垂墙壁会被当作悬垂处理，这意味着即使悬垂墙壁是桥接的一部分，也会应用悬垂速度。
例如，当墙壁 100% 悬垂、下方没有墙壁支撑时，将应用 100% 悬垂速度。

small_perimeter_speed.label: Small perimeters
small_perimeter_speed.tip: This separate setting will affect the speed of perimeters having radius <= small_perimeter_threshold (usually holes). If expressed as percentage (for example: 80%) it will be calculated on the outer wall speed setting above. Set to zero for auto.
small_perimeter_speed.tip_zh: 此设置将影响半径小于等于small_perimeter_threshold（通常是孔洞）的围墙的速度。如果以百分比表示（例如：80%），则将根据上面的外壁速度设置进行计算。设置为零时为自动。

small_perimeter_threshold.label: Small perimeters threshold
small_perimeter_threshold.tip: This sets the threshold for small perimeter length. Default threshold is 0mm.
small_perimeter_threshold.tip_zh: 这将设置微小部位周长的阈值。默认阈值为0mm

sparse_infill_acceleration.label: Sparse infill
sparse_infill_acceleration.tip: Acceleration of sparse infill. If the value is expressed as a percentage (e.g. 100%), it will be calculated based on the default acceleration.
sparse_infill_acceleration.tip_zh: 稀疏填充的加速度。如果该值表示为百分比（例如100%），则将根据默认加速度进行计算。

sparse_infill_speed.label: Sparse infill
sparse_infill_speed.tip_zh: 内部稀疏填充的打印速度

top_surface_acceleration.label: Top surface
top_surface_acceleration.tip: Acceleration of top surface infill. Using a lower value may improve top surface quality.
top_surface_acceleration.tip_zh: 顶面填充的加速度。使用较低值可能会改善顶面质量

top_surface_speed.label: Top surface
top_surface_speed.tip: Speed of top surface infill which is solid.

wipe_speed.label: Wipe speed
wipe_speed.tip: The wipe speed is determined by the speed setting specified in this configuration. If the value is expressed as a percentage (e.g. 80%), it will be calculated based on the travel speed setting above. The default value for this parameter is 80%.
wipe_speed.tip_zh: 擦拭速度是根据此配置中指定的速度设置确定的。如果该值以百分比形式表示（例如80%），则将根据上方的移动速度设置进行计算。该参数的默认值为80%。

align_infill_direction_to_model.label: Align infill direction to model
align_infill_direction_to_model.tip:
Aligns infill, bridge, ironing and surface fill directions to follow the model's orientation on the build plate.
When enabled, directions rotate with the model to maintain optimal strength characteristics.
align_infill_direction_to_model.tip_zh:
使填充、桥接、熨烫和表面填充的方向跟随模型在打印板上的朝向。
启用后，这些方向会随模型一起旋转，以保持最佳的强度特性。

alternate_extra_wall.label: Alternate extra wall
alternate_extra_wall.tip:
This setting adds an extra wall to every other layer. This way the infill gets wedged vertically between the walls, resulting in stronger prints.

When this option is enabled, the ensure vertical shell thickness option needs to be disabled.

Using lightning infill together with this option is not recommended as there is limited infill to anchor the extra perimeters to.
alternate_extra_wall.tip_zh:
此设置在每隔一层添加一层额外的内墙。这样，填充物就会垂直地夹在墙壁之间，从而产生更牢固的打印件。

启用此选项时，需要禁用确保垂直壳厚度选项。

不建议将闪电填充与此选项一起使用，因为填充物有限，无法将额外的壁厚固定在填充物上。

bottom_shell_layers.label: Bottom shell layers
bottom_shell_layers.tip: This is the number of solid layers of bottom shell, including the bottom surface layer. When the thickness calculated by this value is thinner than bottom shell thickness, the bottom shell layers will be increased.
bottom_shell_layers.tip_zh: 底部壳体实心层层数，包括底面。当由该层数计算的厚度小于底部壳体厚度，切片时会增加底部壳体的层数

bottom_shell_thickness.label: Bottom shell thickness
bottom_shell_thickness.tip: The number of bottom solid layers is increased when slicing if the thickness calculated by bottom shell layers is thinner than this value. This can avoid having too thin shell when layer height is small. 0 means that this setting is disabled and thickness of bottom shell is absolutely determined by bottom shell layers.
bottom_shell_thickness.tip_zh: 如果由底部壳体层数算出的厚度小于这个数值，那么切片时将自动增加底部壳体层数。这能够避免当层高很小时，底部壳体过薄。0表示关闭这个设置，同时底部壳体的厚度完全由底部壳体层数决定

bottom_surface_density.label: Bottom surface density
bottom_surface_density.tip:
Density of the bottom surface layer. Intended for aesthetic or functional purposes, not to fix issues such as over-extrusion.
WARNING: Lowering this value may negatively affect bed adhesion.
bottom_surface_density.tip_zh:
底层表面的密度
此功能是为了美观或功能性目的，而是为了解决过量挤出等问题。
警告：降低此值会对热床粘接力产生负面影响。

bottom_surface_pattern.label: Bottom surface pattern
bottom_surface_pattern.tip: Line pattern of bottom surface infill, not bridge infill.
bottom_surface_pattern.tip_zh: 除了桥接外的底面填充的走线图案

bridge_angle.label: External bridge infill direction
bridge_angle.tip:
External Bridging angle override.
If left to zero, the bridging angle will be calculated automatically for each specific bridge.
Otherwise the provided angle will be used according to:
 - The absolute coordinates
 - The absolute coordinates + Model rotation: If Align infill direction to model is enabled
 - The optimal automatic angle + this value: If 'Relative Bridge Angle' is enabled

Use 180° for zero absolute angle.
bridge_angle.tip_zh:
外部桥接角度覆盖。
如果保持为零，每个具体桥接的桥接角度都会自动计算。
否则将按以下方式使用所提供的角度：
 - 绝对坐标
 - 绝对坐标 + 模型旋转：如果启用了“对齐填充方向到模型”
 - 最佳自动角度 + 此值：如果启用了“相对桥接角度”

使用 180° 表示绝对角度为零。

bridge_density.label: External bridge density
bridge_density.tip:
Controls the density (spacing) of external bridge lines.
Theoretically, 100% means a solid bridge, but due to the tendency of bridge extrusions to sag, 100% may not be sufficient.

- Higher than 100% density (Recommended Max 125%):
  - Pros: Produces smoother bridge surfaces, as overlapping lines provide additional support during printing.
  - Cons: Can cause overextrusion, which may reduce lower and upper surface quality and increase the risk of warping.

- Lower than 100% density (Min 10%):
  - Pros: Can create a string-like first layer. Faster and with better cooling because there is more space for air to circulate around the extruded bridge.
  - Cons: May lead to sagging and poorer surface finish.

detect_narrow_internal_solid_infill.label: Detect narrow internal solid infills
detect_narrow_internal_solid_infill.tip: This option will auto-detect narrow internal solid infill areas. If enabled, the concentric pattern will be used for the area to speed up printing. Otherwise, the rectilinear pattern will be used by default.
detect_narrow_internal_solid_infill.zh: 识别狭窄的内部实心填充
detect_narrow_internal_solid_infill.tip_zh: 此选项用于自动识别内部实心填充中的狭窄区域。开启后，将对狭窄区域使用同心填充，以加快打印速度。否则将使用直线等默认填充。

detect_thin_wall.label: Detect thin walls
detect_thin_wall.tip: Detect thin walls which can't contain two line widths, and use single line to print. Maybe not printed very well, because it's not a closed loop.
detect_thin_wall.tip_zh: 检查无法容纳两条走线的薄壁。使用单条走线打印。可能会打地不是很好，因为走线不再闭合。

ensure_vertical_shell_thickness.label: Ensure vertical shell thickness
ensure_vertical_shell_thickness.tip:
Add solid infill near sloping surfaces to guarantee the vertical shell thickness (top+bottom solid layers)
None: No solid infill will be added anywhere. Caution: Use this option carefully if your model has sloped surfaces
Critical Only: Avoid adding solid infill for walls
Moderate: Add solid infill for heavily sloping surfaces only
All: Add solid infill for all suitable sloping surfaces
Default value is All.
ensure_vertical_shell_thickness.tip_zh:
在倾斜表面附近添加实心填充，以保证垂直外壳的厚度（顶部+底部实心层）
无：任何地方都不会添加实心填充。注意：如果您的模型有倾斜表面，请谨慎使用此选项
仅关键区域：避免为墙壁添加实心填充
适量：仅为严重倾斜的表面添加实心填充
全部：为所有适当的倾斜表面添加实心填充
默认值为全部。

extra_solid_infills.label: Insert solid layers
extra_solid_infills.tip: Insert solid infill at specific layers. Use N to insert every Nth layer, N#K to insert K consecutive solid layers every N layers (K is optional, e.g. '5#' equals '5#1'), or a comma-separated list (e.g. 1,7,9) to insert at explicit layers. Layers are 1-based.
extra_solid_infills.tip_zh: 在特定层插入实心填充。使用N表示每N层插入一次，N#K表示每N层插入K个连续的实心层（K是可选的，例如'5#'等于'5#1'），或使用逗号分隔的列表（例如1,7,9）在指定层插入。层数从1开始。

fill_multiline.label: Fill Multiline
fill_multiline.tip: Using multiple lines for the infill pattern, if supported by infill pattern.
fill_multiline.tip_zh: 如果填充图案支持，使用多线进行填充。

gap_fill_target.label: Apply gap fill
gap_fill_target.tip:
Enables gap fill for the selected solid surfaces. The minimum gap length that will be filled can be controlled from the filter out tiny gaps option below.

Options:
1. Everywhere: Applies gap fill to top, bottom and internal solid surfaces for maximum strength
2. Top and Bottom surfaces: Applies gap fill to top and bottom surfaces only, balancing print speed, reducing potential over extrusion in the solid infill and making sure the top and bottom surfaces have no pinhole gaps
3. Nowhere: Disables gap fill for all solid infill areas

Note that if using the classic perimeter generator, gap fill may also be generated between perimeters, if a full width line cannot fit between them. That perimeter gap fill is not controlled by this setting.

If you would like all gap fill, including the classic perimeter generated one, removed, set the filter out tiny gaps value to a large number, like 999999.

However this is not advised, as gap fill between perimeters is contributing to the model's strength. For models where excessive gap fill is generated between perimeters, a better option would be to switch to the arachne wall generator and use this option to control whether the cosmetic top and bottom surface gap fill is generated.
gap_fill_target.tip_zh:
为选定的实体曲面启用间隙填充。可以通过下面的过滤掉微小间隙选项来控制要填充的最小间隙长度。 选项：
1. 无处不在：对顶部、底部和内部固体表面进行间隙填充，以获得最大强度
2. 顶部和底部表面：仅对顶部和底部表面应用间隙填充，平衡打印速度，减少固体填充中过度挤出的可能性，并确保顶部和底部表面没有针孔间隙
3. 无处：禁用所有实体填充区域的间隙填充 请注意，如果使用经典的周长生成器，如果全宽线无法容纳在周长之间，则也可能在周长之间生成间隙填充。周边间隙填充不受此设置控制。 如果您希望删除所有间隙填充（包括生成的经典周长），请将过滤掉微小间隙的值设置为一个较大的数字，例如 999999。 然而，不建议这样做，因为周边之间的间隙填充有助于提高模型的强度。对于在周边之间生成过多间隙填充的模型，更好的选择是切换到蜘蛛壁生成器并使用此选项来控制是否生成装饰性顶部和底部表面间隙填充。

gyroid_optimized.label: Z-buckling bias optimization (experimental)
gyroid_optimized.tip: Tightens the gyroid wave along the Z (vertical) axis at low infill density to shorten the effective vertical column length and improve Z-axis compression buckling resistance. Filament use is preserved. No effect at ~30% sparse infill density and above. Only applies when Sparse infill pattern is set to Gyroid.
gyroid_optimized.zh: Z 轴屈曲偏置优化（实验性）
gyroid_optimized.tip_zh: 在低填充密度下沿 Z（垂直）轴收紧螺旋（Gyroid）波形，以缩短有效的垂直柱长，提升 Z 轴抗压屈曲能力。耗材用量保持不变。在约 30% 及以上的稀疏填充密度下无效果。仅当稀疏填充图案设置为 Gyroid 时适用。

infill_anchor.label: Sparse infill anchor length
infill_anchor.tip:
Connect an infill line to an internal perimeter with a short segment of an additional perimeter. If expressed as percentage (example: 15%) it is calculated over infill extrusion width. Orca Slicer tries to connect two close infill lines to a short perimeter segment. If no such perimeter segment shorter than infill_anchor_max is found, the infill line is connected to a perimeter segment at just one side and the length of the perimeter segment taken is limited to this parameter, but no longer than anchor_length_max.
Set this parameter to zero to disable anchoring perimeters connected to a single infill line.
infill_anchor.tip_zh: 用附加周长的一小段将填充线连接到内部周长。如果以百分比（例如：15%）表示，则计算填充拉伸宽度。OrcaSlicer 试图将两条紧密的填充线连接到一个短的周长段。如果找不到短于“填充”和“锚点”最大值的周长线段，则填充线仅在一侧连接到周长线段，并且所取周长线段的长度仅限于此参数，但不超过“锚点长度”最大值。将此参数设置为零，以禁用连接到单个填充线的锚点周长。

infill_anchor_max.label: Maximum length of the infill anchor
infill_anchor_max.tip:
Connect an infill line to an internal perimeter with a short segment of an additional perimeter. If expressed as percentage (example: 15%) it is calculated over infill extrusion width. Orca Slicer tries to connect two close infill lines to a short perimeter segment. If no such perimeter segment shorter than this parameter is found, the infill line is connected to a perimeter segment at just one side and the length of the perimeter segment taken is limited to infill_anchor, but no longer than this parameter.
If set to 0, the old algorithm for infill connection will be used, it should create the same result as with 1000 & 0.
infill_anchor_max.tip_zh: 用附加周长的一小段将填充线连接到内部周长。如果以百分比（例如：15%）表示，则计算填充拉伸宽度。OrcaSlicer 试图将两条紧密的填充线连接到一个短的周长段。如果找不到比此参数短的周长线段，则填充线仅在一侧连接到周长线段，并且所采用的周长线段的长度仅限于 infl_anchor，但不超过此参数。将此参数设置为零以禁用锚点。

infill_combination.label: Infill combination
infill_combination.tip: Automatically Combine sparse infill of several layers to print together to reduce time. Wall is still printed with original layer height.
infill_combination.tip_zh: 自动合并打印若干层稀疏填充，以缩短时间，内外墙维持原始打印层高。

infill_combination_max_layer_height.label: Infill combination - Max layer height
infill_combination_max_layer_height.tip:
Maximum layer height for the combined sparse infill.

Set it to 0 or 100% to use the nozzle diameter (for maximum reduction in print time) or a value of ~80% to maximize sparse infill strength.

The number of layers over which infill is combined is derived by dividing this value with the layer height and rounded down to the nearest decimal.

Use either absolute mm values (eg. 0.32mm for a 0.4mm nozzle) or % values (eg 80%). This value must not be larger than the nozzle diameter.
infill_combination_max_layer_height.zh: 填充组合 - 最大层高
infill_combination_max_layer_height.tip_zh:
组合稀疏填充的最大层高。

设置为 0 或 100% 使用喷嘴直径（以最大程度减少打印时间），或设置为约 80% 以最大化稀疏填充强度。

填充组合的层数是通过将此值除以层高并向下取整得出的。

可以使用绝对 mm 值（例如 0.4mm 喷嘴使用 0.32mm）或百分比值（例如 80%）。此值不得大于喷嘴直径。

infill_direction.label: Sparse infill direction
infill_direction.tip: Angle for sparse infill pattern, which controls the start or main direction of line.
infill_direction.tip_zh: 稀疏填充图案的角度，决定走线的开始或整体方向。

infill_lock_depth.label: Infill lock depth
infill_lock_depth.tip: The parameter sets the overlapping depth between the interior and skin.
infill_lock_depth.tip_zh: 该参数设置内部与外壳之间的重叠深度

infill_overhang_angle.label: Infill overhang angle
infill_overhang_angle.tip: The angle of the infill angled lines. 60° will result in a pure honeycomb.
infill_overhang_angle.tip_zh: 填充倾斜线的角度。60°将产生纯蜂窝结构。

infill_shift_step.label: Infill shift step
infill_shift_step.tip: This parameter adds a slight displacement to each layer of infill to create a cross texture.
infill_shift_step.tip_zh: 此参数为每层填充添加轻微的位移以创建十字纹理。

infill_wall_overlap.label: Infill/Wall overlap
infill_wall_overlap.tip: Infill area is enlarged slightly to overlap with wall for better bonding. The percentage value is relative to line width of sparse infill. Set this value to ~10-15% to minimize potential over extrusion and accumulation of material resulting in rough top surfaces.
infill_wall_overlap.tip_zh: 填充区域略微扩大以与墙壁重叠，以获得更好的粘合。百分比值相对于稀疏填充的线宽。将此值设置为约10-15%，以最小化潜在的过挤出和材料积累，从而导致顶部表面粗糙。

internal_bridge_angle.label: Internal bridge infill direction
internal_bridge_angle.tip:
Internal Bridging angle override.
If left to zero, the bridging angle will be calculated automatically for each specific bridge.
Otherwise the provided angle will be used according to:
 - The absolute coordinates
 - The absolute coordinates + Model rotation: If Align infill direction to model is enabled
 - The optimal automatic angle + this value: If 'Relative Bridge Angle' is enabled

Use 180° for zero absolute angle.
internal_bridge_angle.tip_zh:
内部桥接角度覆盖。
如果保持为零，每个具体桥接的桥接角度都会自动计算。
否则将按以下方式使用所提供的角度：
 - 绝对坐标
 - 绝对坐标 + 模型旋转：如果启用了“对齐填充方向到模型”
 - 最佳自动角度 + 此值：如果启用了“相对桥接角度”

使用 180° 表示绝对角度为零。

internal_bridge_density.label: Internal bridge density
internal_bridge_density.tip:
Controls the density (spacing) of internal bridge lines.
Internal bridges act as intermediate support between sparse infill and top solid infill and can strongly affect top surface quality.

- Higher than 100% density (Recommended Max 125%):
  - Pros: Improves internal bridge strength and support under top layers, reducing sagging and improving top-surface finish.
  - Cons: Increases material use and print time; excessive density may cause overextrusion and internal stresses.

- Lower than 100% density (Min 10%):
  - Pros: Can reduce pillowing and improve cooling (more airflow through the bridge), and may speed up printing.
  - Cons: May reduce internal support, increasing the risk of sagging and top surface defects.

This option works particularly well when combined with the second internal bridge over infill option to improve bridging further before solid infill is extruded.

internal_solid_infill_pattern.label: Internal solid infill pattern
internal_solid_infill_pattern.tip: Line pattern of internal solid infill. if the detect narrow internal solid infill be enabled, the concentric pattern will be used for the small area.
internal_solid_infill_pattern.tip_zh: 内部实心填充的线型图案。如果启用了检测狭窄的内部实心填充，将使用同心圆图案来填充小区域。
