lateral_lattice_angle_1.label: Lateral lattice angle 1
lateral_lattice_angle_1.tip: The angle of the first set of Lateral lattice elements in the Z direction. Zero is vertical.
lateral_lattice_angle_1.tip_zh: 第一组二维晶格单元在Z方向的角度。零表示垂直。

lateral_lattice_angle_2.label: Lateral lattice angle 2
lateral_lattice_angle_2.tip: The angle of the second set of Lateral lattice elements in the Z direction. Zero is vertical.
lateral_lattice_angle_2.tip_zh: 第二组二维晶格单元在Z方向的角度。零表示垂直。

lightning_overhang_angle.label: Lightning overhang angle
lightning_overhang_angle.tip: Maximum overhang angle for Lightning infill support propagation.
lightning_overhang_angle.tip_zh: 闪电填充支撑扩展的最大悬垂角度。

lightning_prune_angle.label: Prune angle
lightning_prune_angle.tip:
Controls how aggressively short or unsupported Lightning branches are pruned.
This angle is converted internally to a per-layer distance.
lightning_prune_angle.tip_zh:
控制对短的或无支撑的闪电分支进行修剪的力度。
此角度在内部会被转换为每层的距离。

lightning_straightening_angle.label: Straightening angle
lightning_straightening_angle.tip: Maximum straightening angle used to simplify Lightning branches.
lightning_straightening_angle.tip_zh: 用于简化闪电分支的最大拉直角度。

minimum_sparse_infill_area.label: Minimum sparse infill threshold
minimum_sparse_infill_area.tip: Sparse infill areas smaller than this threshold value are replaced by internal solid infill.
minimum_sparse_infill_area.tip_zh: 小于这个阈值的稀疏填充区域将会被内部实心填充替代。

relative_bridge_angle.label: Relative bridge angle
relative_bridge_angle.tip: When enabled, the bridge angle values are added to the automatically calculated bridge direction instead of overriding it.
relative_bridge_angle.tip_zh: 启用后，桥接角度值将被加到自动计算出的桥接方向上，而不是覆盖它。

skeleton_infill_density.label: Skeleton infill density
skeleton_infill_density.tip: The remaining part of the model contour after removing a certain depth from the surface is called the skeleton. This parameter is used to adjust the density of this section. When two regions have the same sparse infill settings but different skeleton densities, their skeleton areas will develop overlapping sections. Default is as same as infill density.
skeleton_infill_density.tip_zh: 模型轮廓从表面去除一定深度后剩余的部分称为骨架。该参数用于调整该部分的密度。当两个区域具有相同的稀疏填充设置但不同的骨架密度时，它们的骨架区域将产生重叠部分。默认值与填充密度相同。

skeleton_infill_line_width.label: Skeleton line width
skeleton_infill_line_width.tip: Adjust the line width of the selected skeleton paths.
skeleton_infill_line_width.tip_zh: 调整选中骨架路径的线宽

skin_infill_density.label: Skin infill density
skin_infill_density.tip: The portion of the model's outer surface within a certain depth range is called the skin. This parameter is used to adjust the density of this section. When two regions have the same sparse infill settings but different skin densities, this area will not be split into two separate regions. Default is as same as infill density.
skin_infill_density.tip_zh: 模型外表面在一定深度范围内的部分称为蒙皮。该参数用于调整该部分的密度。当两个区域具有相同的稀疏填充设置但不同的蒙皮密度时，该区域不会被分割为两个单独的区域。默认值与填充密度相同。

skin_infill_depth.label: Skin infill depth
skin_infill_depth.tip: The parameter sets the depth of skin.

skin_infill_line_width.label: Skin line width
skin_infill_line_width.tip: Adjust the line width of the selected skin paths.
skin_infill_line_width.tip_zh: 调整选中外壳路径的线宽

solid_infill_direction.label: Solid infill direction
solid_infill_direction.tip: Angle for solid infill pattern, which controls the start or main direction of line.
solid_infill_direction.tip_zh: 实心填充图案的角度，决定走线的开始或整体方向。

solid_infill_rotate_template.label: Solid infill rotation template
solid_infill_rotate_template.tip: This parameter adds a rotation of solid infill direction to each layer according to the specified template. The template is a comma-separated list of angles in degrees, e.g. '0,90'. The first angle is applied to the first layer, the second angle to the second layer, and so on. If there are more layers than angles, the angles will be repeated. Note that not all solid infill patterns support rotation.
solid_infill_rotate_template.tip_zh: 该参数根据指定的模板为每个图层添加实体填充方向的旋转。该模板是一个以逗号分隔的角度列表，以度为单位，例如'0,90'。第一个角度应用于第一层，第二个角度应用于第二层，依此类推。如果层数多于角度，则角度将重复。请注意，并非所有实心填充图案都支持旋转。

sparse_infill_density.label: Sparse infill density
sparse_infill_density.tip: Density of internal sparse infill, 100% turns all sparse infill into solid infill and internal solid infill pattern will be used.
sparse_infill_density.tip_zh: 内部稀疏填充的密度，100%会将所有稀疏填充变为实心填充，并将使用内部实心填充图案。

sparse_infill_pattern.label: Sparse infill pattern
sparse_infill_pattern.tip: Line pattern for internal sparse infill.
sparse_infill_pattern.tip_zh: 内部稀疏填充的走线图案

sparse_infill_rotate_template.label: Sparse infill rotation template
sparse_infill_rotate_template.tip: Rotate the sparse infill direction per layer using a template of angles. Enter comma-separated degrees (e.g., '0,30,60,90'). Angles are applied in order by layer and repeat when the list ends. Advanced syntax is supported: '+5' rotates +5° every layer; '+5#5' rotates +5° every 5 layers. See the Wiki for details. When a template is set, the standard infill direction setting is ignored. Note: some infill patterns (e.g., Gyroid) control rotation themselves; use with care.
sparse_infill_rotate_template.tip_zh: 使用角度模板旋转每层的稀疏填充方向。输入以逗号分隔的度数（例如“0,30,60,90”）。角度按层顺序应用，并在列表结束时重复。支持高级语法：“+5”每层旋转+5°； ‘+5#5’每 5 层旋转+5°。详细信息请参阅维基百科。设置模板后，将忽略标准填充方向设置。注意：一些填充图案（例如 Gyroid）本身控制旋转；小心使用。

symmetric_infill_y_axis.label: Symmetric infill Y axis
symmetric_infill_y_axis.tip: If the model has two parts that are symmetric about the Y axis, and you want these parts to have symmetric textures, please click this option on one of the parts.
symmetric_infill_y_axis.tip_zh: 若模型有两个在Y轴上对称的部分，并且您想对其使用对称的纹理，就请在对应的模型部分上应用此设置。

top_bottom_infill_wall_overlap.label: Top/Bottom solid infill/wall overlap
top_bottom_infill_wall_overlap.tip: Top solid infill area is enlarged slightly to overlap with wall for better bonding and to minimize the appearance of pinholes where the top infill meets the walls. A value of 25-30% is a good starting point, minimizing the appearance of pinholes. The percentage value is relative to line width of sparse infill.
top_bottom_infill_wall_overlap.zh: 顶/底部实心填充/墙重叠率
top_bottom_infill_wall_overlap.tip_zh: 顶部实心填充区域略微扩大，以便与墙壁重叠，以获得更好的粘合，并减少顶部填充与墙壁相接处的小孔出现。25-30%的值是一个很好的起点，可以减少小孔的出现。百分比值相对于稀疏填充的线宽

top_shell_layers.label: Top shell layers
top_shell_layers.tip: This is the number of solid layers of top shell, including the top surface layer. When the thickness calculated by this value is thinner than top shell thickness, the top shell layers will be increased.
top_shell_layers.tip_zh: 顶部壳体实心层层数，包括顶面。当由该层数计算的厚度小于顶部壳体厚度，切片时会增加顶部壳体的层数

top_shell_thickness.label: Top shell thickness
top_shell_thickness.tip: The number of top solid layers is increased when slicing if the thickness calculated by top shell layers is thinner than this value. This can avoid having too thin shell when layer height is small. 0 means that this setting is disabled and thickness of top shell is absolutely determined by top shell layers.
top_shell_thickness.tip_zh: 如果由顶部壳体层数算出的厚度小于这个数值，那么切片时将自动增加顶部壳体层数。这能够避免当层高很小时，顶部壳体过薄。0 表示关闭这个设置，同时顶部壳体的厚度完全由顶部壳体层数决定

top_surface_density.label: Top surface density
top_surface_density.tip: Density of top surface layer. A value of 100% creates a fully solid, smooth top layer. Reducing this value results in a textured top surface, according to the chosen top surface pattern. A value of 0% will result in only the walls on the top layer being created. Intended for aesthetic or functional purposes, not to fix issues such as over-extrusion.
top_surface_density.tip_zh:
顶层表面的密度。
100% 的值会创建一个完全实心、平滑的顶面。降低此值会根据所选的顶面图案生成有纹理的顶面。0% 的值将只生成顶层的墙。
此选项仅为美观或功能性目的，而不是为了解决过量挤出等问题。

top_surface_pattern.label: Top surface pattern
top_surface_pattern.tip: Line pattern of top surface infill.

wall_loops.label: Wall loops
wall_loops.tip: Number of walls of every layer.

bridge_no_support.label: Don't support bridges
bridge_no_support.tip: Don't support the whole bridge area which make support very large. Bridges can usually be printed directly without support if not very long.
bridge_no_support.tip_zh: 不对整个桥接面进行支撑，否则支撑体会很大。不是很长的桥接通常可以无支撑直接打印。

brim_ears.label: Brim ears
brim_ears.tip: Only draw brim over the sharp edges of the model.

brim_ears_detection_length.label: Brim ear detection radius
brim_ears_detection_length.tip:
The geometry will be decimated before detecting sharp angles. This parameter indicates the minimum length of the deviation for the decimation.
0 to deactivate.
brim_ears_detection_length.tip_zh:
在检测尖锐角度之前，几何形状将被简化。此参数表示简化的最小偏差长度。
设为0以停用

brim_ears_max_angle.label: Brim ear max angle
brim_ears_max_angle.tip:
Maximum angle to let a brim ear appear.
If set to 0, no brim will be created.
If set to ~180, brim will be created on everything but straight sections.
brim_ears_max_angle.tip_zh:
让圆盘出现的最大角度。
如果设置为0，则不会创建圆盘。
如果设置为约180，除直线部分外，其他部分都会创建圆盘。

brim_flow_ratio.label: Brim flow ratio
brim_flow_ratio.tip:
This factor affects the amount of material for brims.

The actual brim flow used is calculated by multiplying this value by the filament flow ratio, and if set, the object's flow ratio.

Note: The resulting value will not be affected by the first-layer flow ratio.
brim_flow_ratio.tip_zh:
此系数影响Brim的材料用量。

实际使用的Brim流量是将此值乘以耗材流量比，以及（如已设置）对象的流量比计算得出的。

注意：所得的值不会受首层流量比的影响。

brim_object_gap.label: Brim-object gap
brim_object_gap.tip: A gap between innermost brim line and object can make brim be removed more easily.
brim_object_gap.tip_zh: 在brim和模型之间设置间隙，能够让brim更容易剥离

brim_type.label: Brim type
brim_type.tip: This controls the generation of the brim at outer and/or inner side of models. Auto means the brim width is analyzed and calculated automatically.
brim_type.tip_zh: 该参数控制在模型的外侧和/或内侧生成brim。自动是指自动分析和计算边框的宽度。

brim_use_efc_outline.label: Brim follows compensated outline
brim_use_efc_outline.tip:
When enabled, the brim is aligned with the first-layer perimeter geometry after Elephant Foot Compensation is applied.
This option is intended for cases where Elephant Foot Compensation significantly alters the first-layer footprint.

If your current setup already works well, enabling it may be unnecessary and can cause the brim to fuse with upper layers.
brim_use_efc_outline.tip_zh:
启用后，Brim 与第一层周边几何体对齐 应用象脚补偿后。
此选项适用于象脚补偿的情况 显着改变第一层足迹。

如果您当前的设置已经运行良好，则可能没有必要启用它，并且 可以导致 Brim 与上层融合。

brim_width.label: Brim width
brim_width.tip: Distance from model to the outermost brim line.
brim_width.tip_zh: 从模型到最外圈brim走线的距离

combine_brims.label: Combine brims
combine_brims.tip: Combine multiple brims into one when they are close to each other. This can improve brim adhesion.
combine_brims.tip_zh: 当多个Brim彼此靠近时，将它们合并为一个。这可以改善Brim附着力。

enforce_support_layers.label: Enforce support for the first
enforce_support_layers.tip: Generate support material for the specified number of layers counting from bottom, regardless of whether normal support material is enabled or not and regardless of any angle threshold. This is useful for getting more adhesion of objects having a very thin or poor footprint on the build plate.

independent_support_layer_height.label: Independent support layer height
independent_support_layer_height.tip: Support layer uses layer height independent with object layer. This is to support customizing Z-gap and save print time. This option will be invalid when the prime tower is enabled.
independent_support_layer_height.tip_zh: 支撑层使用与对象层独立的层高。这是为了支持自定义z-gap并且节省打印时间。当擦料塔被启用时，这个选项将无效。

max_bridge_length.label: Max bridge length
max_bridge_length.tip: Max length of bridges that don't need support. Set it to 0 if you want all bridges to be supported, and set it to a very large value if you don't want any bridges to be supported.
max_bridge_length.tip_zh: 不需要支撑的桥接的最大长度。如果希望支持所有桥接，请将其设置为0；如果不希望支持任何桥接，请将其设置为非常大的值。

raft_contact_distance.label: Raft contact Z distance
raft_contact_distance.tip: Z gap between raft and object. If Support Top Z Distance is 0, this value is ignored and the object is printed in direct contact with the raft (no gap).
raft_contact_distance.tip_zh: 筏层与模型之间的Z间隙。如果支撑顶部Z距离为0，则忽略该值，模型与筏层直接接触打印（无间隙）。

raft_expansion.label: Raft expansion
raft_expansion.tip: Expand all raft layers in XY plane.

raft_first_layer_density.label: First layer density
raft_first_layer_density.tip: Density of the first raft or support layer.

raft_first_layer_expansion.label: First layer expansion
raft_first_layer_expansion.tip: Expand the first raft or support layer to improve bed plate adhesion.
raft_first_layer_expansion.tip_zh: 扩展筏和支撑的首层可以改善和热床的粘接。

raft_layers.label: Raft layers
raft_layers.tip: Object will be raised by this number of support layers. Use this function to avoid warping when printing ABS.
raft_layers.tip_zh: 模型会在相应层数的支撑上抬高进行打印。使用该功能通常用于打印ABS时翘曲。

skirt_start_angle.label: Skirt start point
skirt_start_angle.tip: Angle from the object center to skirt start point. Zero is the most right position, counter clockwise is positive angle.
skirt_start_angle.tip_zh: 从模型中心到裙边起始点的角度。0是最右边的位置，逆时针是正角度。

support_angle.label: Pattern angle
support_angle.tip: Use this setting to rotate the support pattern on the horizontal plane.
support_angle.tip_zh: 设置支撑图案在水平面的旋转角度。

support_base_pattern.label: Base pattern
support_base_pattern.tip:
Line pattern of support.

The Default option for Tree supports is Hollow, which means no base pattern. For other support types, the Default option is the Rectilinear pattern.

NOTE: For Organic supports, the two walls are supported only with the Hollow/Default base pattern. The Lightning base pattern is supported only by Tree Slim/Strong/Hybrid supports. For the other support types, the Rectilinear will be used instead of Lightning.
support_base_pattern.tip_zh:
支撑走线图案。

树状支撑的默认选项为空心，即无主体图案。其他支撑类型的默认选项为直线图案。

注意：对于有机支撑，仅在空心/默认主体图案下支持双墙。闪电主体图案仅树状精简/坚固/混合支撑支持。对于其他支撑类型，将改用直线图案替代闪电图案。

support_bottom_interface_spacing.label: Bottom interface spacing
support_bottom_interface_spacing.tip: Spacing of bottom interface lines. Zero means solid interface.
support_bottom_interface_spacing.tip_zh: 底部接触面走线的线距。0 表示实心接触面。

support_bottom_z_distance.label: Bottom Z distance
support_bottom_z_distance.tip: Z gap between the object and the support bottom. If Support Top Z Distance is 0 and the bottom has interface layers, this value is ignored and the support is printed in direct contact with the object (no gap).
support_bottom_z_distance.tip_zh: 模型与支撑底部之间的Z间隙。如果支撑顶部Z距离为0且底部有界面层，则忽略该值，支撑与模型直接接触打印（无间隙）。

support_critical_regions_only.label: Support critical regions only
support_critical_regions_only.tip: Only create support for critical regions including sharp tail, cantilever, etc.
support_critical_regions_only.tip_zh: 仅对关键区域生成支撑，包括尖尾、悬臂等。

support_expansion.label: Normal Support expansion
support_expansion.tip: Expand (+) or shrink (-) the horizontal span of normal support.
support_expansion.tip_zh: 在水平方向对普通支撑进行拓展（+）或收缩（-）

support_filament.label: Support/raft base
support_filament.tip:
Filament to print support base and raft.
"Default" means no specific filament for support and current filament is used.
support_filament.tip_zh:
用于打印支撑基底和筏层的耗材。
“默认”表示不为支撑指定特定耗材，使用当前耗材。

support_interface_filament.label: Support/raft interface
support_interface_filament.tip:
Filament to print support interface.
"Default" means no specific filament for support interface and current filament is used.
support_interface_filament.tip_zh:
用于打印支撑面的耗材。
“默认”表示不为支撑面指定特定耗材，使用当前耗材。

support_interface_loop_pattern.label: Interface use loop pattern
support_interface_loop_pattern.tip: Cover the top contact layer of the supports with loops. Disabled by default.
support_interface_loop_pattern.tip_zh: 使用圈形走线覆盖顶部接触面。默认关闭。

support_interface_not_for_body.label: Avoid interface filament for base
support_interface_not_for_body.tip: Avoid using support interface filament to print support base if possible.
support_interface_not_for_body.tip_zh: 避免使用支撑界面材料打印支撑主体。

support_interface_pattern.label: Interface pattern
support_interface_pattern.tip: Line pattern of support interface. Default pattern for non-soluble support interface is Rectilinear, while default pattern for soluble support interface is Concentric.
support_interface_pattern.tip_zh: 支撑接触面的走线图案。非可溶支撑接触面的默认图案为直线，可溶支撑接触面的默认图案为同心。

support_interface_spacing.label: Top interface spacing
support_interface_spacing.tip:
Spacing of interface lines. Zero means solid interface.
Force using solid interface when support ironing is enabled.
support_interface_spacing.tip_zh:
顶部接触面走线的线距。0 表示实心接触面。
若启用了支撑熨烫，则此选项将强制使用实心接触面设置。

support_ironing.label: Ironing Support Interface
support_ironing.tip: Ironing is using small flow to print on same height of support interface again to make it more smooth. This setting controls whether support interface being ironed. When enabled, support interface will be extruded as solid too.
support_ironing.tip_zh:
此设置控制是否对支撑面进行熨烫。熨烫是使用小流量再次在支撑面的相同高度上打印，使其更加平滑。
启用时，支撑面也会被挤出为实心。

support_ironing_flow.label: Support Ironing flow
support_ironing_flow.tip: The amount of material to extrude during ironing. Relative to flow of normal support interface layer height. Too high value results in overextrusion on the surface.
support_ironing_flow.tip_zh:
在熨烫过程中需要挤出的材料流量。此设置与普通支撑面层流量设置之间相关。
值过高会导致表面过量挤出。

support_ironing_pattern.label: Support Ironing Pattern
support_ironing_pattern.tip: The pattern that will be used when ironing.

support_ironing_spacing.label: Support Ironing line spacing
support_ironing_spacing.tip: The distance between the lines of ironing.

support_object_first_layer_gap.label: Support/object first layer gap
support_object_first_layer_gap.tip: XY separation between an object and its support at the first layer.
support_object_first_layer_gap.tip_zh: 物体与其首层支撑之间的 XY 间隔。

support_object_xy_distance.label: Support/object XY distance
support_object_xy_distance.tip: XY separation between an object and its support.
support_object_xy_distance.tip_zh: 模型和支撑之间XY分离距离

support_on_build_plate_only.label: On build plate only
support_on_build_plate_only.tip: Don't create support on model surface, only on build plate.
support_on_build_plate_only.tip_zh: 不在模型表面上生成支撑，只在热床上生成。

support_remove_small_overhang.label: Ignore small overhangs
support_remove_small_overhang.tip: Ignore small overhangs that possibly don't require support.
support_remove_small_overhang.tip_zh: 将几乎不需要支撑的微小悬垂忽略掉。

support_style.label: Style
support_style.tip:
Style and shape of the support. For normal support, projecting the supports into a regular grid will create more stable supports (default), while snug support towers will save material and reduce object scarring.
For tree support, slim and organic style will merge branches more aggressively and save a lot of material (default organic), while hybrid style will create similar structure to normal support under large flat overhangs.
support_style.tip_zh:
支撑物的样式和形状。对于普通支撑，将支撑投射到一个规则的网格中，将创建更稳定的支撑（默认），而紧贴的支撑塔将节省材料并减少物体的瑕疵。
对于树形支撑，苗条树将更激进地合并树枝，并节省大量的材料；粗壮树会产生更大更强壮的支撑结构，但用料更多；而混合树是苗条树和普通支撑的结合，它会在大的平面悬垂下创建与正常支撑类似的结构（默认）。

support_threshold_angle.label: Threshold angle
support_threshold_angle.tip:
Support will be generated for overhangs whose slope angle is below the threshold. The smaller this value is, the steeper the overhang that can be printed without support.
Note: If set to 0, normal supports use the Threshold overlap instead, while tree supports fall back to a default value of 30.
support_threshold_angle.tip_zh:
将会为倾斜角度低于阈值的悬垂生成支撑。该值越小，可在不使用支撑的情况下打印的悬垂就越陡。
注意：若设置为 0，普通支撑将改用阈值支撑比例，而树状支撑将回退到默认值 30。

support_threshold_overlap.label: Threshold overlap
support_threshold_overlap.tip: If threshold angle is zero, support will be generated for overhangs whose overlap is below the threshold. The smaller this value is, the steeper the overhang that can be printed without support.
support_threshold_overlap.tip_zh: 如果阈值角为零，将会为重叠度低于阈值的悬垂部分生成支撑。若该值越小，则可打印而无需支撑的悬垂角度就越陡。

support_top_z_distance.label: Top Z distance
support_top_z_distance.tip: Z gap between the support's top and object.
support_top_z_distance.tip_zh: 支撑顶部与模型之间的Z间隙。

support_type.label: Type
support_type.tip: Normal (auto) and Tree (auto) are used to generate support automatically. If Normal (manual) or Tree (manual) is selected, only support enforcers are generated.
support_type.tip_zh: 普通（自动）和树状（自动）用于自动生成支撑。如果选择普通（手动）或树状（手动），则仅在支撑强制面上生成支撑。

tree_support_angle_slow.label: Preferred Branch Angle
tree_support_angle_slow.tip: The preferred angle of the branches, when they do not have to avoid the model. Use a lower angle to make them more vertical and more stable. Use a higher angle for branches to merge faster.
tree_support_angle_slow.tip_zh: 分支的首选角度，每当它们不必避开模型之时。使用小的角度使之更垂直、更稳定。使用大的角度使之更快地合并。

tree_support_branch_angle.label: Tree support branch angle
tree_support_branch_angle.tip: This setting determines the maximum overhang angle that the branches of tree support are allowed to make. If the angle is increased, the branches can be printed more horizontally, allowing them to reach farther.
tree_support_branch_angle.tip_zh: 此设置确定了允许树状支撑的最大悬垂角度。如果角度增加，可以更水平地打印分支，使它们可以到达更远的地方。

tree_support_branch_angle_organic.label: Tree support branch angle
tree_support_branch_angle_organic.tip: This setting determines the maximum overhang angle that the branches of tree support are allowed to make. If the angle is increased, the branches can be printed more horizontally, allowing them to reach farther.
tree_support_branch_angle_organic.tip_zh: 此设置确定了允许树状支撑的最大悬垂角度。如果角度增加，可以更水平地打印分支，使它们可以到达更远的地方。

tree_support_branch_diameter.label: Tree support branch diameter
tree_support_branch_diameter.tip: This setting determines the initial diameter of support nodes.
tree_support_branch_diameter.tip_zh: 此设置确定了树状支撑节点的初始直径。

tree_support_branch_diameter_angle.label: Branch Diameter Angle
tree_support_branch_diameter_angle.tip: The angle of the branches' diameter as they gradually become thicker towards the bottom. An angle of 0 will cause the branches to have uniform thickness over their length. A bit of an angle can increase stability of the organic support.
tree_support_branch_diameter_angle.tip_zh: 分支直径的角度，随着分支向底部逐渐变厚。如果角度为0，分支将在其长度上拥有均匀的厚度。一点角度可以增加organic的稳定性。

tree_support_branch_diameter_organic.label: Tree support branch diameter
tree_support_branch_diameter_organic.tip: This setting determines the initial diameter of support nodes.
tree_support_branch_diameter_organic.tip_zh: 此设置确定了树状支撑节点的初始直径。

tree_support_branch_distance.label: Tree support branch distance
tree_support_branch_distance.tip: This setting determines the distance between neighboring tree support nodes.
tree_support_branch_distance.tip_zh: 此设置确定了树状支撑的相邻节点之间的距离。

tree_support_branch_distance_organic.label: Tree support branch distance
tree_support_branch_distance_organic.tip: This setting determines the distance between neighboring tree support nodes.
tree_support_branch_distance_organic.tip_zh: 此设置确定了树状支撑的相邻节点之间的距离。

tree_support_tip_diameter.label: Tip Diameter
tree_support_tip_diameter.tip: Branch tip diameter for organic supports.

tree_support_top_rate.label: Branch Density
tree_support_top_rate.tip: Adjusts the density of the support structure used to generate the tips of the branches. A higher value results in better overhangs but the supports are harder to remove, thus it is recommended to enable top support interfaces instead of a high branch density value if dense interfaces are needed.
tree_support_top_rate.tip_zh: 用于调整分支尖端所生成的支撑结构的密度。值越大悬垂越好，但更难拆支撑，因此，如果需要密集的接触面，建议启用顶部接触面相关参数，而不是较高的分支密度。

tree_support_wall_count.label: Support wall loops
tree_support_wall_count.tip: This setting specifies the count of support walls in the range of [0,2]. 0 means auto.
tree_support_wall_count.tip_zh: 此设置指定[0,2]范围内的支撑墙层数。0表示自动。

tree_support_with_infill.label: Tree support with infill
tree_support_with_infill.tip: This setting specifies whether to add infill inside large hollows of tree support.
tree_support_with_infill.tip_zh: 这个设置决定是否为树状支撑内部的空腔生成填充。

activate_air_filtration.label: Activate air filtration
activate_air_filtration.tip: Activate for better air filtration. G-code command: M106 P3 S(0-255)
activate_air_filtration.tip_zh: 启用空气过滤/排气风扇。G-code命令：M106 P3 S(0-255)

activate_chamber_temp_control.label: Activate temperature control
activate_chamber_temp_control.tip:
Enable this option for automated chamber temperature control. This option activates the emitting of an M191 command before the "machine_start_gcode"
 which sets the chamber temperature and waits until it is reached. In addition, it emits an M141 command at the end of the print to turn off the chamber heater, if present.

This option relies on the firmware supporting the M191 and M141 commands either via macros or natively and is usually used when an active chamber heater is installed.
activate_chamber_temp_control.tip_zh: 启用此选项可实现自动室温度控制。该选项激活在“machine_start_gcode”之前发出 M191 命令 它设置腔室温度并等待达到该温度。此外，它还会在打印结束时发出 M141 命令以关闭腔室加热器（如果有）。 此选项依赖于通过宏或本机支持 M191 和 M141 命令的固件，通常在安装主动室加热器时使用。

adaptive_pressure_advance.label: Enable adaptive pressure advance (beta)
adaptive_pressure_advance.tip:
With increasing print speeds (and hence increasing volumetric flow through the nozzle) and increasing accelerations, it has been observed that the effective PA value typically decreases. This means that a single PA value is not always 100% optimal for all features and a compromise value is usually used that does not cause too much bulging on features with lower flow speed and accelerations while also not causing gaps on faster features.

This feature aims to address this limitation by modeling the response of your printer's extrusion system depending on the volumetric flow speed and acceleration it is printing at. Internally, it generates a fitted model that can extrapolate the needed pressure advance for any given volumetric flow speed and acceleration, which is then emitted to the printer depending on the current print conditions.

When enabled, the pressure advance value above is overridden. However, a reasonable default value above is strongly recommended to act as a fallback and for when tool changing.
adaptive_pressure_advance.zh: 启用自适应压力提前（试验）
adaptive_pressure_advance.tip_zh: With increasing print speeds (and hence increasing volumetric flow through the nozzle) and increasing accelerations, it has been observed that the effective PA value typically decreases.这意味着单个 PA 值并不总是对所有特征都是 100% 最佳的，并且通常使用折衷值，该折衷值不会在具有较低流速和加速度的特征上造成过多的凸出，同时也不会在较快的特征上造成间隙。 此功能旨在通过根据打印时的体积流速和加速度对打印机挤出系统的响应进行建模来解决此限制。在内部，它生成一个拟合模型，可以推断出任何给定体积流速和加速度所需的压力提前，然后根据当前的打印条件将其发送到打印机。 启用后，上面的压力提前值将被覆盖。然而，强烈建议使用上述合理的默认值作为后备以及更换工具时的选择。

adaptive_pressure_advance_bridges.label: Pressure advance for bridges
adaptive_pressure_advance_bridges.tip:
Pressure advance value for bridges. Set to 0 to disable.

A lower PA value when printing bridges helps reduce the appearance of slight under extrusion immediately after bridges. This is caused by the pressure drop in the nozzle when printing in the air and a lower PA helps counteract this.
adaptive_pressure_advance_bridges.tip_zh: 桥梁的压力提前值。设置为 0 以禁用。 打印桥接时较低的 PA 值有助于减少桥接后立即出现的轻微挤压不足现象。这是由在空气中打印时喷嘴中的压力下降引起的，较低的 PA 有助于抵消这种情况。

adaptive_pressure_advance_model.label: Adaptive pressure advance measurements (beta)
adaptive_pressure_advance_model.tip:
Add sets of pressure advance (PA) values, the volumetric flow speeds and accelerations they were measured at, separated by a comma. One set of values per line. For example
0.04,3.96,3000
0.033,3.96,10000
0.029,7.91,3000
0.026,7.91,10000

How to calibrate:
1. Run the pressure advance test for at least 3 speeds per acceleration value. It is recommended that the test is run for at least the speed of the external perimeters, the speed of the internal perimeters and the fastest feature print speed in your profile (usually its the sparse or solid infill). Then run them for the same speeds for the slowest and fastest print accelerations, and no faster than the recommended maximum acceleration as given by the Klipper input shaper
2. Take note of the optimal PA value for each volumetric flow speed and acceleration. You can find the flow number by selecting flow from the color scheme drop down and move the horizontal slider over the PA pattern lines. The number should be visible at the bottom of the page. The ideal PA value should be decreasing the higher the volumetric flow is. If it is not, confirm that your extruder is functioning correctly. The slower and with less acceleration you print, the larger the range of acceptable PA values. If no difference is visible, use the PA value from the faster test
3. Enter the triplets of PA values, Flow and Accelerations in the text box here and save your filament profile.
adaptive_pressure_advance_model.zh: 自适应压力提前参数（试验）
adaptive_pressure_advance_model.tip_zh:
添加压力提前 (PA) 值组、测量时的体积流速和加速度，并用逗号分隔。每行一组值。例如
0.04,3.96,3000
0.033,3.96,10000
0.029,7.91,3000
0.026,7.91,10000 如何校准：
1. 每个加速度值至少以 3 个速度运行压力提前测试。建议至少针对外部周边的速度、内部周边的速度以及配置文件中的最快特征打印速度（通常是稀疏或实心填充）运行测试。然后以相同的速度运行它们，以获得最慢和最快的打印加速度，并且不超过 Klipper 输入整形器给出的建议最大加速度
2. 记下每个体积流速和加速度的最佳 PA 值。您可以通过从配色方案下拉列表中选择流量并将水平滑块移动到 PA 图案线上来找到流量编号。该数字应该在页面底部可见。理想的 PA 值应该随着体积流量的增加而减小。如果不是，请确认您的挤出机运行正常。打印速度越慢且加速度越小，可接受的 PA 值范围就越大。如果没有明显差异，请使用更快测试中的 PA 值
3. 在此处的文本框中输入 PA 值、流量和加速度的三元组并保存耗材丝配置文件

adaptive_pressure_advance_overhangs.label: Enable adaptive pressure advance for overhangs (beta)
adaptive_pressure_advance_overhangs.tip: Enable adaptive PA for overhangs as well as when flow changes within the same feature. This is an experimental option, as if the PA profile is not set accurately, it will cause uniformity issues on the external surfaces before and after overhangs.
adaptive_pressure_advance_overhangs.zh: 为悬垂启用自适应压力提前（试验）
adaptive_pressure_advance_overhangs.tip_zh: 针对悬垂以及同一特征内的流量变化启用自适应 PA。这是一个实验性选项，如果 PA 轮廓设置不准确，则会导致悬垂前后外表面的均匀性问题。

additional_cooling_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
additional_cooling_fan_speed.tip:
Speed of auxiliary part cooling fan. Auxiliary fan will run at this speed during printing except the first several layers which is defined by no cooling layers.
Please enable auxiliary_fan in printer settings to use this feature. G-code command: M106 P2 S(0-255)
additional_cooling_fan_speed.tip_zh:
辅助部件冷却风扇的转速。辅助部件冷却风扇将一直运行在该速度，除了设置的无需冷却的前若干层
请在打印机设置中启用辅助风扇以使用此功能。G-code指令：M106 P2 S(0-255)

additional_fan_full_speed_layer.label: Full fan speed at layer
additional_fan_full_speed_layer.tip:
Auxiliary fan speed will be ramped up linearly from layer "For the first" to maximum at layer "Full fan speed at layer".
"Full fan speed at layer" will be ignored if lower than "For the first", in which case the fan will run at maximum allowed speed at layer "For the first" + 1.
additional_fan_full_speed_layer.tip_zh:
辅助风扇速度将从“在最初的”层数线性提升，到“满速风扇在”所指定的层时达到最大值。
如果“满速风扇在”低于“在最初的”，则会被忽略，此时风扇将在“在最初的” + 1 层处以允许的最大速度运行。

align_xy.label: Align XY
align_xy.tip: Align the model to the given point.

allow_mix_temp.label: Allow filaments with high/low temperature to be printed together
allow_mix_temp.tip: Allow filaments with high/low temperature to be printed together.

allow_multicolor_oneplate.label: Allow multiple colors on one plate
allow_multicolor_oneplate.tip: If enabled, Arrange will allow multiple colors on one plate.
allow_multicolor_oneplate.zh: 允许在一个打印板上使用多种颜色
allow_multicolor_oneplate.tip_zh: 如果启用，自动排列将允许在一个打印板上使用多种颜色

allow_newer_file.label: Allow 3MF with newer version to be sliced
allow_newer_file.tip: Allow 3MF with newer version to be sliced.
allow_newer_file.zh: 允许较新版本的 3MF 进行切片
allow_newer_file.tip_zh: 允许较新版本的 3MF 进行切片。

allow_rotations.label: Allow rotation when arranging
allow_rotations.tip: If enabled, Arrange will allow rotation when placing objects.
allow_rotations.tip_zh: 如果启用，排列功能将在放置对象时允许旋转。

arrange.label: Arrange Options
arrange.tip_zh: 摆放选项：0-关闭，1-开启，其他-自动

assemble.label: Assemble
assemble.tip: Arrange the supplied models in a plate and merge them in a single model in order to perform actions once.
assemble.tip_zh: 将提供的模型排列在一个盘上，并将它们合并为单个模型，以便执行一次操作。

autosave.label: Autosave
autosave.tip: Automatically export current configuration to the specified file.

avoid_extrusion_cali_region.label: Avoid extrusion calibrate region when arranging
avoid_extrusion_cali_region.tip: If enabled, Arrange will avoid extrusion calibrate region when placing objects.
avoid_extrusion_cali_region.zh: 排列时避开挤出校准区域
avoid_extrusion_cali_region.tip_zh: 如果启用，排列将在放置对象时，避开挤出校准区域。

center.label: Center
center.tip: Center the print around the given center.

chamber_minimal_temperature.label: Minimal
chamber_minimal_temperature.tip:
This is the chamber temperature at which printing should start, while the chamber continues heating toward the "Target" chamber temperature. For example, set the Target to 60 and the Minimal to 50 to begin printing once the chamber reaches 50°C, without waiting for the full 60°C.

It sets a G-code variable named chamber_minimal_temperature, which can be passed to your print start macro or a heat soak macro, like this: PRINT_START (other variables) CHAMBER_MIN_TEMP=[chamber_minimal_temperature].

Unlike the "Target" chamber temperature, this option does not emit any M141/M191 commands; it only exposes the value to your custom G-code. It should not exceed the "Target" chamber temperature.

chamber_temperature.label: Chamber temperature
chamber_temperature.tip:
For high-temperature materials like ABS, ASA, PC, and PA, a higher chamber temperature can help suppress or reduce warping and potentially lead to higher interlayer bonding strength. However, at the same time, a higher chamber temperature will reduce the efficiency of air filtration for ABS and ASA.

For PLA, PETG, TPU, PVA, and other low-temperature materials, this option should be disabled (set to 0) as the chamber temperature should be low to avoid extruder clogging caused by material softening at the heat break.

If enabled, this parameter also sets a G-code variable named chamber_temperature, which can be used to pass the desired chamber temperature to your print start macro, or a heat soak macro like this: PRINT_START (other variables) CHAMBER_TEMP=[chamber_temperature]. This may be useful if your printer does not support M141/M191 commands, or if you desire to handle heat soaking in the print start macro if no active chamber heater is installed.
chamber_temperature.tip_zh: 对于 ABS、ASA、PC 和 PA 等高温材料，较高的腔室温度有助于抑制或减少翘曲，并有可能提高层间粘合强度。但同时，较高的腔室温度会降低 ABS 和 ASA 的空气过滤效率。 对于 PLA、PETG、TPU、PVA 等低温材料，应禁用此选项（设置为 0），因为腔室温度应较低，以避免热断时材料软化导致挤出机堵塞。 如果启用，此参数还会设置一个名为 chamber_temple 的 G-code 变量，该变量可用于将所需的腔室温度传递给打印启动宏，或热浸宏，如下所示：PRINT_START（其他变量）CHAMBER_TEMP=[cham​​ber_Temperature]。如果您的打印机不支持 M141/M191 命令，或者如果您希望在未安装活动室加热器的情况下在打印启动宏中处理热浸，则这可能很有用。

clone_objects.label: Clone Objects
clone_objects.tip: Clone objects in the load list.
clone_objects.tip_zh: 复制加载列表中的对象。

close_additional_fan_first_x_layers.label: For the first
close_additional_fan_first_x_layers.tip: Set special auxiliary cooling fan for the first certain layers.
close_additional_fan_first_x_layers.tip_zh: 为起始几层设置特殊的辅助冷却风扇速度。

close_fan_the_first_x_layers.label: No cooling for the first
close_fan_the_first_x_layers.tip: Turn off all cooling fans for the first few layers. This can be used to improve build plate adhesion.
close_fan_the_first_x_layers.tip_zh: 对开始的一些层关闭所有的部件冷却风扇。通常关闭首层冷却用来获得更好的热床粘接

compatible_printers_condition.label: Condition
compatible_printers_condition.tip: A boolean expression using the configuration values of an active printer profile. If this expression evaluates to true, this profile is considered compatible with the active printer profile.
compatible_printers_condition.tip_zh: 使用活动打印机配置文件的配置值的布尔表达式。如果此表达式计算为 true,则此配置文件将被视为与活动打印机配置文件兼容。

compatible_prints_condition.label: Condition
compatible_prints_condition.tip: A boolean expression using the configuration values of an active print profile. If this expression evaluates to true, this profile is considered compatible with the active print profile.
compatible_prints_condition.tip_zh: 使用活动打印配置文件的配置值的布尔表达式。如果此表达式计算为 true,则此配置文件将被视为与活动打印配置文件兼容。

complete_print_exhaust_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
complete_print_exhaust_fan_speed.tip: Speed of exhaust fan after printing completes.
complete_print_exhaust_fan_speed.tip_zh: 打印完成后排气风扇的速度

config_compatibility.label: Forward-compatibility rule when loading configurations from config files and project files (3MF, AMF).
config_compatibility.tip: This version of OrcaSlicer may not understand configurations produced by the newest OrcaSlicer versions. For example, newer OrcaSlicer may extend the list of supported firmware flavors. One may decide to bail out or to substitute an unknown value with a default silently or verbosely.
vlbl: Bail out on unknown configuration values
Enable reading unknown configuration values by verbosely substituting them with defaults.
Enable reading unknown configuration values by silently substituting them with defaults.
vlbl_zh: Bail out on unknown configuration values
Enable reading unknown configuration values by verbosely substituting them with defaults.
Enable reading unknown configuration values by silently substituting them with defaults.

cool_plate_temp.label: Other layers
cool_plate_temp.tip: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Cool Plate.
cool_plate_temp.tip_zh: 非首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持低温打印热床

cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: First layer
cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip: Bed temperature of the first layer. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Cool Plate.
cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip_zh: 首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持低温打印热床

curr_bed_type.label: Bed type
curr_bed_type.tip: Bed types supported by the printer.
curr_bed_type.tip_zh: 打印机所支持的热床类型

current_extruder.label: Current extruder
current_extruder.tip: Zero-based index of currently used extruder.
current_extruder.tip_zh: 当前使用挤出机的索引编号。编号从零开始。

current_object_idx.label: Current object index
current_object_idx.tip: Specific for sequential printing. Zero-based index of currently printed object.
current_object_idx.tip_zh: 专门用于顺序打印。当前打印对象的索引编号，编号从零开始。

cut.label: Cut
cut.tip: Cut model at the given Z.

cut_grid.label: Cut
cut_grid.tip: Cut model in the XY plane into tiles of the specified max size.

cut_x.label: Cut
cut_x.tip: Cut model at the given X.

cut_y.label: Cut
cut_y.tip: Cut model at the given Y.

datadir.label: Data directory
datadir.tip: Load and store settings at the given directory. This is useful for maintaining different profiles or including configurations from a network storage.
datadir.tip_zh: 在指定目录加载和存储设置。这对于维护不同的配置文件、或含有网络路径的配置文件非常有用。

default_filament_colour.label: Default color
default_filament_colour.tip:
Default filament color.
Right click to reset value to system default.
default_filament_colour.tip_zh:
默认耗材颜色。
右键单击以将值重置为系统默认值。

dont_slow_down_outer_wall.label: Don't slow down outer walls
dont_slow_down_outer_wall.tip:
If enabled, this setting will ensure external perimeters are not slowed down to meet the minimum layer time. This is particularly helpful in the below scenarios:
1. To avoid changes in shine when printing glossy filaments
2. To avoid changes in external wall speed which may create slight wall artifacts that appear like Z banding
3. To avoid printing at speeds which cause VFAs (fine artifacts) on the external walls
dont_slow_down_outer_wall.tip_zh:
如果启用，此设置将确保外墙不会为了满足最小层时间而减速。这在以下情况下特别有帮助：
1. 避免在打印光滑耗材时改变光泽
2. 避免改变外墙速度，可能会产生轻微的墙壁伪影，看起来像z条纹
3. 避免以会在外墙上产生VFAs（细微伪影）的速度打印

downward_check.label: Downward machines check
downward_check.tip: If enabled, check whether current machine downward compatible with the machines in the list.
downward_check.tip_zh: 如果启用，检查当前的机器是否向下兼容列表中的机器。

downward_settings.label: Downward machines settings
downward_settings.tip: The machine settings list needs to do downward checking.
downward_settings.tip_zh: 需要检查向下兼容状况的机器列表。

draft_shield.label: Draft shield
draft_shield.tip:
A draft shield is useful to protect an ABS or ASA print from warping and detaching from print bed due to wind draft. It is usually needed only with open frame printers, i.e. without an enclosure.

Enabled = skirt is as tall as the highest printed object. Otherwise 'Skirt height' is used.
Note: With the draft shield active, the skirt will be printed at skirt distance from the object. Therefore, if brims are active it may intersect with them. To avoid this, increase the skirt distance value.
draft_shield.tip_zh:
风挡对于保护ABS或ASA打印件免受风力的影响，防止翘曲和从打印床上脱落是非常有用的。通常只有在没有封箱的开放式打印机上才需要。

启用 = 裙边的高度与最高的打印对象一样高。否则的话会使用'裙边高度'。
注意：启用风挡后，裙边将会在距离模型'裙边距离'的地方打印。因此，如果brim启用，可能会与其相交。为了避免这种情况，增加裙边距离值。

duplicate_grid.label: Duplicate by grid
duplicate_grid.tip: Multiply copies by creating a grid.

during_print_exhaust_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
during_print_exhaust_fan_speed.tip: Speed of exhaust fan during printing. This speed will override the speed in filament custom G-code.
during_print_exhaust_fan_speed.tip_zh: 打印过程中排气风扇的速度。此速度将覆盖耗材丝自定义G-code中的速度。

e_position.label: Absolute E position
e_position.tip: Current position of the extruder axis. Only used with absolute extruder addressing.
e_position.tip_zh: 挤出机轴的当前位置。仅与绝对式挤出机寻址一起使用。

e_restart_extra.label: Extra de-retraction
e_restart_extra.tip: Currently planned extra extruder priming after de-retraction.
e_restart_extra.tip_zh: 在当前挤出头在装填后，进行额外的预挤出。

e_retracted.label: Retraction
e_retracted.tip: Retraction state at the beginning of the custom G-code block. If the custom G-code moves the extruder axis, it should write to this variable so OrcaSlicer de-retracts correctly when it gets control back.
e_retracted.tip_zh: 自定义 G-code 块开始时的回抽状态。如果自定义 G-code 移动了挤出轴，应将该轴状态写入此变量，以便 OrcaSlicer 在重新取得控制时能够正确重装填

enable_arc_fitting.label: Arc fitting
enable_arc_fitting.tip:
Enable this to get a G-code file which has G2 and G3 moves. The fitting tolerance is same as the resolution.

Note: For Klipper machines, this option is recommended to be disabled. Klipper does not benefit from arc commands as these are split again into line segments by the firmware. This results in a reduction in surface quality as line segments are converted to arcs by the slicer and then back to line segments by the firmware.
enable_arc_fitting.tip_zh:
启用后，导出的 G-code 将包含 G2 和 G3 指令。圆弧拟合的公差将与精度相同。
请注意：对于使用Klipper固件的打印机，建议禁用此选项。Klipper固件不会从圆弧拟合中受益，因为此命令会被固件再次分割为线段。
在切片软件将线段转换为圆弧后，若再被固件转换为线段，将导致打印件表面质量下降。

enable_filament_dynamic_map.label: Enable filament dynamic map
enable_filament_dynamic_map.tip: Enable dynamic filament mapping during print.
enable_filament_dynamic_map.tip_zh: 在打印期间启用动态耗材映射。

enable_overhang_bridge_fan.label: Force cooling for overhangs and bridges
enable_overhang_bridge_fan.tip: Enable this option to allow adjustment of the part cooling fan speed for specifically for overhangs, internal and external bridges. Setting the fan speed specifically for these features can improve overall print quality and reduce warping.
enable_overhang_bridge_fan.tip_zh: 启用此选项以允许单独针对悬垂、内部桥接和外部桥接调整部件冷却风扇的速度。针对这些特性设置风扇速度可以提高整体打印质量并减少翘曲。

enable_pressure_advance.label: Enable pressure advance
enable_pressure_advance.tip: Enable pressure advance, auto calibration result will be overwritten once enabled.
enable_pressure_advance.tip_zh: 启用压力提前，一旦启用会覆盖自动检测的结果

enable_prime_tower.label: Enable
enable_prime_tower.tip: The wiping tower can be used to clean up the residue on the nozzle and stabilize the chamber pressure inside the nozzle, in order to avoid appearance defects when printing objects.
enable_prime_tower.tip_zh: 擦拭塔可以用来清理喷嘴上的残留料和让喷嘴内部的腔压达到稳定状态，以避免打印物体时出现外观瑕疵。

enable_timelapse.label: Enable timelapse for print
enable_timelapse.tip: If enabled, this slicing will be considered using timelapse.
enable_timelapse.tip_zh: 如果启用，此切片将被视为使用延时摄影。

enable_tower_interface_cooldown_during_t.label: Cool down from interface boost during prime tower
enable_tower_interface_cooldown_during_t.tip: When interface-layer temperature boost is active, set the nozzle back to print temperature at the start of the prime tower so it cools down during the tower.
enable_tower_interface_cooldown_during_t.zh: 擦拭塔期间从接触层加速状态冷却
enable_tower_interface_cooldown_during_t.tip_zh: 当接触层温度提升处于活动状态时，在擦拭塔开始时将喷嘴温度恢复到打印温度，以便在打印塔期间降温。

enable_tower_interface_features.label: Enable tower interface features
enable_tower_interface_features.tip: Enable optimized prime tower interface behavior when different materials meet.
enable_tower_interface_features.zh: 启用擦拭塔接触层功能
enable_tower_interface_features.tip_zh: 启用优化后的擦拭塔接触层行为，用于不同耗材丝相遇时。

eng_plate_temp.label: Other layers
eng_plate_temp.tip: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Engineering Plate.
eng_plate_temp.tip_zh: 非首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持工程材料热床

eng_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: First layer
eng_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip: Bed temperature of the first layer. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Engineering Plate.
eng_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip_zh: 首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持工程材料热床

ensure_on_bed.label: Ensure on bed
ensure_on_bed.tip: Lift the object above the bed when it is partially below. Disabled by default.
ensure_on_bed.tip_zh: 当对象有部位超出热床的下方时，将对象提升到热床的上方。默认为禁用

exclude_object.label: Exclude objects
exclude_object.tip: Enable this option to add EXCLUDE OBJECT command in G-code.
exclude_object.tip_zh: 启用此选项以在G-code中添加EXCLUDE OBJECT命令。

export_gcode.label: Export G-code
export_gcode.tip: Slice the model and export toolpaths as G-code.

export_sla.label: Export SLA
export_sla.tip: Slice the model and export SLA printing layers as PNG.

export_slicedata.label: Export slicing data
export_slicedata.tip: Export slicing data to a folder.

export_stl.label: Export STL
export_stl.tip: Export the objects as single STL.

export_stls.label: Export multiple STLs
export_stls.tip: Export the objects as multiple STLs to directory.
export_stls.tip_zh: 将对象导出为多个STL到目录。

export_svg.label: Export SVG
export_svg.tip: Slice the model and export solid slices as SVG.

extruded_volume.label: Volume per extruder
extruded_volume.tip: Total filament volume extruded per extruder during the entire print.
extruded_volume.tip_zh: 整个打印过程中每个挤出机挤出的总耗材体积

extruded_volume_total.label: Total volume
extruded_volume_total.tip: Total volume of filament used during the entire print.
extruded_volume_total.tip_zh: 整个打印过程中使用的耗材总体积。

extruded_weight.label: Weight per extruder
extruded_weight.tip: Weight per extruder extruded during the entire print. Calculated from filament_density value in Filament Settings.
extruded_weight.tip_zh: 整个打印过程中各个挤出机所挤出的重量。根据耗材设置中的耗材密度值计算。

extruded_weight_total.label: Total weight
extruded_weight_total.tip: Total weight of the print. Calculated from filament_density value in Filament Settings.
extruded_weight_total.tip_zh: 打印件的总重量。根据耗材设置中的耗材密度值计算。

extrusion_rate_smoothing_external_perime.label: Apply only on external features
extrusion_rate_smoothing_external_perime.tip: Applies extrusion rate smoothing only on external perimeters and overhangs. This can help reduce artefacts due to sharp speed transitions on externally visible overhangs without impacting the print speed of features that will not be visible to the user.
extrusion_rate_smoothing_external_perime.tip_zh: 仅对外周和悬伸应用挤出速率平滑。这有助于减少由于外部可见突出部分上的急剧速度过渡而导致的伪影，而不会影响用户不可见的特征的打印速度。

fan_cooling_layer_time.label: Layer time
fan_cooling_layer_time.tip: Part cooling fan will be enabled for layers of which estimated time is shorter than this value. Fan speed is interpolated between the minimum and maximum fan speeds according to layer printing time.
fan_cooling_layer_time.tip_zh: 当层预估打印时间小于该数值时，部件冷却风扇将会被开启。风扇转速将根据层打印时间在最大和最小风扇转速之间插值获得

fan_max_speed.label: Fan speed
fan_max_speed.tip: Part cooling fan speed may be increased when auto cooling is enabled. This is the maximum speed for the part cooling fan.
fan_max_speed.tip_zh: 启用自动冷却时，可能会提高部件冷却风扇的转速。这是部件冷却风扇的最大速度限制

fan_min_speed.label: Fan speed
fan_min_speed.tip: Minimum speed for part cooling fan.
fan_min_speed.tip_zh: 部件冷却风扇的最小转速

filament_adaptive_volumetric_speed.label: Adaptive volumetric speed
filament_adaptive_volumetric_speed.tip:
When enabled, the extrusion flow is limited by the smaller of the fitted value (calculated from line width and layer height) and the user-defined maximum flow. When disabled, only the user-defined maximum flow is applied.

Note: Experimental and incomplete feature imported from BBS. Functional for some profiles that already have the variable saved.
filament_adaptive_volumetric_speed.tip_zh:
启用后，挤出流量受到拟合值（根据线宽和层高计算）和用户定义的最大流量中较小者的限制。禁用时，仅应用用户定义的最大流量。

注意：从 BBS 导入的实验性和不完整功能。对于某些已保存该变量的配置文件有效。

filament_change_extrusion_role_gcode.label: Change extrusion role G-code (filament)
filament_change_extrusion_role_gcode.tip: This G-code is inserted when the extrusion role is changed for the active filament.
filament_change_extrusion_role_gcode.zh: 挤出类型更换 G-code（耗材）
filament_change_extrusion_role_gcode.tip_zh: 当当前耗材的挤出类型发生变化时插入此 G-code。

filament_change_length.label: Filament ramming length
filament_change_length.tip: When changing the extruder, it is recommended to extrude a certain length of filament from the original extruder. This helps minimize nozzle oozing.
filament_change_length.tip_zh: 在切换挤出机时，使原先挤出机额外挤出一段耗材，有助耗材末端抽出完整，并减少待命时的喷嘴渗料。

filament_colour.label: Color
filament_colour.tip: Only used as a visual help on UI.
filament_colour.tip_zh: 只作为界面上的可视化辅助

filament_cooling_before_tower.label: Wipe tower cooling
filament_cooling_before_tower.tip: Temperature drop before entering filament tower
filament_cooling_before_tower.tip_zh: 进入擦料塔前的降温量

filament_cooling_final_speed.label: Speed of the last cooling move
filament_cooling_final_speed.tip: Cooling moves are gradually accelerating towards this speed.
filament_cooling_final_speed.zh: 最后一次冷却移动的速度
filament_cooling_final_speed.tip_zh: 冷却移动向这个速度逐渐加速。

filament_cooling_initial_speed.label: Speed of the first cooling move
filament_cooling_initial_speed.tip: Cooling moves are gradually accelerating beginning at this speed.
filament_cooling_initial_speed.zh: 第一次冷却移动的速度
filament_cooling_initial_speed.tip_zh: 从这个速度开始冷却移动逐渐加速

filament_cooling_moves.label: Number of cooling moves
filament_cooling_moves.tip: Filament is cooled by being moved back and forth in the cooling tubes. Specify desired number of these moves.
filament_cooling_moves.tip_zh: 耗材丝通过在喉管中来回移动来冷却。指定所需的移动次数。

filament_cost.label: Price
filament_cost.tip_zh: 耗材丝的价格。只用于统计信息。

filament_density.label: Density
filament_density.tip_zh: 耗材丝的密度。只用于统计信息。

filament_diameter.label: Diameter
filament_diameter.tip: Filament diameter is used to calculate extrusion in G-code, so it is important and should be accurate.
filament_diameter.tip_zh: 耗材丝直径被用于计算G-code文件中的挤出量。因此很重要，应尽可能精确。

filament_end_gcode.label: End G-code
filament_end_gcode.tip: End G-code when finishing the printing of this filament.
filament_end_gcode.tip_zh: 结束使用该耗材打印时的结尾G-code

filament_extruder_id.label: Filament extruder ID
filament_extruder_id.tip: The current extruder ID. The same as current_extruder.

filament_flow_ratio.label: Flow ratio
filament_flow_ratio.tip: The material may have volumetric change after switching between molten and crystalline states. This setting changes all extrusion flow of this filament in G-code proportionally. The recommended value range is between 0.95 and 1.05. You may be able to tune this value to get a nice flat surface if there is slight overflow or underflow.
filament_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 材料经过融化后凝固可能会产生体积差异。这个设置会等比例改变所有挤出走线的挤出量。推荐的范围为0.95到1.05。发现大平层模型的顶面有轻微的缺料或多料时，或许可以尝试微调这个参数。

filament_flush_temp.label: Flush temperature
filament_flush_temp.tip: Temperature when flushing filament. 0 indicates the upper bound of the recommended nozzle temperature range.
filament_flush_temp.tip_zh: 冲洗耗材丝时的温度。 0 表示推荐喷嘴温度范围的上限。

filament_flush_volumetric_speed.label: Flush volumetric speed
filament_flush_volumetric_speed.tip: Volumetric speed when flushing filament. 0 indicates the max volumetric speed.
filament_flush_volumetric_speed.tip_zh: 冲洗耗材丝时的体积流量。 0 表示最大体积流量。

filament_is_support.label: Support material
filament_is_support.tip: Support material is commonly used to print supports and support interfaces.
filament_is_support.tip_zh: 支撑材料通常用于打印支撑体和支撑接触面

filament_loading_speed.label: Loading speed
filament_loading_speed.tip: Speed used for loading the filament on the wipe tower.
filament_loading_speed.tip_zh: 用于擦拭塔加载耗材的速度。

filament_loading_speed_start.label: Loading speed at the start
filament_loading_speed_start.tip: Speed used at the very beginning of loading phase.
filament_loading_speed_start.tip_zh: 最开始加载阶段的速度

filament_map_mode.label: filament mapping mode
filament_map_mode.tip: Filament mapping mode used as plate param.

filament_max_volumetric_speed.label: Max volumetric speed
filament_max_volumetric_speed.tip: This setting stands for how much volume of filament can be melted and extruded per second. Printing speed is limited by max volumetric speed, in case of too high and unreasonable speed setting. Can't be zero.
filament_max_volumetric_speed.tip_zh: 这个设置表示在1秒内能够融化和挤出的耗材丝体积。打印速度会受到最大体积流量的限制，防止设置过高和不合理的速度。不允许设置为0。

filament_minimal_purge_on_wipe_tower.label: Minimal purge on wipe tower
filament_minimal_purge_on_wipe_tower.tip: After a tool change, the exact position of the newly loaded filament inside the nozzle may not be known, and the filament pressure is likely not yet stable. Before purging the print head into an infill or a sacrificial object, Orca Slicer will always prime this amount of material into the wipe tower to produce successive infill or sacrificial object extrusions reliably.
filament_minimal_purge_on_wipe_tower.zh: 擦拭塔上的最小清理量
filament_minimal_purge_on_wipe_tower.tip_zh: 换色后，新加载的耗材在喷嘴内的确切位置可能未知，耗材压力可能还不稳定。在冲刷打印头到填充或作为挤出废料之前，Orca Slicer将始终将这些的耗材丝冲刷到擦拭塔中以产生连续的填充或稳定的挤出废料。

filament_multitool_ramming.label: Enable ramming for multi-tool setups
filament_multitool_ramming.tip: Perform ramming when using multi-tool printer (i.e. when the 'Single Extruder Multimaterial' in Printer Settings is unchecked). When checked, a small amount of filament is rapidly extruded on the wipe tower just before the tool change. This option is only used when the wipe tower is enabled.
filament_multitool_ramming.zh: 启用多色尖端成型设置
filament_multitool_ramming.tip_zh: 多色打印机执行尖端成型时（即，当打印机设置中的单挤出机多材料未选中时）。选中时，在换色之前，会迅速挤出少量耗材丝到擦拭塔上。此选项仅在启用擦拭塔时使用。

filament_multitool_ramming_flow.label: Multi-tool ramming flow
filament_multitool_ramming_flow.tip: Flow used for ramming the filament before the tool change.
filament_multitool_ramming_flow.tip_zh: 换色前耗材尖端成型的流量

filament_multitool_ramming_volume.label: Multi-tool ramming volume
filament_multitool_ramming_volume.tip: The volume to be rammed before the tool change.
filament_multitool_ramming_volume.tip_zh: 换色前尖端成型的体积

filament_notes.label: Filament notes
filament_notes.tip: You can put your notes regarding the filament here.
filament_notes.tip_zh: 你可以把关于耗材的注释放在这里。

filament_preset.label: Filament preset name
filament_preset.tip: Names of the filament presets used for slicing. The variable is a vector containing one name for each extruder.
filament_preset.tip_zh: 用于切片的耗材预设的名称。该变量是一个向量，包含每个挤出机的名称。

filament_printable.label: Filament printable
filament_printable.tip: The filament is printable in extruder.
filament_printable.tip_zh: 此耗材可通过挤出机打印

filament_ramming_parameters.label: Ramming parameters
filament_ramming_parameters.tip: This string is edited by RammingDialog and contains ramming specific parameters.
filament_ramming_parameters.tip_zh: 此内容由尖端成型窗口编辑，包含尖端成型的特定参数。

filament_shrink.label: Shrinkage (XY)
filament_shrink.tip:
Enter the shrinkage percentage that the filament will get after cooling (94% if you measure 94mm instead of 100mm). The part will be scaled in XY to compensate. For multi-material prints, ensure filament shrinkage matches across all used filaments
Be sure to allow enough space between objects, as this compensation is done after the checks.
filament_shrink.tip_zh:
冷却后耗材会收缩的百分比(如果测量的长度是94mm而不是100mm，则为是收缩率为94%)
补偿将按比例缩放xy轴该补偿仅考虑墙壁所使用的耗材
请确保物体之间有足够的间距，因为补偿是在边界检查之后进行

filament_shrinkage_compensation_z.label: Shrinkage (Z)
filament_shrinkage_compensation_z.tip: Enter the shrinkage percentage that the filament will get after cooling (94% if you measure 94mm instead of 100mm). The part will be scaled in Z to compensate.
filament_shrinkage_compensation_z.tip_zh:
冷却后耗材会收缩的百分比(如果测量的长度是94mm而不是100mm，则为是收缩率为94%)
补偿将按比例缩放Z轴

filament_soluble.label: Soluble material
filament_soluble.tip: Soluble material is commonly used to print supports and support interfaces.
filament_soluble.tip_zh: 可溶性材料通常用于打印支撑和支撑面

filament_stamping_distance.label: Stamping distance measured from the center of the cooling tube
filament_stamping_distance.tip: If set to non-zero value, filament is moved toward the nozzle between the individual cooling moves ("stamping"). This option configures how long this movement should be before the filament is retracted again.
filament_stamping_distance.zh: 从冷却管中心测量的尖端成型距离
filament_stamping_distance.tip_zh: 如果设置为非零值，则在各个冷却移动之间耗材会向喷嘴方向移动（“印模”）。该选项用于配置耗材在重新回抽前应移动多长时间。

filament_start_gcode.label: Start G-code
filament_start_gcode.tip: Start G-code when starting the printing of this filament.
filament_start_gcode.tip_zh: 开始使用这个耗材丝打印的起始G-code

filament_toolchange_delay.label: Delay after unloading
filament_toolchange_delay.tip: Time to wait after the filament is unloaded. May help to get reliable tool changes with flexible materials that may need more time to shrink to original dimensions.
filament_toolchange_delay.tip_zh: 耗材丝卸载后等待的时间。有助于柔性材料（收缩到原始尺寸需更多的时间）以获得可靠的换色。

filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_d.label: Interface layer pre-extrusion distance
filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_d.tip: Pre-extrusion distance for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet).
filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_d.tip_zh: 擦拭塔接触层（不同耗材丝相遇处）的预挤出距离。

filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_l.label: Interface layer pre-extrusion length
filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_l.tip: Pre-extrusion length for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet).
filament_tower_interface_pre_extrusion_l.tip_zh: 擦拭塔接触层（不同耗材丝相遇处）的预挤出长度。

filament_tower_interface_print_temp.label: Interface layer print temperature
filament_tower_interface_print_temp.tip: Print temperature for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet). If set to -1, use max recommended nozzle temperature.
filament_tower_interface_print_temp.tip_zh: 擦拭塔接触层（不同耗材丝相遇处）的打印温度。如果设置为 -1，则使用最大推荐喷嘴温度。

filament_tower_interface_purge_volume.label: Interface layer purge length
filament_tower_interface_purge_volume.tip: Purge length for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet).
filament_tower_interface_purge_volume.tip_zh: 擦拭塔接触层（不同耗材丝相遇处）的冲刷长度。

filament_tower_ironing_area.label: Tower ironing area
filament_tower_ironing_area.tip: Ironing area for prime tower interface layer (where different materials meet).
filament_tower_ironing_area.tip_zh: 擦拭塔接触层（不同耗材丝相遇处）的熨烫区域。

filament_unloading_speed.label: Unloading speed
filament_unloading_speed.tip: Speed used for unloading the filament on the wipe tower (does not affect initial part of unloading just after ramming).
filament_unloading_speed.tip_zh: 用于擦拭塔卸载耗材的速度（不影响尖端成型之后初始部分的速度）。

filament_unloading_speed_start.label: Unloading speed at the start
filament_unloading_speed_start.tip: Speed used for unloading the tip of the filament immediately after ramming.
filament_unloading_speed_start.tip_zh: 耗材尖端成型后立即卸载的速度

filament_vendor.label: Vendor
filament_vendor.tip: Vendor of filament. For show only.
filament_vendor.tip_zh: 打印耗材的供应商。仅用于展示。

filename_format.label: Filename format
filename_format.tip: Users can define the project file name when exporting.
filename_format.tip_zh: 用户可以自定义导出项目文件的名称。

first_layer_print_convex_hull.label: First layer convex hull
first_layer_print_convex_hull.tip: Vector of points of the first layer convex hull. Each element has the following format:'[x, y]' (x and y are floating-point numbers in mm).
first_layer_print_convex_hull.tip_zh: 第一层凸包的点向量。每个元素的格式如下：'[x, y]'（x 和 y 是以 mm 为单位的浮点数）。

first_layer_print_max.label: Top-right corner of the first layer bounding box
first_layer_print_max.zh: 第一层边界框的右上角

first_layer_print_min.label: Bottom-left corner of the first layer bounding box
first_layer_print_min.zh: 第一层边界框的左下角

first_layer_print_size.label: Size of the first layer bounding box

first_x_layer_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
first_x_layer_fan_speed.tip: Special auxiliary cooling fan speed, effective only for the first x layers.
first_x_layer_fan_speed.tip_zh: 特殊辅助冷却风扇速度，仅对前 x 层有效。

flashforge_serial_number.label: Serial Number
flashforge_serial_number.tip: Flashforge local API requires the printer serial number.
flashforge_serial_number.tip_zh: Flashforge 本地 API 需要打印机序列号。

flush_multiplier.label: Flush multiplier
flush_multiplier.tip: The actual flushing volumes is equal to the flush multiplier multiplied by the flushing volumes in the table.
flush_multiplier.tip_zh: 实际冲刷量等于冲刷量乘数乘以表格单元中的冲刷量

flush_volumes_matrix.label: Purging volumes
flush_volumes_matrix.tip: This matrix describes volumes (in cubic millimeters) required to purge the new filament on the wipe tower for any given pair of tools.

flush_volumes_vector.label: Purging volumes - load/unload volumes
flush_volumes_vector.tip: This vector saves required volumes to change from/to each tool used on the wipe tower. These values are used to simplify creation of the full purging volumes below.
flush_volumes_vector.zh: 清理量 - 加载/卸载量
flush_volumes_vector.tip_zh: 此矢量可保存所需的体积，用于更改每个擦拭塔上工具所使用的from/to体积 。这些值用于简化完全冲刷体积的创建。

full_fan_speed_layer.label: Full fan speed at layer
full_fan_speed_layer.tip: Fan speed will be ramped up linearly from zero at layer "close_fan_the_first_x_layers" to maximum at layer "full_fan_speed_layer". "full_fan_speed_layer" will be ignored if lower than "close_fan_the_first_x_layers", in which case the fan will be running at maximum allowed speed at layer "close_fan_the_first_x_layers" + 1.
full_fan_speed_layer.tip_zh:
风扇速度将从“禁用第一层”的零转速，线性上升到“全风扇速度层”的最大转速。
如果低于“禁用风扇第一层”，则“全风扇速度第一层”将被忽略，在这种情况下，风扇将在“禁用风扇第一层”的后续一层以最大允许速度运行。

gcode_add_line_number.label: Add line number
gcode_add_line_number.tip: Enable this to add line number(Nx) at the beginning of each G-code line.
gcode_add_line_number.tip_zh: 启用该设置，G-code的每一行的开头会增加Nx标注行号。

gcode_comments.label: Verbose G-code
gcode_comments.tip: Enable this to get a commented G-code file, with each line explained by a descriptive text. If you print from SD card, the additional weight of the file could make your firmware slow down.
gcode_comments.tip_zh: 启用此选项，将获得带有注释的G-code文件，每行都附带文本注释。若您从SD卡打印，文件的额外内容可能会增加您的固件的负担。

gcode_label_objects.label: Label objects
gcode_label_objects.tip: Enable this to add comments into the G-code labeling print moves with what object they belong to, which is useful for the Octoprint CancelObject plug-in. This setting is NOT compatible with Single Extruder Multi Material setup and Wipe into Object / Wipe into Infill.
gcode_label_objects.tip_zh: 启用此选项，将在G-code中添加注释，标记打印移动属于哪个对象，这对Octoprint CancelObject插件非常有用。此设置与单挤出机多材料设置和擦拭到对象/擦拭到填充不兼容。

gcodeviewer.label: G-code viewer
gcodeviewer.tip: Visualize an already sliced and saved G-code.

has_filament_switcher.label: Has filament switcher
has_filament_switcher.tip: Printer has a filament switcher hardware (e.g., AMS).
has_filament_switcher.tip_zh: 打印机具有耗材切换器硬件（例如 AMS）。

has_single_extruder_multi_material_primi.label: Has single extruder MM priming
has_single_extruder_multi_material_primi.tip: Are the extra multi-material priming regions used in this print?
has_single_extruder_multi_material_primi.zh: 单挤出机多材料预挤出
has_single_extruder_multi_material_primi.tip_zh: 此打印中是否使用额外的多材料预注区域？

has_wipe_tower.label: Has wipe tower
has_wipe_tower.tip: Whether or not wipe tower is being generated in the print.
has_wipe_tower.tip_zh: 打印中是否生成擦拭塔。

help_fff.label: Help (FFF options)
help_fff.tip: Show the full list of print/G-code configuration options.

help_sla.label: Help (SLA options)
help_sla.tip: Show the full list of SLA print configuration options.

hot_plate_temp.label: Other layers
hot_plate_temp.tip: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the High Temp Plate.
hot_plate_temp.tip_zh: 非首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持高温打印热床

hot_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: First layer
hot_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip: Bed temperature of the first layer. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the High Temp Plate.
hot_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip_zh: 首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持高温打印热床

idle_temperature.label: Idle temperature
idle_temperature.tip: Nozzle temperature when the tool is currently not used in multi-tool setups. This is only used when 'Ooze prevention' is active in Print Settings. Set to 0 to disable.
idle_temperature.tip_zh: 在多工具设置中，当前未使用的工具的喷嘴温度。这仅在打印设置中启用'防滴漏'时使用。设置为0以禁用。

ignore_nonexistent_config.label: Ignore non-existent config files
ignore_nonexistent_config.tip: Do not fail if a file supplied to --load does not exist.

initial_extruder.label: Initial extruder
initial_extruder.tip: Zero-based index of the first extruder used in the print. Same as initial_tool.
initial_extruder.tip_zh: 打印中使用的第一个挤出机的从零开始的索引。与初始工具相同。

initial_filament_type.label: Initial filament type
initial_filament_type.tip: String containing filament type of the first used extruder.

initial_layer_infill_speed.label: First layer infill
initial_layer_infill_speed.tip: Speed of solid infill part of the first layer.
initial_layer_infill_speed.tip_zh: 首层实心填充的打印速度

initial_layer_speed.label: First layer
initial_layer_speed.tip: Speed of the first layer except the solid infill part.
initial_layer_speed.tip_zh: 首层除实心填充之外的其他部分的打印速度

initial_layer_travel_acceleration.label: First layer travel
initial_layer_travel_acceleration.tip:
Travel acceleration of first layer.
The percentage value is relative to Travel Acceleration.
initial_layer_travel_acceleration.tip_zh:
首层的空驶加速度。
百分比值相对于空驶加速度。

initial_layer_travel_jerk.label: First layer travel
initial_layer_travel_jerk.tip:
Travel jerk of first layer.
The percentage value is relative to Travel Jerk.
initial_layer_travel_jerk.tip_zh:
首层的空驶抖动。
百分比值相对于空驶抖动。

initial_tool.label: Initial tool
initial_tool.tip: Zero-based index of the first extruder used in the print. Same as initial_extruder.
initial_tool.tip_zh: 打印中使用的第一个挤出机的从零开始的索引。与 initial_extruder 相同。

input_filename_base.label: Input filename without extension
input_filename_base.tip: Source filename of the first object, without extension.
input_filename_base.tip_zh: 第一个对象的源文件名，无扩展名。

input_shaping_damp_x.label: X
input_shaping_damp_x.tip:
Damping ratio for the X axis input shaper.
Zero will use the firmware damping ratio.
To disable input shaping, use the Disable type.
RRF: X and Y values are equal.
input_shaping_damp_x.tip_zh:
X 轴输入整形器的阻尼比。
为零时将使用固件阻尼比。
要禁用输入整形，请使用“禁用”类型。
RRF：X 和 Y 的值相等。

input_shaping_damp_y.label: Y
input_shaping_damp_y.tip:
Damping ratio for the Y axis input shaper.
Zero will use the firmware damping ratio.
To disable input shaping, use the Disable type.
input_shaping_damp_y.tip_zh:
Y 轴输入整形器的阻尼比。
为零时将使用固件阻尼比。
要禁用输入整形，请使用“禁用”类型。

input_shaping_emit.label: Emit input shaping
input_shaping_emit.tip:
Override firmware input shaping settings.
If disabled, firmware settings are used.
input_shaping_emit.tip_zh:
覆盖固件的输入整形设置。
如果禁用，则使用固件设置。

input_shaping_freq_x.label: X
input_shaping_freq_x.tip:
Resonant frequency for the X axis input shaper.
Zero will use the firmware frequency.
To disable input shaping, use the Disable type.
RRF: X and Y values are equal.
input_shaping_freq_x.tip_zh:
X 轴输入整形器的谐振频率。
为零时将使用固件频率。
要禁用输入整形，请使用“禁用”类型。
RRF：X 和 Y 的值相等。

input_shaping_freq_y.label: Y
input_shaping_freq_y.tip:
Resonant frequency for the Y axis input shaper.
Zero will use the firmware frequency.
To disable input shaping, use the Disable type.
input_shaping_freq_y.tip_zh:
Y 轴输入整形器的谐振频率。
为零时将使用固件频率。
要禁用输入整形，请使用“禁用”类型。

input_shaping_type.label: Input shaper type
input_shaping_type.tip:
Choose the input shaper algorithm.
Default uses the firmware default settings.
Disable turns off input shaping in the firmware.
input_shaping_type.tip_zh:
选择输入整形器算法。
“默认”使用固件的默认设置。
“禁用”将关闭固件中的输入整形。

internal_bridge_fan_speed.label: Internal bridges fan speed
internal_bridge_fan_speed.tip:
The part cooling fan speed used for all internal bridges. Set to -1 to use the overhang fan speed settings instead.

Reducing the internal bridges fan speed, compared to your regular fan speed, can help reduce part warping due to excessive cooling applied over a large surface for a prolonged period of time.
internal_bridge_fan_speed.tip_zh:
用于所有内部桥接的部件冷却风扇转速。设置为 -1 时，将采用悬垂时风扇转速设置。
与常规转速相比，若降低内部桥接风扇转速，有助缓解长时间大面积施加过度冷却而引起的零件变形。

ironing_fan_speed.label: Ironing fan speed
ironing_fan_speed.tip:
This part cooling fan speed is applied when ironing. Setting this parameter to a lower than regular speed reduces possible nozzle clogging due to the low volumetric flow rate, making the interface smoother.
Set to -1 to disable it.
ironing_fan_speed.tip_zh:
熨烫时的部件风扇转速。
设为低于平常的转速，将有助缓解长时间低流量打印的堵头问题。设置为 -1 以停用此功能。

is_extruder_used.label: Is extruder used?
is_extruder_used.tip: Vector of booleans stating whether a given extruder is used in the print.
is_extruder_used.tip_zh: 布尔值向量，说明打印中是否使用给定的挤出机。

layer_num.label: Layer number
layer_num.tip: Index of the current layer. One-based (i.e. first layer is number 1).
layer_num.tip_zh: 当前层编号。从 1 开始编号（即第一层编号为 1）。

layer_z.label: Layer Z
layer_z.tip: Height of the current layer above the print bed, measured to the top of the layer.
layer_z.tip_zh: 打印床上方当前层的高度，测量到层的顶部。

load.label: Load config file
load.tip: Load configuration from the specified file. It can be used more than once to load options from multiple files.

load_assemble_list.label: Load assemble list
load_assemble_list.tip: Load assemble object list from config file.
load_assemble_list.tip_zh: 从配置文件加载组合对象列表。

load_custom_gcodes.label: Load custom G-code
load_custom_gcodes.tip_zh: 从 json 文件加载自定义 G-code

load_defaultfila.label: Load default filaments
load_defaultfila.tip: Load first filament as default for those not loaded.
load_defaultfila.tip_zh: 加载第一个耗材为默认材料

load_filament_ids.label: Load filament IDs
load_filament_ids.tip: Load filament IDs for each object.

load_filaments.label: Load Filament Settings
load_filaments.tip: Load filament settings from the specified file list.
load_filaments.tip_zh: 从指定文件加载耗材设置

load_settings.label: Load General Settings
load_settings.tip: Load process/machine settings from the specified file.
load_settings.tip_zh: 从指定文件加载工艺/打印机设置

load_slicedata.label: Load slicing data
load_slicedata.tip: Load cached slicing data from directory.
load_slicedata.tip_zh: 从目录导入缓存的切片数据

logfile.label: Log file
logfile.tip_zh: 将调试日志重定向到文件。

makerlab_name.label: MakerLab name
makerlab_name.tip_zh: 生成此 3MF 的 MakerLab 名称。

makerlab_version.label: MakerLab version
makerlab_version.tip_zh: 生成此 3MF 的 MakerLab 版本。

max_layer_z.label: Maximal layer Z
max_layer_z.tip: Height of the last layer above the print bed.
max_layer_z.tip_zh: 最顶层相对打印板高度

max_volumetric_extrusion_rate_slope.label: Extrusion rate smoothing
max_volumetric_extrusion_rate_slope.tip:
This parameter smooths out sudden extrusion rate changes that happen when the printer transitions from printing a high flow (high speed/larger width) extrusion to a lower flow (lower speed/smaller width) extrusion and vice versa.

It defines the maximum rate by which the extruded volumetric flow in mm³/s can change over time. Higher values mean higher extrusion rate changes are allowed, resulting in faster speed transitions.

A value of 0 disables the feature.

For a high speed, high flow direct drive printer (like the Bambu lab or Voron) this value is usually not needed. However it can provide some marginal benefit in certain cases where feature speeds vary greatly. For example, when there are aggressive slowdowns due to overhangs. In these cases a high value of around 300-350 mm³/s² is recommended as this allows for just enough smoothing to assist pressure advance achieve a smoother flow transition.

For slower printers without pressure advance, the value should be set much lower. A value of 10-15 mm³/s² is a good starting point for direct drive extruders and 5-10 mm³/s² for Bowden style.

This feature is known as Pressure Equalizer in Prusa slicer.

Note: this parameter disables arc fitting.
max_volumetric_extrusion_rate_slope.tip_zh:
此参数是打印机从打印高流量挤出（高速/较大宽度）向低流量挤出（低速/较小宽度）时用于突然变化挤出速率的平滑，反之亦然。
它定义了挤出体积流量（mm³/s）随时间变化的最大速率。更高的值意味着允许更高的挤出速率变化，从而产生更快速的过渡。

值为0将禁用该功能。

对于高速、高流量的近程挤出机（如Bambu或Voron）通常不需要该值。但是，在特征速度变化很大的某些情况下，它可以提供一些边际收益。例如，当由于悬垂而出现严重的减速时。在这些情况下，建议使用一个大的值大约300-350 mm³/s²的，因为这刚好允许足够的平滑，以帮助压力提前实现更平滑的流量过渡。

对于没有压力提前的较慢打印机，该值应该设置得非常低。对于近程挤出机来说10-15 mm³/s²是一个很好值的起点，而对于远程挤出机来说是5-10 mm³/s²。

这个功能在Prusa切片机中被称为压力均衡器。

注意：此参数禁用圆弧拟合。

max_volumetric_extrusion_rate_slope_segm.label: Smoothing segment length
max_volumetric_extrusion_rate_slope_segm.tip:
A lower value results in smoother extrusion rate transitions. However, this results in a significantly larger G-code file and more instructions for the printer to process.

Default value of 3 works well for most cases. If your printer is stuttering, increase this value to reduce the number of adjustments made.

Allowed values: 0.5-5
max_volumetric_extrusion_rate_slope_segm.tip_zh: 值越低，挤出速率过渡越平滑。然而，这会导致 G-code 文件变得更大，并且打印机需要处理更多指令。 默认值 3 适用于大多数情况。如果您的打印机出现卡顿，请增加该值以减少调整次数。 允许值：0.5-5

metadata_name.tip_zh: 添加到 3MF 中的元数据名称列表。

metadata_value.label: Metadata value list
metadata_value.tip_zh: 添加到 3MF 中的元数据值列表。

min_skirt_length.label: Skirt minimum extrusion length
min_skirt_length.tip:
Minimum filament extrusion length in mm when printing the skirt. Zero means this feature is disabled.

Using a non-zero value is useful if the printer is set up to print without a prime line.
Final number of loops is not taking into account while arranging or validating objects distance. Increase loop number in such case.
min_skirt_length.tip_zh:

如果打印机设置为不打印起始擦嘴线，建议使用非零值。

no_check.label: No check

normal_print_time.label: Print time (normal mode)
normal_print_time.tip: Estimated print time when printed in normal mode (i.e. not in silent mode). Same as print_time.
normal_print_time.tip_zh: 在普通模式（即非静音模式）下打印时的预计打印耗时。与“打印耗时”类似。

notes.label: Configuration notes
notes.tip: You can put here your personal notes. This text will be added to the G-code header comments.
