nozzle_temperature.label: Other layers
nozzle_temperature.tip: Nozzle temperature for layers after the initial one.
nozzle_temperature.tip_zh: 除首层外的其它层的喷嘴温度

nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.label: First layer
nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.tip: Nozzle temperature for printing the first layer when using this filament.
nozzle_temperature_initial_layer.tip_zh: 使用此耗材时的首层打印温度。

num_extruders.label: Number of extruders
num_extruders.tip: Total number of extruders, regardless of whether they are used in the current print.
num_extruders.tip_zh: 挤出机总数，无论当前打印中是否使用它们。

num_instances.label: Number of instances
num_instances.tip: Total number of object instances in the print, summed over all objects.
num_instances.tip_zh: 打印中所有对象实例的总数，所有对象相加。

num_objects.label: Number of objects
num_objects.tip: Total number of objects in the print.

num_printing_extruders.label: Number of printing extruders
num_printing_extruders.tip: Number of extruders used during the print.

ooze_prevention.label: Enable
ooze_prevention.tip: This option will drop the temperature of the inactive extruders to prevent oozing.
ooze_prevention.tip_zh: 此选项将降低非活动挤出机的温度，以防止渗出。

orient.label: Orient Options
orient.tip_zh: 朝向选项：0-禁用，1-启用，其他-自动

other_layers_print_sequence_nums.label: The number of other layers print sequence
other_layers_print_sequence_nums.zh: 其他层的打印顺序数量

output.label: Output File
output.tip: The file where the output will be written (if not specified, it will be based on the input file).

outputdir.label: Output directory
outputdir.tip: Output directory for the exported files.

overhang_fan_speed.label: Overhangs and external bridges fan speed
overhang_fan_speed.tip:
Use this part cooling fan speed when printing bridges or overhang walls with an overhang threshold that exceeds the value set in the 'Overhangs cooling threshold' parameter above. Increasing the cooling specifically for overhangs and bridges can improve the overall print quality of these features.

Please note, this fan speed is clamped on the lower end by the minimum fan speed threshold set above. It is also adjusted upwards up to the maximum fan speed threshold when the minimum layer time threshold is not met.
overhang_fan_speed.zh: 悬垂和外部桥接风扇速度
overhang_fan_speed.tip_zh:
当打印桥接结构或悬垂墙时，如果悬垂程度超过上述“悬垂冷却阈值”所设定的值，则使用此部件冷却风扇速度。专门针对悬垂和桥接加大冷却力度，有助于提升这些特征整体的打印质量。

请注意，此风扇速度的下限受前面设置的最小风扇速度阈值限制；当打印层时间未达到最小层时间阈值时，会相应上调至最大风扇速度阈值。

overhang_fan_threshold.label: Overhang cooling activation threshold
overhang_fan_threshold.tip: When the overhang exceeds this specified threshold, force the cooling fan to run at the 'Overhang Fan Speed' set below. This threshold is expressed as a percentage, indicating the portion of each line's width that is unsupported by the layer beneath it. Setting this value to 0% forces the cooling fan to run for all outer walls, regardless of the overhang degree.
overhang_fan_threshold.tip_zh: 当悬垂超过此指定阈值时，强制部件冷却风扇按照下方设置的“悬垂风扇速度”运转。该阈值以百分比表示，指示每条走线宽度中未被下层支撑的部分。将此值设置为0%即使在任何悬垂条件下也会使风扇运转于所有外壁。

parallel_printheads_bed_exclude_areas.label: Parallel printheads bed exclude areas
parallel_printheads_bed_exclude_areas.tip: Ordered list of bed exclude areas by parallel printhead count. Item 1 applies to one printhead, item 2 to two printheads, and so on. Leave an item empty for no excluded area.
parallel_printheads_bed_exclude_areas.zh: 并联打印头的热床排除区域
parallel_printheads_bed_exclude_areas.tip_zh: 按并联打印头数量排列的热床排除区域有序列表。第 1 项适用于一个打印头，第 2 项适用于两个打印头，依此类推。将某项留空表示无排除区域。

parallel_printheads_count.label: Parallel printheads count
parallel_printheads_count.tip: Set the number of parallel printheads for machines like OrangeStorm Giga printer.
parallel_printheads_count.tip_zh: 设置并联打印头的数量，适用于 OrangeStorm Giga 等打印机。

part_cooling_fan_min_pwm.label: Minimum non-zero part cooling fan speed
part_cooling_fan_min_pwm.tip:
Some part-cooling fans cannot start spinning when commanded below a certain PWM duty cycle. When set above 0, any non-zero part-cooling fan command will be raised to at least this percentage so the fan reliably starts. A fan command of 0 (fan off) is always honoured exactly. This clamp is applied after every other fan calculation (first-layer ramp, layer-time interpolation, overhang/bridge/support-interface/ironing overrides), so scaling still operates within the range [this value, 100%].
If your firmware already disables the fan below a threshold (for example Klipper's [fan] off_below: 0.10 shuts the fan off whenever the commanded duty cycle is below 10%), this option and the firmware threshold should ideally be set to the same value. Matching them (e.g. off_below: 0.10 in Klipper and 10% here) guarantees the slicer never emits a non-zero value that the firmware would silently drop, and the fan never receives a value below the one you know it can actually spool at.
Set to 0 to deactivate.
part_cooling_fan_min_pwm.zh: 最小非零部件冷却风扇速度
part_cooling_fan_min_pwm.tip_zh:
某些部件冷却风扇在收到低于某一 PWM 占空比的指令时无法启动旋转。当设置为大于 0 时，任何非零的部件冷却风扇指令都会被提升到至少此百分比，以使风扇可靠启动。指令为 0（风扇关闭）时始终精确执行。此限制在所有其他风扇计算之后应用（首层渐变、层时间插值、悬垂/桥接/支撑面/熨烫覆盖），因此缩放仍在 [此值, 100%] 范围内进行。
如果您的固件已经在低于某阈值时禁用风扇（例如 Klipper 的 [fan] off_below: 0.10 会在指令占空比低于 10% 时关闭风扇），那么此选项与固件阈值最好设置为相同的值。使二者匹配（例如 Klipper 中 off_below: 0.10、此处为 10%）可确保切片软件绝不会发出会被固件悄然丢弃的非零值，且风扇绝不会收到低于其实际可启动转速的值。
设置为 0 以停用。

pellet_flow_coefficient.label: Pellet flow coefficient
pellet_flow_coefficient.tip:
Pellet flow coefficient is empirically derived and allows for volume calculation for pellet printers.

Internally it is converted to filament_diameter. All other volume calculations remain the same.

filament_diameter = sqrt( (4 * pellet_flow_coefficient) / PI )
pellet_flow_coefficient.tip_zh:
颗粒流动系数是基于经验得出的数据，可用于为颗粒耗材打印机开展体积计算。
在软件内部计算时，它其实会被转换为“耗材丝直径”，其他体积的计算保持不变：耗材丝直径 = 开平方( (4 * 颗粒流动系数) / 圆周率 )

physical_printer_preset.label: Physical printer name
physical_printer_preset.tip: Name of the physical printer used for slicing.
physical_printer_preset.tip_zh: 用于切片的，实际的打印机的名字。

position.label: Position
position.tip: Position of the extruder at the beginning of the custom G-code block. If the custom G-code travels somewhere else, it should write to this variable so OrcaSlicer knows where it travels from when it gets control back.
position.tip_zh: 自定义 G-code 块开始时挤出机的位置。如果自定义 G-code 移动到了其他方位，应将该方位写入此变量，以便 OrcaSlicer 在重新取得控制时知道其起始位置。

post_process.label: Post-processing Scripts
post_process.tip: If you want to process the output G-code through custom scripts, just list their absolute paths here. Separate multiple scripts with a semicolon. Scripts will be passed the absolute path to the G-code file as the first argument, and they can access the Orca Slicer config settings by reading environment variables.
post_process.tip_zh: 如果您希望使用自定义脚本来处理输出的 G-code，只需要在此列出这些脚本的绝对路径，使用分号来分割多个脚本。脚本执行的第一个参数将会被设置为 G-code 文件的绝对路径，并支持脚本通过全局变量来读取 Orca Slicer 的设置。

preheat_steps.label: Preheat steps
preheat_steps.tip: Insert multiple preheat commands (e.g. M104.1). Only useful for Prusa XL. For other printers, please set it to 1.
preheat_steps.tip_zh: 插入多个预热命令（例如 M104.1）。仅适用于 Prusa XL。对于其他打印机，请将其设置为 1。

preheat_time.label: Preheat time
preheat_time.tip: To reduce the waiting time after tool change, Orca can preheat the next tool while the current tool is still in use. This setting specifies the time in seconds to preheat the next tool. Orca will insert a M104 command to preheat the tool in advance.
preheat_time.tip_zh: 为了减少换刀后的等待时间，Orca 可以在当前刀具仍在使用时预热下一个刀具。此设置指定预热下一个工具的时间（以秒为单位）。 Orca 会插入 M104 指令提前预热刀具。

preset_names.label: Printer preset names
preset_names.tip: Names of presets related to the physical printer.
preset_names.tip_zh: 与物理打印机相关的预设名称

pressure_advance.label: Pressure advance
pressure_advance.tip: Pressure advance (Klipper) AKA Linear advance factor (Marlin).
pressure_advance.tip_zh: 压力提前(Klipper)或者线性提前(Marlin)

prime_tower_brim_width.label: Brim width
prime_tower_brim_width.tip: Brim width of prime tower, negative number means auto calculated width based on the height of prime tower.
prime_tower_brim_width.tip_zh: 擦拭塔的Brim宽度，设为负数将根据塔高自动计算宽度。

prime_tower_enable_framework.label: Internal ribs
prime_tower_enable_framework.tip: Enable internal ribs to increase the stability of the prime tower.
prime_tower_enable_framework.tip_zh: 启用内部加强筋，有助于增加擦拭塔的稳定性。

prime_tower_skip_points.label: Skip points
prime_tower_skip_points.tip: The wall of prime tower will skip the start points of wipe path.
prime_tower_skip_points.tip_zh: Prime 塔的墙壁将跳过擦拭路径的起点。

prime_volume.label: Prime volume
prime_volume.tip: The volume of material to prime extruder on tower.

print_bed_max.label: Top-right corner of print bed bounding box

print_bed_min.label: Bottom-left corner of print bed bounding box

print_bed_size.label: Size of the print bed bounding box

print_order.label: Intra-layer order
print_order.tip: Print order within a single layer.

print_preset.label: Print preset name
print_preset.tip: Name of the print preset used for slicing.
print_preset.tip_zh: 用于切片的打印预设的名称。

print_sequence.label: Print sequence
print_sequence.tip: Print sequence, layer by layer or object by object.
print_sequence.tip_zh: 打印顺序，逐层打印或者逐件打印

print_time.label: Print time (normal mode)
print_time.tip: Estimated print time when printed in normal mode (i.e. not in silent mode). Same as normal_print_time.
print_time.tip_zh: 在正常模式（即非静音模式）下打印时的预计打印耗时。与“普通打印耗时”类似。

print_time_sec.label: Print time (seconds)
print_time_sec.tip: Total estimated print time in seconds. Replaced with actual value during post-processing.
print_time_sec.tip_zh: 预计总打印耗时（以秒为单位）。在后处理时将替换为实际值。

printer_preset.label: Printer preset name
printer_preset.tip: Name of the printer preset used for slicing.
printer_preset.tip_zh: 用于切片的打印机预设的名称。

printing_filament_types.label: Used filament types
printing_filament_types.tip: Comma-separated list of all filament types used during the print.

process_change_extrusion_role_gcode.label: Change extrusion role G-code (process)
process_change_extrusion_role_gcode.tip: This G-code is inserted when the extrusion role is changed. It runs after the machine and filament extrusion role G-code.
process_change_extrusion_role_gcode.zh: 挤出类型更换 G-code（工艺）
process_change_extrusion_role_gcode.tip_zh: 当挤出类型发生变化时插入此 G-code。它在机器和耗材的挤出类型更换 G-code 之后运行。

reduce_fan_stop_start_freq.label: Keep fan always on
reduce_fan_stop_start_freq.tip: Enabling this setting means that the part cooling fan will never stop completely and will run at least at minimum speed to reduce the frequency of starting and stopping.
reduce_fan_stop_start_freq.tip_zh: 如果勾选这个选项，部件冷却风扇将永远不会停止，并且会至少运行在最小风扇转速值以减少风扇的启停频次

reduce_infill_retraction.label: Reduce infill retraction
reduce_infill_retraction.tip: Don't retract when the travel is entirely within an infill area. That means the oozing can't been seen. This can reduce times of retraction for complex model and save printing time, but make slicing and G-code generating slower. Note that z-hop is also not performed in areas where retraction is skipped.
reduce_infill_retraction.tip_zh: 当空驶完全在填充区域内时不触发回抽。这意味着即使漏料也是不可见的。对于复杂模型，该设置能够减少回抽次数以及打印时长，但是会造成G-code生成变慢

repair.label: Repair
repair.tip: Repair the model's meshes if it is non-manifold mesh.

repetitions.label: Repetition count
repetitions.tip: Repetition count of the whole model.

required_nozzle_HRC.label: Required nozzle HRC
required_nozzle_HRC.tip: Minimum HRC of nozzle required to print the filament. Zero means no checking of nozzle's HRC.
required_nozzle_HRC.tip_zh: 打印此材料的所需的最小喷嘴硬度。零值表示不检查喷嘴硬度。

resolution.label: Resolution
resolution.tip: The G-code path is generated after simplifying the contour of models to avoid too many points and G-code lines. Smaller value means higher resolution and more time to slice.
resolution.tip_zh: 为了避免G-code文件中过密集的点和走线，G-code走线通常是在简化模型的外轮廓之后生成。越小的数值代表更高的分辨率，同时需要更长的切片时间。

retraction_distances_when_ec.label: Retraction distance when extruder change
retraction_distances_when_ec.zh: 更换挤出机时的回缩距离

rotate.label: Rotate
rotate.tip: Rotation angle around the Z axis in degrees.
rotate.tip_zh: 绕 Z 轴的旋转角度（以度为单位）。

rotate_x.label: Rotate around X
rotate_x.tip: Rotation angle around the X axis in degrees.
rotate_x.tip_zh: 绕 X 轴的旋转角度（以度为单位）。

rotate_y.label: Rotate around Y
rotate_y.tip: Rotation angle around the Y axis in degrees.
rotate_y.tip_zh: 绕 Y 轴的旋转角度（以度为单位）

scale.label: Scale per object
scale.tip:
Contains a string with the information about what scaling was applied to the individual objects. Indexing of the objects is zero-based (first object has index 0).
Example: 'x:100% y:50% z:100%'.
scale.tip_zh:
包含一个字符串，其中包含有关对各个对象应用的缩放比例的信息。对象的索引从零开始（第一个对象的索引为 0）。
示例：“x:100% y:50% z:100%”。

silent_print_time.label: Print time (silent mode)
silent_print_time.tip: Estimated print time when printed in silent mode.
silent_print_time.tip_zh: 在静音模式下打印时的预计打印耗时。

single_extruder_multi_material_priming.label: Prime all printing extruders
single_extruder_multi_material_priming.tip: If enabled, all printing extruders will be primed at the front edge of the print bed at the start of the print.
single_extruder_multi_material_priming.tip_zh: 如果启用，所有挤出机将在打印开始时在床前画线

single_instance.label: Single instance mode
single_instance.tip: If enabled, the command line arguments are sent to an existing instance of GUI OrcaSlicer, or an existing OrcaSlicer window is activated. Overrides the "single_instance" configuration value from application preferences.

single_loop_draft_shield.label: Single loop after first layer
single_loop_draft_shield.tip: Limits the skirt/draft shield loops to one wall after the first layer. This is useful, on occasion, to conserve filament but may cause the draft shield/skirt to warp / crack.
single_loop_draft_shield.tip_zh: 在首层之后，将环形裙边或隔风罩限制为单层墙。这在某些情况下有助于节省耗材，但可能导致隔风罩或裙边翘曲或开裂。

skip_modified_gcodes.label: Skip modified G-code in 3MF
skip_modified_gcodes.tip: Skip the modified G-code in 3MF from printer or filament presets.
skip_modified_gcodes.zh: 跳过 3MF 中修改过的 G-code
skip_modified_gcodes.tip_zh: 跳过 3MF 中来自打印机或耗材预设中修改过的 G-code。

skip_objects.label: Skip Objects
skip_objects.tip: Skip some objects in this print.
skip_objects.tip_zh: 打印过程中跳过一些对象

skirt_distance.label: Skirt distance
skirt_distance.tip: The distance from the skirt to the brim or the object.
skirt_distance.tip_zh: 从裙边到模型或者brim的距离

skirt_height.label: Skirt height
skirt_height.tip: How many layers of skirt. Usually only one layer.
skirt_height.tip_zh: 裙边有多少层。通常只有一层

skirt_loops.label: Skirt loops
skirt_loops.tip: Number of loops for the skirt. Zero means disabling skirt.
skirt_loops.tip_zh: 裙边的圈数。0表示关闭裙边。

skirt_speed.label: Skirt speed
skirt_speed.tip: Speed of skirt, in mm/s. Zero means use default layer extrusion speed.
skirt_speed.tip_zh: 裙边速度，单位为mm/s。0表示使用默认的层挤出速度。

skirt_type.label: Skirt type
skirt_type.tip: Combined - single skirt for all objects, Per object - individual object skirt.
skirt_type.tip_zh: 合并 - 所有对象共用一个裙边，按对象 - 每个对象单独的裙边。

slice.label: Slice
slice.tip: Slice the plates: 0-all plates, i-plate i, others-invalid
slice.tip_zh: 对打印板切片：0-所有板，i-第i个板，其他-无效

slow_down_for_layer_cooling.label: Slow printing down for better layer cooling
slow_down_for_layer_cooling.tip: Enable this option to slow printing speed down to make the final layer time not shorter than the layer time threshold in "Max fan speed threshold", so that layer can be cooled for longer time. This can improve the cooling quality for needle and small details.
slow_down_for_layer_cooling.zh: 降低打印速度 以得到更好的冷却
slow_down_for_layer_cooling.tip_zh: 勾选这个选项，将降低打印速度，使得最终的层打印时间不小于"最大风扇速度阈值"里的层时间阈值，从而使得该层获得更久的冷却。这能够改善尖顶和小细节的冷却效果

slow_down_layer_time.label: Layer time
slow_down_layer_time.tip: The printing speed in exported G-code will be slowed down when the estimated layer time is shorter than this value in order to get better cooling for these layers.
slow_down_layer_time.tip_zh: 当层预估打印时间小于这个数值时，打印速度将会降低，从而获得更好的冷却效果。

slow_down_min_speed.label: Min print speed
slow_down_min_speed.tip: The minimum print speed to which the printer slows down to maintain the minimum layer time defined above when the slowdown for better layer cooling is enabled.
slow_down_min_speed.tip_zh: 当启用减速以实现更好的层冷却时，打印机为了维持上面定义的最小层时间而减速的最小打印速度。

small_area_infill_flow_compensation_mode.label: Flow Compensation Model
small_area_infill_flow_compensation_mode.tip: Flow Compensation Model, used to adjust the flow for small infill areas. The model is expressed as a comma separated pair of values for extrusion length and flow correction factor. Each pair is on a separate line, followed by a semicolon, in the following format: "1.234, 5.678;"
small_area_infill_flow_compensation_mode.tip_zh: 流量补偿模型，用于调整小填充区域的流量。该模型表示为挤出长度和流量校正因子的逗号分隔值对。每对位于单独的行上，后跟分号，格式如下："1.234, 5.678;"

spaghetti_detector.label: Enable spaghetti detector
spaghetti_detector.tip: Enable the camera on printer to check spaghetti.

spiral_finishing_flow_ratio.label: Spiral finishing flow ratio
spiral_finishing_flow_ratio.tip: Sets the finishing flow ratio while ending the spiral. Normally the spiral transition scales the flow ratio from 100% to 0% during the last loop which can in some cases lead to under extrusion at the end of the spiral.
spiral_finishing_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 设置结束螺旋时的精加工流量比。通常，螺旋过渡在最后一个循环期间将流量比从 100% 缩放到 0%，这在某些情况下可能会导致螺旋末端挤出不足。

spiral_mode.label: Spiral vase
spiral_mode.tip: Spiralize smooths out the Z moves of the outer contour. And turns a solid model into a single walled print with solid bottom layers. The final generated model has no seam.
spiral_mode.tip_zh: 沿着对象的外轮廓螺旋上升，将实体模型转变为只有底面实心层和侧面单层墙壁的打印。最后生成的打印件没有接缝。

spiral_mode_max_xy_smoothing.label: Max XY Smoothing
spiral_mode_max_xy_smoothing.tip: Maximum distance to move points in XY to try to achieve a smooth spiral. If expressed as a %, it will be computed over nozzle diameter.
spiral_mode_max_xy_smoothing.tip_zh: 在XY平面上移动点的最大距离，以尝试实现平滑的螺旋。如果以%表示，它将基于喷嘴直径来计算。

spiral_mode_smooth.label: Smooth Spiral
spiral_mode_smooth.tip: Smooth Spiral smooths out X and Y moves as well, resulting in no visible seam at all, even in the XY directions on walls that are not vertical.
spiral_mode_smooth.tip_zh: 光滑螺旋模式平滑X和Y轴移动，从而在所有方向上都没有可见的接缝，即使在不垂直的墙壁上也是如此。

spiral_starting_flow_ratio.label: Spiral starting flow ratio
spiral_starting_flow_ratio.tip: Sets the starting flow ratio while transitioning from the last bottom layer to the spiral. Normally the spiral transition scales the flow ratio from 0% to 100% during the first loop which can in some cases lead to under extrusion at the start of the spiral.
spiral_starting_flow_ratio.tip_zh: 设置从最后一个底层过渡到螺旋时的起始流量比。通常，螺旋过渡在第一个循环期间将流量比从 0% 调整到 100%，这在某些情况下可能导致螺旋开始时挤出不足。

split.label: Split
split.tip: Detect unconnected parts in the given model(s) and split them into separate objects.

standby_temperature_delta.label: Temperature variation
standby_temperature_delta.tip: Temperature difference to be applied when an extruder is not active. The value is not used when 'idle_temperature' in filament settings is set to non-zero value.
standby_temperature_delta.tip_zh: 挤出机未启动时施加的温差。当耗材丝设置中的“idle_Temperature”设置为非零值时，不使用该值。

start_end_points.label: Start end points
start_end_points.tip: The start and end points which is from cutter area to garbage can.
start_end_points.tip_zh: 从切割区域到垃圾桶的起始和结束点。

supertack_plate_temp.label: Other layers
supertack_plate_temp.tip: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Cool Plate SuperTack.
supertack_plate_temp.tip_zh: 除首层外的其他层的热床温度。0值表示该耗材丝不支持在Cool Plate SuperTack上打印。

supertack_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: First layer
supertack_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip: Bed temperature of the first layer. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Cool Plate SuperTack.
supertack_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip_zh: 初始层的床温。值 0 表示耗材不支持在 Cool Plate SuperTack 上打印。

support_material_interface_fan_speed.label: Support interface fan speed
support_material_interface_fan_speed.tip:
This part cooling fan speed is applied when printing support interfaces. Setting this parameter to a higher than regular speed reduces the layer binding strength between supports and the supported part, making them easier to separate.
Set to -1 to disable it.
This setting is overridden by disable_fan_first_layers.
support_material_interface_fan_speed.tip_zh:
在打印支撑接触面时使用的风扇转速。若设为高于平常的速度，有助降低支撑与打印件之间的层粘结强度，使其更易分离。
设置为 -1 以停用此功能。
该设置会被 disable_fan_first_layers 选项覆盖。

support_parallel_printheads.label: Support parallel printheads
support_parallel_printheads.tip: Enable printer settings for machines that can use multiple printheads in parallel.
support_parallel_printheads.tip_zh: 为可并联使用多个打印头的机器启用打印机设置。

sw_renderer.label: Render with a software renderer
sw_renderer.tip: Render with a software renderer. The bundled MESA software renderer is loaded instead of the default OpenGL driver.

temperature_vitrification.label: Softening temperature
temperature_vitrification.tip: The material softens at this temperature, so when the bed temperature is equal to or greater than this, it's highly recommended to open the front door and/or remove the upper glass to avoid clogging.
temperature_vitrification.tip_zh:
材料在这个温度下会软化。
因此，当热床温度等于或高于这个温度时，强烈建议打开舱门，或去除上盖板以避免喷嘴堵塞。

textured_cool_plate_temp.label: Other layers
textured_cool_plate_temp.tip: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Textured Cool Plate.
textured_cool_plate_temp.tip_zh: 非首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持纹理低温打印热床

textured_cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: First layer
textured_cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip: Bed temperature of the first layer. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Textured Cool Plate.
textured_cool_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip_zh: 首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持纹理低温打印热床

textured_plate_temp.label: Other layers
textured_plate_temp.tip: Bed temperature for layers except the initial one. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Textured PEI Plate.
textured_plate_temp.tip_zh: 非首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持纹理PEI热床

textured_plate_temp_initial_layer.label: First layer
textured_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip: Bed temperature of the first layer. A value of 0 means the filament does not support printing on the Textured PEI Plate.
textured_plate_temp_initial_layer.tip_zh: 首层热床温度。0值表示这个耗材丝不支持纹理PEI热床

timelapse_type.label: Timelapse
timelapse_type.tip: If smooth or traditional mode is selected, a timelapse video will be generated for each print. After each layer is printed, a snapshot is taken with the chamber camera. All of these snapshots are composed into a timelapse video when printing completes. If smooth mode is selected, the toolhead will move to the excess chute after each layer is printed and then take a snapshot. Since the melt filament may leak from the nozzle during the process of taking a snapshot, a prime tower is required for smooth mode to wipe nozzle.
timelapse_type.tip_zh: 如果启用平滑模式或者传统模式，将在每次打印时生成延时摄影视频。打印完每层后，将用内置相机拍摄快照。打印完成后，所有这些快照会组合成一个延时视频。如果启用平滑模式，打印完每层后，工具头将移动到吐料槽，然后拍摄快照。由于平滑模式在拍摄快照的过程中熔丝可能会从喷嘴中泄漏，因此需要使用擦拭塔进行喷嘴擦拭。

timestamp.label: Timestamp
timestamp.tip: String containing current time in yyyyMMdd-hhmmss format.
timestamp.tip_zh: 包含当前时间的字符串，格式为yyyyMMdd-hhmmss。

tool_change_on_wipe_tower.label: Tool change on wipe tower
tool_change_on_wipe_tower.tip: Force the toolhead to travel to the wipe tower before issuing the tool change command (Tx). Only relevant for multi-extruder (multi-toolhead) printers using a Type 2 wipe tower. By default Orca skips the travel on multi-toolhead machines because the firmware handles the head swap, which can result in the Tx command being issued above the printed part. Enable this option if you want the tool change to always be issued above the wipe tower instead.
tool_change_on_wipe_tower.tip_zh: 在发出换头命令 (Tx) 之前，强制打印头先移动到擦拭塔。仅与使用第 2 类擦拭塔的多挤出机（多打印头）打印机相关。默认情况下，Orca 会在多打印头机器上跳过此移动，因为固件会处理换头，这可能导致 Tx 命令在打印件上方发出。如果您希望换头命令始终在擦拭塔上方发出，请启用此选项。

total_cost.label: Total cost
total_cost.tip: Total cost of all material used in the print. Calculated from filament_cost value in Filament Settings.
total_cost.tip_zh: 打印中使用的所有耗材的总成本。根据耗材设置中的 filament_cost 值计算。

total_layer_count.label: Total layer count
total_layer_count.tip: Number of layers in the entire print.

total_toolchanges.label: Total tool changes
total_toolchanges.tip: Number of tool changes during the print.
total_toolchanges.tip_zh: 打印期间的工具头更换次数。

total_weight.label: Total weight
total_weight.tip: Total weight of the print. Calculated from filament_density value in Filament Settings.
total_weight.tip_zh: 打印件的总重量。根据耗材设置中的耗材密度值计算。

total_wipe_tower_cost.label: Total wipe tower cost
total_wipe_tower_cost.tip: Total cost of the material wasted on the wipe tower. Calculated from filament_cost value in Filament Settings.
total_wipe_tower_cost.tip_zh: 擦拭塔上浪费的材料的总成本。根据耗材设置中的 filament_cost 值计算。

total_wipe_tower_filament.label: Wipe tower volume
total_wipe_tower_filament.tip: Total filament volume extruded on the wipe tower.
total_wipe_tower_filament.tip_zh: 擦拭塔上已挤出耗材的总体积。

travel_speed.label: Travel
travel_speed.tip: Speed of travel which is faster and without extrusion.
travel_speed.tip_zh: 空驶的速度。空驶是无挤出量的快速移动。

travel_speed_z.label: Z travel
travel_speed_z.tip: Speed of vertical travel along z axis. This is typically lower because build plate or gantry is hard to be moved. Zero means using travel speed directly in G-code, but will be limited by printer's ability when run G-code.

uptodate.label: UpToDate
uptodate.tip: Update the config values of 3MF to latest.
uptodate.tip_zh: 将3mf的配置值更新为最新值。

uptodate_filaments.label: Load uptodate filament settings when using uptodate
uptodate_filaments.tip: Load uptodate filament settings from the specified file when using uptodate.
uptodate_filaments.zh: 更新同步时加载最新耗材设置
uptodate_filaments.tip_zh: 在使用 同步最新设置 时，从指定文件加载最新的耗材设置。

uptodate_settings.label: Load uptodate process/machine settings when using uptodate
uptodate_settings.tip: Load uptodate process/machine settings from the specified file when using uptodate.
uptodate_settings.zh: 更新同步时加载最新工艺/机器设置
uptodate_settings.tip_zh: 在使用 同步最新设置 时，从指定的文件中加载最新的进程/机器设置。

used_filament.label: Used filament
used_filament.tip: Total length of filament used in the print.
used_filament.tip_zh: 打印中使用的耗材的总长度。

used_filament_length.label: Filament length (meters)
used_filament_length.tip: Total filament length used in meters. Replaced with actual value during post-processing.
used_filament_length.tip_zh: 使用的耗材丝总长度（以米为单位）。在后处理期间替换为实际值。

volumetric_speed_coefficients.label: Max volumetric speed multinomial coefficients
volumetric_speed_coefficients.zh: 最大体积流量多项式系数

wipe_tower_bridging.label: Maximal bridging distance
wipe_tower_bridging.tip: Maximal distance between supports on sparse infill sections.
wipe_tower_bridging.tip_zh: 稀疏填充剖面上支撑之间的最大距离。

wipe_tower_cone_angle.label: Stabilization cone apex angle
wipe_tower_cone_angle.tip: Angle at the apex of the cone that is used to stabilize the wipe tower. Larger angle means wider base.
wipe_tower_cone_angle.tip_zh: 塔锥体顶角的角度，用于稳定擦拭塔。角度越大，底座越宽。

wipe_tower_extra_flow.label: Extra flow for purging
wipe_tower_extra_flow.tip: Extra flow used for the purging lines on the wipe tower. This makes the purging lines thicker or narrower than they normally would be. The spacing is adjusted automatically.
wipe_tower_extra_flow.tip_zh: 用于擦拭塔冲刷线的额外流量。这使冲刷线比正常情况下更厚或更窄。间距会自动调整。

wipe_tower_extra_rib_length.label: Extra rib length
wipe_tower_extra_rib_length.tip: Positive values can increase the size of the rib wall, while negative values can reduce the size. However, the size of the rib wall can not be smaller than that determined by the cleaning volume.
wipe_tower_extra_rib_length.tip_zh: 正值可以增加加强筋墙的尺寸，负值可以减小尺寸。但是，加强筋墙的尺寸不能小于由清洁体积决定的尺寸。

wipe_tower_extra_spacing.label: Wipe tower purge lines spacing
wipe_tower_extra_spacing.tip: Spacing of purge lines on the wipe tower.
wipe_tower_extra_spacing.tip_zh: 擦拭塔上冲刷线的间距

wipe_tower_fillet_wall.label: Fillet wall
wipe_tower_fillet_wall.tip: The wall of prime tower will fillet.
wipe_tower_fillet_wall.tip_zh: 擦料塔的墙壁做倒角处理

wipe_tower_max_purge_speed.label: Maximum wipe tower print speed
wipe_tower_max_purge_speed.tip:
The maximum print speed when purging in the wipe tower and printing the wipe tower sparse layers. When purging, if the sparse infill speed or calculated speed from the filament max volumetric speed is lower, the lowest will be used instead.

When printing the sparse layers, if the internal perimeter speed or calculated speed from the filament max volumetric speed is lower, the lowest will be used instead.

Increasing this speed may affect the tower's stability as well as increase the force with which the nozzle collides with any blobs that may have formed on the wipe tower.

Before increasing this parameter beyond the default of 90 mm/s, make sure your printer can reliably bridge at the increased speeds and that ooze when tool changing is well controlled.

For the wipe tower external perimeters the internal perimeter speed is used regardless of this setting.
wipe_tower_max_purge_speed.tip_zh:
擦拭塔冲刷和稀疏层的最大打印速度。当冲刷时，如果稀疏填充速度或从耗材最大体积速度计算出的速度较低，则使用最低速度。

当打印稀疏层时，如果内墙速度或从耗材最大体积流量计算出的速度较低，则使用最低速度。

增加此速度可能会影响塔的稳定性，同时增加喷嘴与擦拭塔上可能形成的任何斑点碰撞的力。

在将此参数增加到默认值90mm/sec之外之前，请确保您的打印机可以可靠地在增加的速度下桥接，并且换料时的滴漏得到了很好的控制。

对于擦拭塔外墙，无论此设置如何，都使用内墙速度。

wipe_tower_no_sparse_layers.label: No sparse layers (beta)
wipe_tower_no_sparse_layers.tip: If enabled, the wipe tower will not be printed on layers with no tool changes. On layers with a tool change, extruder will travel downward to print the wipe tower. User is responsible for ensuring there is no collision with the print.
wipe_tower_no_sparse_layers.tip_zh: 如果启用，将不会在没有换色的层打印擦拭塔。存在换色的层时，挤出机将降低高度打印擦拭塔。用户应该确保不会与打印内容发生冲突。

wipe_tower_rib_width.label: Rib width
wipe_tower_rib_width.tip: Rib width is always less than half the prime tower side length.
wipe_tower_rib_width.tip_zh: 肋宽度始终小于主塔边长的一半。

wipe_tower_rotation_angle.label: Wipe tower rotation angle
wipe_tower_rotation_angle.tip: Wipe tower rotation angle with respect to X axis.
wipe_tower_rotation_angle.tip_zh: 擦拭塔相对于x轴的旋转角度

wipe_tower_wall_type.label: Wall type
wipe_tower_wall_type.tip:
Wipe tower outer wall type.
1. Rectangle: The default wall type, a rectangle with fixed width and height.
2. Cone: A cone with a fillet at the bottom to help stabilize the wipe tower.
3. Rib: Adds four ribs to the tower wall for enhanced stability.
wipe_tower_wall_type.tip_zh:
擦拭塔外墙类型。
1. 矩形：默认墙类型，具有固定宽度和高度的矩形。
2. 圆锥：底部有圆角的圆锥，有助于稳定擦拭塔。
3. 加强筋：在塔壁上增加四个加强筋以提高稳定性。

wipe_tower_x.label: Position X
wipe_tower_x.tip: X coordinate of the left front corner of a wipe tower.

wipe_tower_y.label: Position Y
wipe_tower_y.tip: Y coordinate of the left front corner of a wipe tower.

wiping_volumes_extruders.label: Purging volumes - load/unload volumes
wiping_volumes_extruders.tip: This vector saves required volumes to change from/to each tool used on the wipe tower. These values are used to simplify creation of the full purging volumes below.
wiping_volumes_extruders.zh: 清理量 - 加载/卸载量
wiping_volumes_extruders.tip_zh: 此矢量可保存所需的体积，用于更改每个擦拭塔上工具所使用的from/to体积 。这些值用于简化完全冲刷体积的创建。

zhop.label: Current Z-hop
zhop.tip: Contains Z-hop present at the beginning of the custom G-code block.
zhop.tip_zh: 包含自定义 G-code 块开头的Z轴抬升。

bbl_use_printhost.label: Use 3rd-party print host
bbl_use_printhost.tip: Allow controlling BambuLab's printer through 3rd party print hosts.
bbl_use_printhost.tip_zh: 允许通过第三方网络连接控制BambuLab的打印机

bed_mesh_max.label: Bed mesh max
bed_mesh_max.tip: This option sets the max point for the allowed bed mesh area. Due to the probe's XY offset, most printers are unable to probe the entire bed. To ensure the probe point does not go outside the bed area, the minimum and maximum points of the bed mesh should be set appropriately. OrcaSlicer ensures that adaptive_bed_mesh_min/adaptive_bed_mesh_max values do not exceed these min/max points. This information can usually be obtained from your printer manufacturer. The default setting is (99999, 99999), which means there are no limits, thus allowing probing across the entire bed.
bed_mesh_max.tip_zh: 此选项设置了允许的网床探测区域的最大点。由于探针的XY偏移，大多数打印机无法探测整个打印床。为了确保探针不会超出床的范围，应适当设置网床的最小和最大点。逆戟鲸切片确保adaptive_bed_mesh_min/adaptive_bed_mesh_max值不超过这些最小/最大点。这些信息通常可以从您的打印机制造商那里获得。默认设置为(99999, 99999)，这意味着没有限制，因此允许在整个床上进行探测。

bed_mesh_min.label: Bed mesh min
bed_mesh_min.tip: This option sets the min point for the allowed bed mesh area. Due to the probe's XY offset, most printers are unable to probe the entire bed. To ensure the probe point does not go outside the bed area, the minimum and maximum points of the bed mesh should be set appropriately. OrcaSlicer ensures that adaptive_bed_mesh_min/adaptive_bed_mesh_max values do not exceed these min/max points. This information can usually be obtained from your printer manufacturer. The default setting is (-99999, -99999), which means there are no limits, thus allowing probing across the entire bed.
bed_mesh_min.tip_zh: 此选项设置了允许的网床探测区域的最小点。由于探针的XY偏移，大多数打印机无法探测整个打印床。为了确保探针不会超出床的范围，应适当设置网床的最小和最大点。逆戟鲸切片确保adaptive_bed_mesh_min/adaptive_bed_mesh_max值不超过这些最小/最大点。这些信息通常可以从您的打印机制造商那里获得。默认设置为(-99999, -99999)，这意味着没有限制，因此允许在整个床上进行探测。

best_object_pos.label: Best object position
best_object_pos.tip: Best auto arranging position in range [0,1] w.r.t. bed shape.
best_object_pos.tip_zh: 最佳自动排列位置在[0,1]范围内，相对于打印床形状。

default_bed_type.label: Default bed type
default_bed_type.tip: Default bed type for the printer (supports both numeric and string format).
default_bed_type.tip_zh: 打印机的默认热床类型（支持数字和字符串格式）。

default_filament_profile.label: Default filament profile
default_filament_profile.tip: Default filament profile when switching to this machine profile.
default_filament_profile.tip_zh: 该机器配置的默认耗材配置

default_print_profile.label: Default process profile
default_print_profile.tip: Default process profile when switching to this machine profile.
default_print_profile.tip_zh: 该机器的默认切片配置

disable_m73.label: Disable set remaining print time
disable_m73.tip: Disable generating of the M73: Set remaining print time in the final G-code.
disable_m73.tip_zh: 在最终生成的G-code中禁用M73命令：设置剩余打印时间

enable_power_loss_recovery.label: Power Loss Recovery
enable_power_loss_recovery.tip: Choose how to control power loss recovery. When set to Printer configuration, the slicer will not emit power loss recovery G-code and will leave the printer's configuration unchanged. Applicable to Bambu Lab or Marlin 2 firmware based printers.
enable_power_loss_recovery.tip_zh: 选择如何控制断电恢复。当设置为打印机配置时，切片机不会发出断电恢复 G-code，并且打印机的配置保持不变。适用于基于 Bambu Lab 或 Marlin 2 固件的打印机。

extra_loading_move.label: Extra loading distance
extra_loading_move.tip: When set to zero, the distance the filament is moved from parking position during load is exactly the same as it was moved back during unload. When positive, it is loaded further, if negative, the loading move is shorter than unloading.
extra_loading_move.tip_zh: 当设置为零时，耗材的加载移动与卸载移动的距离相同。如果为正，加载比卸载长。如果为负，加载比卸载短。

high_current_on_filament_swap.label: High extruder current on filament swap
high_current_on_filament_swap.tip: It may be beneficial to increase the extruder motor current during the filament exchange sequence to allow for rapid ramming feed rates and to overcome resistance when loading a filament with an ugly shaped tip.
high_current_on_filament_swap.zh: 更换耗材挤出机大电流
high_current_on_filament_swap.tip_zh: 可能有益于换耗材过程中增加挤出机电流，克服加载耗材时的阻力以加快尖端成型进料速率从而避免产生难看形状的尖端。

host_type.label: Host Type
host_type.tip: Orca Slicer can upload G-code files to a printer host. This field must contain the kind of the host.
host_type.tip_zh: Orca Slicer可以将G-code文件上传到打印机主机。此字段必须包含主机类型。

machine_load_filament_time.label: Filament load time
machine_load_filament_time.tip: Time to load new filament when switch filament. It's usually applicable for single-extruder multi-material machines. For tool changers or multi-tool machines, it's typically 0. For statistics only.
machine_load_filament_time.tip_zh:
换料时，装载新耗材过程的耗时。
通常适用于单挤出机且多材料机器。对于有工具头切换器或多工具头打印机机器，此值通常为 0。
仅用于统计。

machine_tool_change_time.label: Tool change time
machine_tool_change_time.tip: Time taken to switch tools. It's usually applicable for tool changers or multi-tool machines. For single-extruder multi-material machines, it's typically 0. For statistics only.
machine_tool_change_time.tip_zh:
更换工具头过程的耗时。
通常适用于有工具头切换器或多工具头的打印机。对于单挤出机的多材料机器，此值通常为 0。
仅用于统计。

machine_unload_filament_time.label: Filament unload time
machine_unload_filament_time.tip: Time to unload old filament when switch filament. It's usually applicable for single-extruder multi-material machines. For tool changers or multi-tool machines, it's typically 0. For statistics only.
machine_unload_filament_time.tip_zh:
换料时，卸载旧耗材过程的耗时。
通常适用于单挤出机且多材料机器。对于有工具头切换器或多工具头打印机机器，此值通常为 0。
仅用于统计。

manual_filament_change.label: Manual Filament Change
manual_filament_change.tip: Enable this option to omit the custom Change filament G-code only at the beginning of the print. The tool change command (e.g., T0) will be skipped throughout the entire print. This is useful for manual multi-material printing, where we use M600/PAUSE to trigger the manual filament change action.
manual_filament_change.tip_zh: 启用该选项可以在打印开始时省略自定义更换耗材丝的 G-code。整个打印过程中的工具头指令（如 T0）将会被跳过。这对于手动多材料打印十分有用，其将会使用 M600/PAUSE 指令来使您可以进行手动对耗材丝进行更换。

master_extruder_id.label: Master extruder id
master_extruder_id.tip: Default extruder id to place filament.

max_layer_height.label: Max
max_layer_height.tip: The highest printable layer height for the extruder. Used to limit the maximum layer height when enable adaptive layer height.
max_layer_height.tip_zh: 挤出机的最高可打印层高度。用于限制启用自适应层高时的最大层高。

min_layer_height.label: Min
min_layer_height.tip: The lowest printable layer height for the extruder. Used to limit the minimum layer height when enable adaptive layer height.
min_layer_height.tip_zh: 挤出机的最低可打印层高度。用于限制启用自适应层高时的最小层高。

pellet_modded_printer.label: Pellet Modded Printer
pellet_modded_printer.tip: Enable this option if your printer uses pellets instead of filaments.
pellet_modded_printer.tip_zh: 如果您的打印机使用颗粒而不是耗材丝，请启用此选项

physical_extruder_map.label: Map the logical extruder to physical extruder
physical_extruder_map.tip: Map the logical extruder to physical extruder.

preferred_orientation.label: Preferred orientation
preferred_orientation.tip: Automatically orient STL files on the Z axis upon initial import.
preferred_orientation.tip_zh: 导入模型时自动旋转到指定的朝向

print_host.label: Hostname, IP or URL
print_host.tip: Orca Slicer can upload G-code files to a printer host. This field should contain the hostname, IP address or URL of the printer host instance. Print host behind HAProxy with basic auth enabled can be accessed by putting the user name and password into the URL in the following format: https://username:password@your-octopi-address/
print_host.tip_zh: Orca Slicer可以将G-code文件上传到打印机主机。此字段应包含打印机主机实例的主机名、IP地址或URL。启用基本身份验证的Print host可以通过将用户名和密码放入以下格式的URL中来访问：https://username:password@your-octopi-address/

print_host_webui.label: Device UI
print_host_webui.tip: Specify the URL of your device user interface if it's not same as print_host.
print_host_webui.tip_zh: 如果打印机的设备用户界面的URL不同，请在此指定。

printer_notes.label: Printer notes
printer_notes.tip: You can put your notes regarding the printer here.
printer_notes.tip_zh: 你可以把你关于打印机的注释放在这里。

printer_structure.label: Printer structure
printer_structure.tip: The physical arrangement and components of a printing device.
printer_structure.tip_zh: 打印设备的物理结构和组件

printhost_apikey.label: API Key / Password
printhost_apikey.tip: Orca Slicer can upload G-code files to a printer host. This field should contain the API Key or the password required for authentication.
printhost_apikey.tip_zh: Orca Slicer可以将G-code文件上传到打印机主机。此字段应包含用于身份验证的API密钥或密码。

printhost_cafile.label: HTTPS CA File
printhost_cafile.tip: Custom CA certificate file can be specified for HTTPS OctoPrint connections, in crt/pem format. If left blank, the default OS CA certificate repository is used.
printhost_cafile.tip_zh: 可以为HTTPS OctoPrint连接指定自定义CA证书文件，格式为crt/pem。如果留空，则使用默认的操作系统CA证书存储库。

printhost_ssl_ignore_revoke.label: Ignore HTTPS certificate revocation checks
printhost_ssl_ignore_revoke.tip: Ignore HTTPS certificate revocation checks in case of missing or offline distribution points. One may want to enable this option for self signed certificates if connection fails.
printhost_ssl_ignore_revoke.tip_zh: 在缺少或离线分发点的情况下忽略HTTPS证书吊销检查。如果连接失败，可以启用此选项来处理自签名证书。

travel_slope.label: Traveling angle
travel_slope.tip: Traveling angle for Slope and Spiral Z-hop type. Setting it to 90° results in Normal Lift.
travel_slope.tip_zh: 斜坡和螺旋 Z 跳类型的行进角度。将其设置为 90° 会产生正常升力。

use_3mf.label: Use 3MF instead of G-code
use_3mf.tip: Enable this if the printer accepts a 3MF file as the print job. When enabled, Orca Slicer sends the sliced file as a .gcode.3mf, instead of a plain .gcode file.
use_3mf.tip_zh: 如果打印机接受 3MF 文件作为打印任务，请启用此选项。启用后，Orca Slicer 将以 .gcode.3mf 格式发送切片文件，而不是普通的 .gcode 文件。

adaptive_bed_mesh_margin.label: Mesh margin
adaptive_bed_mesh_margin.tip: This option determines the additional distance by which the adaptive bed mesh area should be expanded in the XY directions.
adaptive_bed_mesh_margin.tip_zh: 此选项决定了自适应网床网格区域在XY方向上应扩展的额外距离。

scan_first_layer.label: Scan first layer
scan_first_layer.tip: Enable this to enable the camera on printer to check the quality of first layer.
scan_first_layer.tip_zh: 开启这个设置将打开打印机上的摄像头用于检查首层打印质量。

support_air_filtration.label: Support air filtration
support_air_filtration.tip:
Enable this if printer support air filtration
G-code command: M106 P3 S(0-255)
support_air_filtration.tip_zh:
如果打印机支持空气过滤/排气风扇，可以开启此选项
G-code指令：M106 P3 S(0-255)

support_chamber_temp_control.label: Support control chamber temperature
support_chamber_temp_control.tip:
This option is enabled if machine support controlling chamber temperature
G-code command: M141 S(0-255)
support_chamber_temp_control.tip_zh: 此选项会开启打印机的打印室温度控制（若有的话）。G-code命令：M141 S(0-255)

support_multi_bed_types.label: Support multi bed types
support_multi_bed_types.tip: Enable this option if you want to use multiple bed types.
support_multi_bed_types.tip_zh: 如果要使用多种打印床类型，请启用此选项

time_cost.label: Time cost
time_cost.tip_zh: 打印机每小时运行成本

deretraction_speed.label: De-retraction Speed
deretraction_speed.tip: Speed for reloading filament into the nozzle. Zero means same speed of retraction.
deretraction_speed.tip_zh:
向喷嘴重新装填耗材的速度。
设为 0 则使用与回抽相同的速度。

long_retractions_when_cut.label: Long retraction when cut (beta)
long_retractions_when_cut.tip: Experimental feature: Retracting and cutting off the filament at a longer distance during changes to minimize purge. While this reduces flush significantly, it may also raise the risk of nozzle clogs or other printing problems.
long_retractions_when_cut.tip_zh: 实验性选项。在更换耗材丝时，将耗材丝回抽一段距离后再切断以最小化冲刷。虽然这大大减少了冲刷，但也可能增加喷嘴堵塞或其他打印问题的风险。

parking_pos_retraction.label: Filament parking position
parking_pos_retraction.tip: Distance of the extruder tip from the position where the filament is parked when unloaded. This should match the value in printer firmware.
parking_pos_retraction.tip_zh: 卸载时，挤出机齿尖与耗材停放位置的距离。这应该与打印机固件中的值相匹配。

retract_before_wipe.label: Retract amount before wipe
retract_before_wipe.tip: The length of fast retraction before wipe, relative to retraction length.
retract_before_wipe.tip_zh: 擦拭之前的回抽长度，用总回抽长度的百分比表示。

retract_length_toolchange.label: Length
retract_length_toolchange.tip: When retraction is triggered before changing tool, filament is pulled back by the specified amount (the length is measured on raw filament, before it enters the extruder).

retract_lift_above.label: Only lift Z above
retract_lift_above.tip: If you set this to a positive value, Z lift will only take place above the specified absolute Z.
retract_lift_above.tip_zh: 如果将其设置为正值，则Z抬升仅在指定的绝对Z之上发生

retract_lift_below.label: Only lift Z below
retract_lift_below.tip: If you set this to a positive value, Z lift will only take place below the specified absolute Z.
retract_lift_below.tip_zh: 如果将其设置为正值，则Z抬升仅在指定的绝对Z以下发生。

retract_lift_enforce.label: On surfaces
retract_lift_enforce.tip: Enforce Z-Hop behavior. This setting is impacted by the above settings (Only lift Z above/below).
retract_lift_enforce.tip_zh: 强制Z抬升行为。此设置受上述设置的影响（仅在高度以下抬Z/仅在高度以上抬Z）。

retract_restart_extra.label: Extra length on restart
retract_restart_extra.tip: When the retraction is compensated after the travel move, the extruder will push this additional amount of filament. This setting is rarely needed.
retract_restart_extra.tip_zh: 每当空驶后回抽被补偿时，挤出机将推入额外数量的耗材丝。很少需要此设置。

retract_restart_extra_toolchange.label: Extra length on restart
retract_restart_extra_toolchange.tip: When the retraction is compensated after changing tool, the extruder will push this additional amount of filament.
retract_restart_extra_toolchange.tip_zh: 当换色后回抽被补偿时，挤出机将推入额外数量的耗材丝。

retract_when_changing_layer.label: Retract when change layer
retract_when_changing_layer.tip: Force a retraction when changes layer.

retraction_distances_when_cut.label: Retraction distance when cut
retraction_distances_when_cut.tip: Experimental feature: Retraction length before cutting off during filament change.
retraction_distances_when_cut.tip_zh: 实验性选项：在更换耗材丝时，切断前的回抽长度

retraction_length.label: Length
retraction_length.tip: Some amount of material in extruder is pulled back to avoid ooze during long travel. Set zero to disable retraction.
retraction_length.tip_zh: 挤出机中的一些材料被拉回，以避免在长行程期间渗出。设置为零以禁用回缩。

retraction_minimum_travel.label: Travel distance threshold
retraction_minimum_travel.tip: Only trigger retraction when the travel distance is longer than this threshold.
retraction_minimum_travel.tip_zh: 只在空驶距离大于该数值时触发回抽。

retraction_speed.label: Retraction Speed
retraction_speed.tip: Speed for retracting filament from the nozzle.
retraction_speed.tip_zh: 从喷嘴回抽耗材的速度

use_firmware_retraction.label: Use firmware retraction
use_firmware_retraction.tip: This experimental setting uses G10 and G11 commands to have the firmware handle the retraction. This is only supported in recent Marlin.
use_firmware_retraction.tip_zh: （实验设置）使用G10和G11命令让固件处理回抽。该功能仅支持最近版本的Marlin固件。

printer_agent.label: Printer Agent
printer_agent.tip: Select the network agent implementation for printer communication.
printer_agent.tip_zh: 选择打印机通信的网络代理实施。

printer_variant.label: Printer variant
printer_variant.tip: Name of the printer variant. For example, the printer variants may be differentiated by a nozzle diameter.

bed_exclude_area.label: Bed exclude area
bed_exclude_area.tip: Unprintable area in XY plane. For example, X1 Series printers use the front left corner to cut filament during filament change. The area is expressed as polygon by points in following format: "XxY, XxY, ..."
bed_exclude_area.tip_zh: XY平面上的不可打印区域。例如，X1系列打印机在换料过程中，会使用左前角区域来切断耗材丝。这个多边形区域由以下格式的点表示：“XxY，XxY，…”

extruder_printable_height.label: Extruder printable height
extruder_printable_height.tip: Maximum printable height of this extruder which is limited by mechanism of printer.
extruder_printable_height.tip_zh: 该挤出机的最大可打印高度受打印机机构的限制。

printable_height.label: Printable height
printable_height.tip: Maximum printable height which is limited by mechanism of printer.
printable_height.tip_zh: 由打印机结构约束的最大可打印高度

default_nozzle_volume_type.label: Default Nozzle Volume Type.
default_nozzle_volume_type.tip: Default Nozzle volume type for extruders in this printer.

extruder_clearance_height_to_lid.label: Height to lid
extruder_clearance_height_to_lid.tip: Distance of the nozzle tip to the lid. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.
extruder_clearance_height_to_lid.tip_zh: 喷嘴尖端到顶盖的距离。用于在逐件打印中避免碰撞。

extruder_clearance_height_to_rod.label: Height to rod
extruder_clearance_height_to_rod.tip: Distance of the nozzle tip to the lower rod. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.
extruder_clearance_height_to_rod.tip_zh: 喷嘴尖端到下方滑杆的距离。用于在逐件打印中避免碰撞。

extruder_clearance_radius.label: Radius
extruder_clearance_radius.tip: Clearance radius around extruder. Used for collision avoidance in by-object printing.
extruder_clearance_radius.tip_zh: 挤出机四周的避让半径。用于在逐件打印中避免碰撞。

extruder_colour.label: Extruder Color
extruder_colour.tip: Only used as a visual help on UI.
extruder_colour.tip_zh: 只作为界面上的可视化辅助

extruder_offset.label: Extruder offset
extruder_offset.tip: If your firmware doesn't handle the extruder displacement you need the G-code to take it into account. This option lets you specify the displacement of each extruder with respect to the first one. It expects positive coordinates (they will be subtracted from the XY coordinate).

extruder_type.label: Type
extruder_type.tip: This setting is only used for initial value of manual calibration of pressure advance. Bowden extruder usually has larger PA value. This setting doesn't influence normal slicing.

nozzle_hrc.label: Nozzle HRC
nozzle_hrc.tip: The nozzle's hardness. Zero means no checking for nozzle's hardness during slicing.
nozzle_hrc.tip_zh:
喷嘴硬度。
设为 0 表示在切片时将不检查喷嘴硬度。

nozzle_type.label: Nozzle type
nozzle_type.tip: The metallic material of nozzle. This determines the abrasive resistance of nozzle, and what kind of filament can be printed.
nozzle_type.tip_zh: 喷嘴的金属材料。这将决定喷嘴的耐磨性，以及可打印材料的种类

nozzle_volume.label: Nozzle volume
nozzle_volume.tip: Volume of nozzle between the cutter and the end of nozzle.
nozzle_volume.tip_zh: 从切刀位置到喷嘴尖端的内腔体积

purge_in_prime_tower.label: Purge in prime tower
purge_in_prime_tower.tip: Purge remaining filament into prime tower.
purge_in_prime_tower.tip_zh: 冲刷剩余的耗材丝进入擦拭塔

single_extruder_multi_material.label: Single Extruder Multi Material
single_extruder_multi_material.tip: Use single nozzle to print multi filament.
single_extruder_multi_material.tip_zh: 使用单喷嘴打印多耗材

bed_mesh_probe_distance.label: Probe point distance
bed_mesh_probe_distance.tip: This option sets the preferred distance between probe points (grid size) for the X and Y directions, with the default being 50mm for both X and Y.
bed_mesh_probe_distance.tip_zh: 此选项设置了X和Y方向的探针点（网格大小）之间的首选距离，其默认值为X和Y方向均为50mm。

use_relative_e_distances.label: Use relative E distances
use_relative_e_distances.tip: Relative extrusion is recommended when using "label_objects" option. Some extruders work better with this option unchecked (absolute extrusion mode). Wipe tower is only compatible with relative mode. It is recommended on most printers. Default is checked.
use_relative_e_distances.tip_zh: 相对挤出建议在使用"label_objects"选项时使用。某些挤出机在未选中此选项（绝对挤出模式）时工作得更好。擦拭塔仅与相对模式兼容。建议在大多数打印机上使用。默认为选中状态。

wipe.label: Wipe while retracting
wipe.tip: Move nozzle along the last extrusion path when retracting to clean any leaked material on the nozzle. This can minimize blobs when printing a new part after traveling.
wipe.tip_zh: 当回抽时，让喷嘴沿着前面的走线方向继续移动，清除掉喷嘴上的漏料。这能够避免空驶结束打印新的区域时产生斑点。

wipe_distance.label: Wipe Distance
wipe_distance.tip:
Describe how long the nozzle will move along the last path when retracting.

Depending on how long the wipe operation lasts, how fast and long the extruder/filament retraction settings are, a retraction move may be needed to retract the remaining filament.

Setting a value in the retract amount before wipe setting below will perform any excess retraction before the wipe, else it will be performed after.
wipe_distance.tip_zh:
喷嘴在回抽时将沿着最后路径移动的距离

根据擦拭操作的距离以及挤出机/耗材丝回抽的速度和长度，可能需要执行额外的回抽动作以收回剩余的丝材。

在下方的擦拭前回抽量设置中输入一个数值，将在擦拭动作之前执行任何超出部分的回抽，否则超出部分的回抽将在擦拭之后执行。

wipe_tower_type.label: Wipe tower type
wipe_tower_type.tip: Choose the wipe tower implementation for multi-material prints. Type 1 is recommended for Bambu and Qidi printers with a filament cutter. Type 2 offers better compatibility with multi-tool and MMU printers and provide overall better compatibility.
wipe_tower_type.tip_zh: 选择多材料打印的擦拭塔实现方式。类型 1 推荐用于带有耗材切刀的 Bambu 和 Qidi 打印机。类型 2 提供与多工具头和 MMU 打印机更好的兼容性，并提供更好的整体兼容性。

bed_temperature_formula.label: Bed temperature type
bed_temperature_formula.tip: This option determines how the bed temperature is set during slicing: based on the temperature of the first filament or the highest temperature of the printed filaments.
bed_temperature_formula.tip_zh:
此选项用以设置切片时的热床温度确定方式。
可选择“根据初始打印耗材”或“根据最高打印温度”。

z_hop.label: Z-hop height
z_hop.tip: Whenever the retraction is done, the nozzle is lifted a little to create clearance between nozzle and the print. It prevents nozzle from hitting the print when travel move. Using spiral lines to lift Z can prevent stringing.
z_hop.tip_zh: 回抽完成之后，喷嘴轻微抬升，和打印件之间产生一定间隙。这能够避免空驶时喷嘴和打印件剐蹭和碰撞。使用螺旋线抬升z能够减少拉丝。

z_offset.label: Z offset
z_offset.tip: This value will be added (or subtracted) from all the Z coordinates in the output G-code. It is used to compensate for bad Z endstop position: for example, if your endstop zero actually leaves the nozzle 0.3mm far from the print bed, set this to -0.3 (or fix your endstop).
z_offset.tip_zh: 此值将从输出 G-Code 中的所有 Z 坐标中添加(或减去)。它用于补偿损坏的 Z 端限位器置：例如，如果限位器零实际离开喷嘴 0.3mm 远离打印板(打印床)，将其设置为 -0.3（或调整限位器）。

resonance_avoidance.label: Resonance avoidance
resonance_avoidance.tip:
By reducing the speed of the outer wall to avoid the resonance zone of the printer, ringing on the surface of the model are avoided.
Please turn this option off when testing ringing.
resonance_avoidance.tip_zh:
通过降低外壁的速度以避开打印机的共振区，可以避免模型表面产生振稳。
在测试振稳时，请关闭此选项。

silent_mode.label: Supports silent mode
silent_mode.tip: Whether the machine supports silent mode in which machine use lower acceleration to print.
silent_mode.tip_zh: 机器是否支持使用低加速度打印的静音模式。

thumbnails.label: G-code thumbnails
thumbnails.tip: Picture sizes to be stored into a .gcode and .sl1 / .sl1s files, in the following format: "XxY, XxY, ..."
thumbnails.tip_zh: 将被存储到.gcode和.sl1/.sl1s文件中的图片尺寸，格式如下："XxY, XxY, ..."

thumbnails_format.label: Format of G-code thumbnails
thumbnails_format.tip: Format of G-code thumbnails: PNG for best quality, JPG for smallest size, QOI for low memory firmware.
thumbnails_format.tip_zh: G-Code 缩略图格式: PNG 质量最佳，JPG 尺寸最小，QOI 用于低内存固件

auxiliary_fan.label: Auxiliary part cooling fan
auxiliary_fan.tip: Enable this option if machine has auxiliary part cooling fan. G-code command: M106 P2 S(0-255).
auxiliary_fan.tip_zh: 如果打印机有辅助风扇，可以开启此选项。G-code指令：M106 P2 S(0-255)

cooling_tube_length.label: Cooling tube length
cooling_tube_length.tip: Length of the cooling tube to limit space for cooling moves inside it.
cooling_tube_length.tip_zh: 喉管的长度，用于限制冷却内部移动的空间。

cooling_tube_retraction.label: Cooling tube position
cooling_tube_retraction.tip: Distance of the center-point of the cooling tube from the extruder tip.
cooling_tube_retraction.tip_zh: 喉管的中心点与挤出机齿尖的距离。

fan_kickstart.label: Fan kick-start time
fan_kickstart.tip:
Emit a max fan speed command for this amount of seconds before reducing to target speed to kick-start the cooling fan.
This is useful for fans where a low PWM/power may be insufficient to get the fan started spinning from a stop, or to get the fan up to speed faster.
Set to 0 to deactivate.
fan_kickstart.tip_zh:
对风扇发送全速运行信号，运行一定秒数后减至预定速度，以帮助风扇顺利转动。
此功能可帮助某些难以启动的低功率、PWM风扇顺利运转起来，或用于让风扇在启动后尽快提升转速。
设为 0 以禁用。

fan_speedup_overhangs.label: Only overhangs
fan_speedup_overhangs.tip: Will only take into account the delay for the cooling of overhangs.

fan_speedup_time.label: Fan speed-up time
fan_speedup_time.tip:
Start the fan this number of seconds earlier than its target start time (you can use fractional seconds). It assumes infinite acceleration for this time estimation, and will only take into account G1 and G0 moves (arc fitting is unsupported).
It won't move fan commands from custom G-code (they act as a sort of 'barrier').
It won't move fan commands into the start G-code if the 'only custom start G-code' is activated.
Use 0 to deactivate.
fan_speedup_time.tip_zh:
提前一定秒数启动风扇（可使用小数），且不考虑加速度，仅考虑 G1 和 G0 移动命令（不支持弧线拟合）。
此功能不会移动自定义命令中的G-code，而是以屏蔽方式工作，就算启用了“仅自定义启动 G-code”，它也不会将风扇命令移动至启动G-code中。
设为 0 以禁用。
